You gain experience.

You receive Hurrieta's Bloody Dress. Take Hurrieta's Bloody Dress and seek out Garuc Anehm in the Qeynos Aqueducts.

Hand the dress to him to get your reward: Experience, faction, money and a piece of Patchwork armor or Rat Shaped Ring.

Garuc Anehm says 'Hahaha.. I see you actually killed a respected, well-known citizen of Qeynos. No loss for them, but you are certainly a gain for our shrine. Maybe this shall do you some good. If not now, then surely later. You may need it when the Qeynos Guards hunt you down.'

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
Erudin Palace
Quest Giver:
Josper Kenshed
Minimum Level:
1+
Classes:
Enchanter, Magician, Necromancer, Wizard
Related Zones:
Everfrost Peaks
Related NPCs:
an ice goblin whelp, an ice goblin scout, ice goblin diver
Required Faction:
Amiable or better

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Josper Kenshed is located at +910, +740 in the Tower of The Crimson Hands in Erudin Palace.

You say, 'Hail, Josper Kenshed'

Josper Kenshed says 'Come forward and speak. What is it you seek within these walls? Let it be the knowledge of wizardry, for that is what we are. Only a [servant of wizardry] should be within these walls.'

You say, 'I am a servant of wizardry.'

Josper Kenshed says 'A servant, you say? If you be a young apprentice, perhaps you might assist me? I could use you to [collect components]. If you believe yourself to be beyond such things, you may wish to assist me with a [special matter].'

You say, 'I can collect components.'

Josper Kenshed says 'Of course you may assist me | We have much need of a certain item which can only be found in the frigid peaks of Everfrost. There you shall find creatures called ice goblins. Take this bag and fill it with ice goblin beads and be sure to combine them before you return them. Well, then... Off with you | And be quick about it and I shall give you a fine wizard's weapon. None of this rust-covered garbage offered by our associates!'

Receive an Empty Bag (identifies as "Bag for Ice Necklaces"), a 6-slot container.

Head to Everfrost Peaks and kill ice goblins to loot Goblin Ice Necklaces. Ice goblins near Halas are lvls 1 - 3 and can drop these

Combine 6 Goblin Ice Necklaces in the Empty Bag to create a Bag of Ice Necklaces.

Hand Josper Kenshed the Bag of Ice Necklaces.

Josper Kenshed says 'Well done, my young apprentice. I call you apprentice for you are nothing but a spark to my fire. This is the final component for my greatest creation. AHA | I call it - iced tea | Never again shall I boil under the hot sun. As for you, take this. It should serve you well. Now go away. There is no iced tea for you.'

• Your faction standing with Crimson Hands got better.
• Your faction standing with High Council of Erudin got better.
• Your faction standing with Heretics got worse.
• Your faction standing with High Guard of Erudin got better.

You gain experience.

You receive Servant's Staff.

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
Halas
Quest Giver:
Lysbith McNaff
Minimum Level:
2
Classes:
?
Related Zones:
Everfrost Peaks
Related NPCs:
ice goblin whelp or ice goblin scout

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Lysbith McNaff is located (566, -410) in the Pit of Doom. Faction of indifferent required for quest - CAN be completed while sneaking.

You say, 'Hail, Lysbith McNaff'

Lysbith McNaff says 'Hail! Ye've come to [serve Halas], have ye not? We're the Wolves o' the North and it is our task to defend our city from harm.'

You say, 'I serve Halas.'

Lysbith McNaff says 'Halas is surrounded by barren arctic tundra. We've many foes. Among them are the [orc troopers], [ice goblins] and the ever-present polar bears.'

You say, 'What ice goblins?'

Lysbith McNaff says 'The ice goblins have plagued our community fer some time now. At times, they even manage to get inside our walls. Fer the most part, they prey on travelers who pass through Everfrost Peaks. Since they're a weak race, we employ our youngest warriors to [protect the pass].'

You say, 'I will protect the pass.'

Lysbith McNaff says 'Then travel to the Everfrost Peaks and take this pack with ye. I want ye to return this pack to me when it is filled with the beaded ice necklaces o' the ice goblins. When it is filled, combine the items and return it to me and I'll decide whether ye deserve a reward fer yer deed.'

You receive a six-slot container called Empty Bag (identifies as "Bag for Ice Necklaces"). Kill ice goblin whelps or ice goblin scouts in Everfrost Peaks and loot Goblin Ice Necklace. They are found wandering throughout the canyon area. Combine six Goblin Ice Necklace in the bag to craft a Bag of Ice Necklaces. Hand this in to Lysbith.

Lysbith McNaff says 'Ye've done well, me young warrior. We've gathered these to add to yer provisions. While in the Everfrost Peaks, be on the watch fer any gnolls ye may find. I declare there to be a [gnoll bounty].'

• Your faction standing with Wolves of the North got better.
• Your faction standing with Shamen of Justice got better.
• Your faction standing with Merchants of Halas got better.
• Your faction standing with Steel Warriors got better.
You gain experience.

You receive 3 gold from Lysbith McNaff.

Additionally you will randomly receive: ration, iron ration, torch, water flask, or small lantern.

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
Northern Plains of Karana
Quest Giver:
Quartermaster Nellian
Minimum Level:
1
Classes:
??
Related Zones:
Northern Plains of Karana
Related NPCs:
??

The Cracking of the Icestar

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, 'Hail, Quartermaster Nellian'

Quartermaster Nellian says, 'I've run supplies for more Snowdrift feasts than I can count, but this year's shaping up poorly. Wolves raided the wagon on the way down from Velious, and the berries froze into stone. If we're going to have anything decent for the Icestar's Eve, I need [help].'

You say, 'What help?'

Quartermaster Nellian says, 'Just the basics, nothing fancy. If you can bring me the following, I can finish the first round of meals. Mammoth Meat, Snow Bunny Stew, and Chilled Berries. Sounds awful I know, but wait until you try it. I'll trade you something cheerful for your trouble. Might even let you have a bite yourself.'

Collect the following:

• Mammoth Meat drops from Mammoths in Eastern Wastes or Everfrost Peaks.
• Snow Bunny Stew is a baking recipe (Trivial: 68).
• Chilled Berries drops from a tundra yeti in Dreadlands.

Turn in the three ingredients,

Quartermaster Nellian says, 'Oh! That's real mammoth, not that cavebeast knockoff. And these berries… still cold, not mushy. You're a miracle worker. If we serve this to the camp, they might stop singing 'Greensong Gravy' every ten minutes! Here. The warmth isn't just for us — it’s for anyone who helps make the night brighter. Be sure to consume it before the end of the festival!'

You receive Aurillias' Winter Broth and a Holiday Gift.

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
East Cabilis
Quest Giver:
an Iksar prisoner
Minimum Level:
25
Classes:
All
Related Zones:
Crypt of Dalnir
Related NPCs:
a coerced dwarf

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest article describes the "bad ending" of what begins as the Trooper Scale Bracers quest.

Drixiv Arcut says 'The bracers of our ancestors embody righteousness. When we strike, and our forearms are soaked in the blood of our enemies, our purpose must be pure. Else that blood will burn our souls and anger that which we live for. Go and find the Archduke in Cabilis and give him my note. He will teach you of righteousness. For if our chosen did not know righteousness, our people would not be. Go!

You give the note to Arch Duke Xog

Arch Duke Xog takes the note and glances at it briefly then lets out a heavy sigh and stares out over the city for several minutes. Finally he says quietly, 'Several months ago we lost contact with one of our crusaders. His name is, or was, Geanik. The last we heard from him he was furthering our cause against the loathsome Goblins that reside in Warsliks Wood. Just recently we were visited by a [strange Iksar].

You say, 'what strange iksar'

Arch Duke Xog says 'Yes, he was dressed in rags and hadn't eaten in days. He rambled on about seemingly nothing, obviously he had lost his mind at some point. The guards brought him in because he told them he had valuable information concerning a captured Crusader. According to the mad man, our missing knight was captured by a group of cultists that follow a false god. The cultists intend on converting him apparently. Your [test] will concern Geanik.

You say, 'what test'

Arch Duke Xog says 'Learning Righteousness is learning to listen to one's own heart. At all times our Lord of Fear speaks to us. Our heart is through which he speaks. If we are pure in action and undistracted in mind we can hear the very words of our Father. Your test will be to find our lost Crusader. When you find him you must listen, and act based on what you hear. If your actions are Righteous, I will give you my reference. Bring me proof of your action and two sapphires.

Upon locating an Iksar prisoner on the second floor of the Crypt of Dalnir, you have 2 choices, you must listen to your heart:
• Kill him for being a coward and return his Traitor's Heart.
• Assist him in escaping his shackles and return with proof of your actions.

You say, 'Hail, an Iksar prisoner'

an Iksar prisoner squints at you and gasps when he recognizes notoriety within Iksar society. He scrambles to his feet and says, 'Please, brother! Get me out of these chains so that I may escape back to Cabilis! They intend to coerce me like the others. A more tragic fate no Iksar should endure. I implore you to [help] me!'

You say, 'how can I help you?'

an Iksar prisoner says 'Well some of the brainwashed short ones seem to know much of mechanical devices and such. Perhaps they have a tool that can get me out of these chains. If they have anything that looks useful bring it to me. I'm sure your help will be rewarded once I reach Cabilis.'

Kill Coerced Dwarves until you get a rare drop of Serrated Wire, take that and give it to the prisoner. Must be indifferent faction or greater.

an Iksar prisoner takes the wire and quickly saws through the rusted shackles. He hands you an icon and says as he runs off, 'Show that to the Arch Duke in Cabilis! He will reward you. Now I'm off to escape!'

You gain experience.

You receive a Greenmist Icon in your inventory and can head to the top floor of the Shaman and Shadowknight guild in East Cabilis.

Arch Duke Xog takes the icon and stares at it. His face twists into a look of disdain and he suddenly throws the icon off the balcony. it lands in the water some distance away. Without even a glance at you he says in disgust, 'You're an idiot, Jhereg. You fit your profession well. Leave me sight.'

• Your faction standing with Crusaders Of Greenmist got worse.
• Your faction standing with Legion of Cabilis got worse.

Old Thread on this quest being "Unsolved" (http://oldunsolvedquestsineverquest.yuku.com/topic/409)

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
Erudin Palace
Quest Giver:
Josper Kenshed
Minimum Level:
5
Classes:
Wizard
Related Zones:
Toxxulia Forest
Related NPCs:
A Kobold Caster, Ilanics Skeleton

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Josper Kenshed in the Wizard's Guild of Erudin mentions a [special matter]. Ask him about it and he will ask you to find the skeleton Ilanic and ask him [where is the scroll?].

You say, 'Hail, Josper Kenshed'

Josper Kenshed says, 'Come forward and speak. What is it you seek within these walls? Let it be the knowledge of wizardry. for that is what we are. Only a [servant of wizardry] should be within these walls.'

You say, 'i am a servant of wizardry'

Josper Kenshed says, 'A servant. you say? If you be a young apprentice. perhaps you might assist me? I could use you to [collect components]. If you believe yourself to be beyond such things. you may wish to assist me with a [special matter].'

You say, 'what special matter'

Josper Kenshed says, 'An old friend of mine, Ilanic, can not rest till he his research is finished. If I only know what he was working on. Goto the forest of Toxxulia and seek him out. Bring me back what information you can find about what he was researching before his demise.'

He sent his apprentice, Ilanic, to test his new spell icecapades but only gave him half the spell. Ilanic wanders Toxxulia Forest. He says when you bring the scroll half back to him he'll give the complete spell. Ilanic is a named skeleton that roams the Southern part of Toxxulia forest.

You say, 'Where is the scroll?'

Ilanics Skeleton says, 'Kobold! Kobold!'

It seems a A Kobold Caster has taken the spell half from the skeleton. The Kobold Caster is a rare spawn and drops the spell half you're looking for. Turn in Half of a Spell to Josper and receive Spell: Column of Frost, experience and faction.

• Your faction standing with Crimson Hands got better.
• Your faction standing with High Council of Erudin got better.
• Your faction standing with Heretics got worse.
• Your faction standing with High Guard of Erudin got better.

You gain experience.

Josper Kenshed says, 'Go now and use his research to aid yourself. Seems that I lack the will to use Ilanic's knowledge for my better good.'

Receive Spell: Column of Frost

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:

West Freeport
Quest Giver:
Tara Neklene
Minimum Level:
5
Classes:
?
Related Zones:

orc apprentice

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Tara Neklene may found on the bottom level of the Academy of Arcane Sciences at 112, -720, -23 reachable by walking over the glimmering circles in the floor of the main chamber. A find will not locate her because of the teleportation involved.

You say, 'Hail, Tara Neklene'

Tara Neklene says 'It is always a pleasure to meet a new face. We have many who travel far and wide to visit our great academy. Many who brave the long trip by boat. Many who dare to cross the territory of the [Deathfist orcs].'

You say, 'What are the Deathfist orcs?'

Tara Neklene says 'The Deathfist are a clan of orcs. They are not very powerful, yet I hear they dabble in the circles of magic. Their skills in the ways of magic are limited. It is my duty to study them. I shall pay for your services. Will you [assist with the research]?'

You say, 'I will assist with the research.'

Tara Neklene says 'Yes. You will do. Go into the lands which surround Freeport. There you shall encounter Deathfist apprentices. They are as young as yourself and each should carry an orc cantrip. Return one for further studies. Do so and you will earn your pay as well as our respect.'

Head to the orc camps in East Commonlands and kill an "orc apprentice" to loot an Illegible Cantrip. Bring this back to Tara.

Tara Neklene says 'Very fine work, my young apprentice. This shall be very useful in understanding their ways. I have heard rumors of a scribe who can decipher these scrolls. He is said to frequent the local taverns. Bah | If I cannot decipher them, no one can | Continue with your work. Soon you shall advance enough to [test the might of the orc oracles].'

• Your faction standing with Arcane Scientists got better. (+10)
• Your faction standing with Knights of Truth got better. (+5)
• Your faction standing with Opal Dark Briar got worse. (-1)
• Your faction standing with The Freeport Militia got worse. (-1)
You gain experience.

You receive 15 silver from Tara Neklene.

You receive a minor item.

Edit: 2 x turn-ins (11 Enc) yielded:
6 Silver, 5 Copper, a Torch
11 Silver, 8 Copper, a Torch

For the most part, you get a Ration, an Iron Ration, a torch or a Cracked Staff

sections.heading: Oracle Scrolls
sections.text:
You say, 'I will test the might of the orc oracles.'

Tara Necklene says 'You had best leave my sight. I am a faithful member of the Academy of Arcane Science and you are no ally of ours.'

This likely leads into a separate quest (details needed).

EDIT: I have done this with multiple characters with just amiable faction. Used cantrips to just barely cross from indifferent to amiable, and it worked with minimal Amiable (as a Halfling Cleric), but it no longer requires kindly. (as of 25 Feb 18)

At dubiously to amiable:

You say, 'I will test the might of the orc oracles'

Tara Neklene says, 'The word of mouth in the Academy of Arcane Science is that you are no foe, but you have yet to prove your worth to us. Perform more tasks for the great Tara Neklene.'

At kindly:

You say, 'I will test the might of the orc oracles'

Tara Neklene says, 'You have heightened your knowledge to the appropriate rank. You are ready to challenge the Deathfish oracles. Do so and return one oracle scroll which any of them may have. If I am in a good mood when you return, you shall soon be summoning elementals.'

Upon turning in an Illegible Scroll:

Tara Neklene says, 'Wonderful | You have survived the might of an oracle. With this we can now continue with our experiments. Now you may continue your teaching and study the power to summon those of earth, air, water and fire.'

She gives you a random Level 4 Magician pet spell, Spell: Elementalkin: Air/Earth/Fire/Water

• Your faction standing with Arcane Scientists got better.
• Your faction standing with Knights of Truth got better.
• Your faction standing with Opal Dark Briar got worse.
• Your faction standing with The Freeport Militia got worse.
You gain experience.

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
High Keep (or East Freeport)
Quest Giver:
Lozani
Minimum Level:
5
Classes:
Casters and Priests
Related Zones:
Crushbone, East Commonlands, West Commonlands
Related NPCs:
Orc Apprentice, Orc Oracle (Crushbone), Orc Oracle (Deathfist)
Required Faction:
Amiable or better

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Find a gnome named Lozani on the third floor of High Keep. He shares at least one spawn point with a noble, so if there is someone else camping them, you might have to wait or kill the placeholder.

You say, 'Hail, Lozani'

Lozani says 'Greetings, friend | I am Lozani, Scribe Supreme of the Eldritch Collective. I have been sent forth from the great Library of Mechanimagica in the city of Ak'Anon, to study the arcane knowledge of man and beast alike. I have studied many languages and spells, from Crushbone to Kerra Ridge. I have found most languages hard to decipher. As of this date, I have learned to read only the script of the [orc oracles]. Oh well, I am on a five decade mission. Better luck next language.'

You say, 'What orc oracles?'

Lozani says 'Oh | Heard of the orc oracles have you? A ghastly bunch they are | Argh! The numerous days I spent interrogating those beasts with their foul breath. It was as if rats had gone and died in their mouths. I wished I could read minds after those days. TWENTY WEEKS of that rat-carcass breath and all I have learned is the ability to decipher [oracle scrolls] and [apprentice cantrips]. What a mess that was! I'm beginning to think I should have become a Gemchopper.'

You say, 'What oracle scrolls?'

Lozani says 'Orc oracle scrolls? Mere shaman spells are they. I know how to decipher those illegible scrolls. I can do so, but it will cost you. Nothing is for free in this world, y'know? You give me one of those illegible scrolls and four gold coins.'

You say, 'What apprentice cantrips?'

Lozani says 'Orc apprentice cantrips. Child's play they are. Very difficult to decipher, mostly due to the orc sweat smearing the writing. I fill in the blanks with a second orc cantrip and my universe of knowledge, so you never know what spell is going to be scribed! Could be magic, could be wizardry, could be necromancy, golly | Sometimes I even end up with a recipe | If you want me to try to decipher one just hand me two illegible cantrips. No coinage necessary | They are mostly apprentice spells. Nothing much.'

Give Lozani an Illegible Scroll (dropped by orc oracles) and 4 gold.

Lozani says, 'Hey! I said FOUR gold and the illegible scroll! Sheesh.'
Lozani says, Hmmm... Aha! Well, I think this is it. A fine spell. I hope you need it because you are not getting your gold back.'

You gain experience.

You receive a low level spell.

OR

Give him two Illegible Cantrips (dropped by orc apprentices).

Lozani says, 'I need TWO illegible cantrips. Not much to ask for.'
Lozani says, 'And the winning spell is... Here, you do the honors.'

You gain experience.

You receive a low level spell.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Experience gained was <2.5% for a level 13 High Elf Enchanter.
• Do NOT try and use the rotted illegible scrolls. They do not work.
• Lozani is also part of the NPC cycle at Seafarer's Roost in East Freeport where he offers this same quest.

Minimum Level:

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:

You say, 'Hail, General Jyleel'

General Jyleel says, 'Stand at attention | I am General Jyleel, of the Koada'Vie, defenders of Felwithe. Do you [follow Tunare], the Mother of All, or do you still [seek enlightenment]?'

You say, 'I seek enlightenment'

General Jyleel says, 'Then seek it within these walls. We welcome all fine upstanding Koada'Dal.'

You say, 'I follow Tunare'

General Jyleel says, 'Then you are wise indeed. Would you like to [assist the defenders] in our conflicts or have you other business to attend to?'

General Jyleel says, 'Seek out the Crushbone orcs of the Faydarks. We must have their oracle scrolls. They are illegible to you, but we will study them here in Felwithe. Only the orc oracles will carry them, so be very careful. There is also the problem with the [Crushbone runners].'

• Your faction standing with Anti-Mage got better. >

sections.heading: Checklist
sections.text:
• Shaman Powder - This should identify as "Powder of Nok". This comes from a "froglok nok shaman" in the north area of Firiona Vie. The icon looks like black pixie dust.

• Heart of Ice - This is dropped by icebone skeletons and greater icebone skeletons. The skeleton tower located in the SE corner of Lake of Ill Omen is an easy place to farm this item quickly.

• Ton Warrior Totem - This is dropped by various frogloks found in the froglok city in the Swamp of No Hope, and identifies as "Key of Dai -I.". Look for Ton and Krup frogloks holding a doll. They spawn apparently in several places but aren't very common. You can also get these in FV. Look for Ton Warriors holding a totem in their hand. SONH is much safer/lower level.

• Sabertooth Tiger Mane - These drop off the sabertooth Tigers found in Lake of Ill Omen, the Overthere, and Trakanon's Teeth.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, 'Hail, Luminare Pasinia'

Luminare Pasinia waves her hands as if to cast a spell. 'GREETINGS | I am the Luminare of Firiona by decree of his royal highness, King Thex,I am here to research spells and artifacts. I have much to do. I welcome any enchanter who offers to [assist the great Luminare].'

You say, 'I will assist the great Luminare.'

Luminare Pasinia says 'And great I am, indeeed | Alas, not great enough to be everywhere at once. I would gladly reward you if you would [collect components] for me.'

You say, 'I will collect components for you.'

Bring these items back to Luminare:

Luminare Pasinia says 'Do you not remember that I asked for powder of Nok, a Ton warrior totem, a heart of ice and a sabertooth tiger mane? Incomplete deeds shall fetch no enchanter reward.'
Luminare Pasinia says 'Do you not remember that I asked for powder of Nok, a Ton warrior totem, a heart of ice and a sabertooth tiger mane? Incomplete deeds shall fetch no enchanter reward.'
Luminare Pasinia says 'Do you not remember that I asked for powder of Nok, a Ton warrior totem, a heart of ice and a sabertooth tiger mane? Incomplete deeds shall fetch no enchanter reward.'

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
War Historian Kobl may be found in the Warriors Guild at -596, -237.

You say, 'Hail War Historian Kobl'

War Historian Kobl says, 'You have come to learn, have you not? I have knowledge of importance to young warriors of the legion. Or perhaps you are a scribe seeking my [unique writing materials]!'

You say, 'What unique writing materials?'

War Historian Kobl says, 'You must be a scribe of sorts? Always glad to assist a talented youth. I make two things unique to Cabilis and important to any future scribe. I can create [blood ink] and [illweed parchment].'

You say, 'What blood ink?'

War Historian Kobl says, 'If blood ink is what you seek, only I can provide it. I use a unique blend prepared by my secret method. I can supply you with a vial of blood ink, but first you must fetch me four ingredients. I need globules of blood from certain creatures. I need globules from the carnivorous plants, leeches, and mosquitoes. I also need globules from the blood pit of the Tower of Death. Bring me these and be quick, or the blood will disintegrate.'

You say, 'What illweed parchment?'

War Historian Kobl says, 'If you wish to obtain a page of my illweed parchment, you only have to perform a simple task. Bring me four illweed reeds from the Lake of Ill Omen. You may find that the only way one can find illweed is to go fishing.'

You can fish Illweed in the Lake of Ill Omen. Pack up your fishing pole and some bait.

You offered 4 Illweed to War Historian Kobl.

War Historian Kobl says, 'That was easy enough. Here then is your page of illweed parchment. Don't waste it with silly limericks. Create a masterpiece.'

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Incandescent gear is Enchanter specific quested items from The Temple of Solusek Ro. Talk to Sultin.

You say, 'Hail, Sultin'

Sultin says, 'I am Sultin - keeper of the three [incandescent]s of power and the [rod] of Insidious Glamour. If you are an enchanter, perhaps we can deal.'

You say, 'incandescent'

Sultin says, 'There are three incandescent items of power - a [wand], [mask] and [gloves]. Are you [interested] in any of them?'

sections.heading: Incandescent Gloves
sections.text:
Obtain the following for Sultin:
• Glowing Gloves from a shadowed man
• Radiant Gloves from Radiant in The Temple of Cazic-Thule
• Enchanted Gloves by giving 5 pp to Tizina in Lavastorm Mountains
• Gleaming Gloves by giving a bloodstone to Tarn Visilin in Highpass Keep

You say, 'I am interested in the gloves'

Sultin says, 'My personal favorite! Incandescent gloves. If you bring me the components to make another pair, I will give you my gloves. Incandescent gloves are made by sewing together four other sets of gloves. Glowing gloves can be found on our mortal enemies, the shadowed men. Radiant gloves can be found on Radiant in the mazes of Cazic-Thule. Enchanted and gleaming gloves can be purchased for 50 golden coins from Tizina of the Lavastorm gypsies and a bloodstone from Tarn Vislin of High Keep. Bring me all four sets of gloves and I will give you a pair of incandescent ones.'

Shadowed men can be found in many zones. Glowing Gloves drom randomly from any of them.

Kill Radiant in The Temple of Cazic-Thule and loot the Radiant Gloves.

Go to Lavastorm Mountains and give 5 platinum pieces to Tizina, and she gives you the Enchanted Gloves:

Tizina says, 'Since you have given me gold, I will give you gloves. For more magic gloves, give a bloodstone to Tarn Visilin in the High Keep library.'

In Highpass Keep, get the Gleaming Gloves by giving a bloodstone to Tarn Visilin:

Tarn Visilin says, 'The gleam of blood - and now the gleam of gloves.'

Take all 4 gloves back to The Temple of Solusek Ro and give them to Sultin:

Sultin says, 'Four pairs of gloves you have given me ? I will give you one pair in return. We shall see who had the better deal.'

• Your faction standing with Temple Of Sol Ro has been adjusted by 5.
• Your faction standing with Shadowed Men has been adjusted by -1.

You gain experience.

You receive the Incandescent Gloves.

sections.heading: Incandescent Mask
sections.text:
Sultin needs four items:
• Glowing Mask, found on a froglok scryer or a skeleton monk in Upper Guk
• Rune of Fortune (top), from Enynti in the Chasm below Mistmoore
• Rune of Fortune (bottom) by giving 5 pp to Mizr N`Mar in the Neriak City Library
• Rune of Fortune (middle) by giving 5 pp to Madame Serena in South Qeynos

You say, 'I am interested in the mask'

Sultin says, 'An item of power! The incandescent mask. If you will bring me the components to make another, I will give you my own incandescent mask. I will need a glowing mask, found on the skeletal monk in the caverns of Guk. I will also need all three runes of fortune. One rune can be found on the dark elf Enynti in the chasm below Castle Mistmoore. The other two can be purchased for 50 golden coins, one from Mizr N'Mar in the Neriak City Library and the other from Madam Serena in the city of Qeynos. Bring me all three runes and the glowing mask and I will give you your reward.'

Kill a froglok scryer or a skeleton monk in Upper Guk for the Glowing Mask.

Kill the Dark Elf Enynti in the Chasm below Mistmoore for the Rune of Fortune (top).

Hand 5 platinum pieces to Mizr N`Mar in the Neriak City Library:

Mizr N`Mar says, 'Ahhh - gold. Here is the rune you desire.'

Mizr N`Mar gives you the Rune of Fortune (bottom).

In South Qeynos, behind the Mermaid's Lure near the dock, hand 5 platinum pieces to Madame Serena:

Madame Serena says, 'Fifty gold? You must want a rune of fortune. If you want another one, give fifty gold to Mizr N'Mar in the Neriak library.'

Madame Serena give you the Rune of Fortune (middle).

Go back to The Temple of Solusek Ro and give the Glowing Mask and the three different Runes of Fortune to Sultin:

Sultin says, 'Fortune favors you .. as will this mask.'

• Your faction standing with Temple Of Sol Ro has been adjusted by 5.
• Your faction standing with Shadowed Men has been adjusted by -1.

You gain experience.

You receive the Incandescent Mask.

sections.heading: Incandescent Wand
sections.text:
Sultin needs:
• Pouch of Silver Dust from the a dusty werebat in The Estate of Unrest
• Glowing Silver Wand from Raine Beteria
• Blessed Silver Wand from Ezmirella (and 5 pp)
• Silver Wand from a silvered guard in The Temple of Cazic-Thule (and 5 pp)

You say, 'I am interested in the wand'

Sultin says, 'Ahh, the incandescent wand. If you will get the components to make another, I will give you mine. I will need a pouch of silver dust, found on the dusty werebat in the Estate of Unrest. I will also need a silver wand, found on a silvered guard in the temple of Cazic-Thule. This wand will not be enchanted - you will need to pay Esmirella of the North Karana gypsy camp 50 gold to enchant it for you. When the wand is fully enchanted, bring it and the pouch to me and I will give you the incandescent wand.'

In The Estate of Unrest, get the keys and go to the basement. Slay a a dusty werebat to get the Pouch of Silver Dust.

In The Temple of Cazic-Thule, find a silvered guard at the northwest pyramids, and kill it to get a Silver Wand.

Find Ezmirella in the gypsy camp in the Northern Plains of Karana. Hand her the Silver Wand and 50 gold coins (or 5 platinum). She will return a Blessed Silver Wand and instruct you to seek out Raine Beteria.

Ezmirella says, 'I have blessed your silver wand. To complete the enchantment, you must take the wand to Raine Beteria in the Erudin library. Tip her 50 golden coins, and she will help you.'

Hand Raine the Blessed Silver Wand and 50 gold coins (or 5 platinum) to receive the Glowing Silver Wand.

Raine Beteria says, 'Your silver wand has been fully enchanted. Take it and the pouch of silver dust back to the temple of Ro.'

Take the Glowing Silver Wand and Pouch of Silver Dust back to Sultin. Hand him both.

Sultin says, 'I see that you are resourceful... you have earned your incandescent wand.'

• Your faction standing with Temple Of Sol Ro has been adjusted by 5.
• Your faction standing with Shadowed Men has been adjusted by -1.

You gain experience.

You receive the Incandescent Wand.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Toresian Fhabel is at 727.01, 804.42, 35.13 in Erudin Palace. Requires amiable faction to start the quest.

You say, 'Hail, Toresian Fhabel'

Toresian Fhabel says 'Welcome, my friend! We are the Craftkeepers. We study the circle of magic called enchantment. What circle do you [study]?'

You say, 'i will study enchantment'

Toresian Fhabel says 'Then I welcome you into our circle. It is good to see new blood. I have a favor to ask of you. Do you wish to [assist Toresian] or do you not have the time?'

This spawns either Slansin or Slansin Denvin downstairs in the shop Vials of Vitality. Slansin is a merchant selling one item, a cloth cap. Slansin Denvin is not a merchant, is wearing armor, and is an enchanter who will summon an enchanter pet after spawning. Only one Slansin can be up a time.

You say, 'I wish to assist Toresian'

Toresian Fhabel says 'Ahhhhh _____ . Slansin used to have need of these potions, how ever he mysteriously disappeared long ago. The only person I know of who still wants them is a cleric of the Church of Marr in Freeport.'

Receive Inert Potion.

sections.heading: Slansin
sections.text:
Give Slansin the Inert Potion.

Slansin says 'Thank you. I have been expecting this. We require it for mixing.'

• Your faction standing with Heretics got better.
• Your faction standing with Craftkeepers got worse.
• Your faction standing with High Council of Erudin got worse.
• Your faction standing with High Guard of Erudin got worse.

You gain experience.

Slansin then despawns. If you are after the other version, Slansin Devin, like most people are, you will need to repeat this step until he spawns. You can try again by saying 'I will study enchantment' to Toresian Fhabel. It took around 20 hands in and took a level 1 to a level 2 and 2 yellows before he spawned

sections.heading: Slansin Denvin
sections.text:
Works at dubious.

Give Slansin Denvin the Inert Potion.

Slansin Denvin says 'Ha | What a fool | I have stolen another potion to add to the crate. I shall make a fortune | The real Slansin is in back. Now it is time for me to leave.'

• Your faction standing with Coalition of Tradefolk Underground got better. (5)
• Your faction standing with Coalition of Tradefolk got better. (5)
• Your faction standing with Carson McCabe got better. (5)

Slansin Denvin does not despawn right away, meaning you can now repeat this part of the quest until he does. He stays up for at least 20 minutes.

sections.heading: Tips
sections.text:
You can actually trigger Toresian from the bottom floor to get the potion with hotkeys if you stand in the right spot. Go into Erudin City Office to the right wall (there is a bench there). Toresian is above at (727, 805). It's actually the "I will study enchantment" dialogue that spawns Slansin, the second line only gets the NPC to give you the potion. Make hotkey macro with the following lines:

/target Toresian_Fhabel
/say I will study Enchantment
/pause 3
/say I wish to assist Toresian
Then just go straight across to Vials of Vitality, where Slansin is.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest can be initiated with two different NPCs: Savarixsa Zexus who is located in the Shaman guild in Grobb or Saxarivza Zaxun who is located in the tunnels underneath East Freeport. Both NPCs provide the same quest text and letter. The one from Freeport can be obtained even at KOS con by standing above ground, over top her position stand at -93, -175 /target Saxarivza_Zaxun and say 'I am devoted to Innoruuk' to receive the letter. For the version from Grobb - The required faction to start this quest is dubious. A Ball of Golem Clay can be used to boost your faction from threatening to amiably if needed. Ornate Velium Pendant may also get you to dubious. Once you are dubious, the recommendation will be accepted.

You say, 'Hail, Savarixsa Zexus'

Savarixsa Zexus says 'Salutations, ______! I am here as a favor to my brother, High Priest Perrir. We seek loyal followers of Innoruuk to earn their place among the hierarchy of the Spires. Are you [devoted to Innoruuk]?'

You say, 'I am devoted to innoruuk'

Savarixsa Zexus says 'My brother requests your presence in Neriak at the Spires of Innoruuk. Take this note with you, _______. It will inform Perrir of who sent you.'

Deliver the note to Perrir Zexus in Neriak Third Gate at (408, -781, -51).

Although you can receive the letter at Threateningly, it is not sufficient faction to do hand in. There is a way around this if you can Sneak or find someone to cast invis on you during the turn in. You can open trade window around the corner from Perrir, out of line of sight. Time it to avoid pathing guards. Open the trade window, have someone reapply invis (or Sneak), and complete the trade while indifferent from.

Perrir Zexus says '_________ eh? My sister has a keen perception for seeing into a person's soul. You may store an abundance of hate but hate can be devoted to different ideals. Prove to me your devotion to our Lord Innoruuk by bringing me the skullcap of a Leatherfoot Raider who has invaded our forest. Go, ________, and do as I have requested'

sections.heading: Initiate Symbol of Innoruuk
sections.text:
Find Perrir Zexus in Neriak Third Gate. He resides in the Temple of Innoruuk (Cleric Guild) on the first floor in the southwest corner room.

When hailed with dubious and apprehensive faction:

You say, 'Hail, Perrir Zexus'
Perrir Zexus says 'You are worthless and pathetic! You could never be of service to our temple! Begone before your innards decorate our walls!'

I was indifferent faction with him as a Troll Shaman and was able to complete this quest from start to finish with no faction problems.

To get the faction needed as a Human: (1) Say "I am devoted to Innoruuk" to Saxarivza Zaxun in the underground East Freeport Tunnels and she hands you a note of recommendation (2) Take the note to Perrir Zexus at the Cleric guild in Neriak Third Gate (3) Repeat steps 1 and 2 one or two more times (On 11/6/19, it took 3 total turn-ins to go from dubious to amiable)

When hailed with acceptable faction:

You say, 'Hail, Perrir Zexus'
Perrir Zexus says 'Salutations, ________! Your devotion to our Lord Innoruuk is evident in your actions and on your soul. As a member of the Spires of Innoruuk, you are required to obtain and wear the symbol of your station among the clergy. I can award you the [hematite symbol of Innoruuk] worn by the initiates of the Spires.'
You say, "What hematite symbol of Innoruuk?"
Perrir Zexus says 'The forest beyond the gates of our grand city has been shaped by the magic of our Lord Innoruuk to be more hospitable to our kind. There are halfling druids in the service of Karana who have set up shrines there in hopes of restoring the forest to its former state. They could never succeed in their task with their feeble powers granted by their insignificant god, yet still, they are a nuisance. Bring me four of the holy symbols worn by the druids and I shall grant you the initiate symbol of Innoruuk.'

He wants four Woven Grass Amulets. There are 2 camps of Halflings in Nektulos, I used area 4 on the map because there were more spawns I could pull solo (at level 15), also Camp 4 is where Master Whoopal spawns (by the statue) and you need his head for the next step. It took about 30 kills to get my first Woven Grass Amulet, then I got the next 3 in about 5 minutes.

Hand in the four Woven Grass Amulets to Perrir Zexus back in Neriak Third Gate.

Perrir Zexus says, 'You have done well young Initiate. I grant you this medallion invested with the divine hatred of Innoruuk. Wear it proudly as a representation of your importance to these sacred spires. Now if you will excuse me I must proceed with the burning of these pathetic halfling symbols of faith.'

• Your faction standing with King Naythox Thex got better.
• Your faction standing with Priests of Innoruuk got better.
• Your faction standing with Clerics of Tunare got worse.
• Your faction standing with Priests of Life got worse.
• Your faction standing with Priests of Marr got worse.
• Your faction standing with Primordial Malice got worse.

sections.heading: Disciple Symbol of Innoruuk
sections.text:
Find Ithvol K`Jasn (another Cleric GM). He is upstairs from Perrir Zexus in Neriak Third Gate.

You say, 'Hail, Ithvol K`Jasn'

Ithvol K`Jasn says, 'Hail, _____! I sense the gift of hatred in your aura. What status do you hold within these Spires?'

You say, 'I am an initiate of Innoruuk'

Ithvol K`Jasn says, 'Well met, Initiate _____. If you desire to raise your station in this temple, I have a task for you. Are you willing to accept the task I am about to set before you?'

You say, 'I am willing'

Ithvol K`Jasn says 'As an initiate of the Spires, you have proven your hatred of the halflings who are desecrating our forest with their feeble shrines and camps. They persist in their hopeless task and seem to anticipate many of our tactics against them. Go out into the Nektulos and slay the one called Master Whoopal. Take his head to Draxiz N'Ryt so that he may probe the brain.'

Master Whoopal and his PH Quester Dunden spawn in Nektulos Forest at area 4 on the map (where you killed halflings for the Woven Grass Amulets earlier). I was unable to pull Quester Dunden solo, the guards would add. I recruited some help and Master Whoopal spawned on the 3rd try (6 minute respawn) and dropped Halfling Druid Master's Head. >

Loot his head and take it to Neriak Commons where you will hand it to Draxiz N'Ryt, He can be found upstairs in the caster's guild at location 120, -980, 3,75.

Draxiz N'Ryt glowers at you dubiously -- he appears to be quite formidable. (He will eat the turn in if done from around a corner at threateningly).

Draxiz N`Ryt says, 'I have foreseen your arrival, _____. I see from the mind of this lesser creature you have slain that he was receiving orders from beyond the boundaries of Nektulos. I see an armored Leatherfoot moving cautiously through the commonlands attempting to avoid the eyes of travelers and guard posts. Find this Leatherfoot I see in my visions and return any pertinent information he may be carrying to me so that I may decipher it. I have skinned the face of this druid and enchanted it so that you may learn what you must through your skills of subterfuge. Go now, _____, and do not disappoint me!'

• Your faction standing with The Dead got worse.
• Your faction standing with The Spurned got better.

You receive a Skinned Halfling Face Mask from Draxiz N`Ryt.

Draxiz N'Ryt looks your way apprehensively -- he appears to be quite formidable.

Find Wallin Slyfoot in the West Commonlands near Kithicor Forest at location 390, 3600, -51. Use the face mask illusion effect to temporarily boost your faction.

You feel different.

You say, 'Hail, Wallin Slyfoot'

Wallin Slyfoot says 'What? What do you want? Are you here to assist me?'

You say, 'Yes, I will assist you'

Wallin Slyfoot says 'Yes..yes..of course you will. It is a matter of the utmost importance. I need this letter to be delivered to Master Whoopal in the Nektulos forest but I must also get these Brussels sprouts to my granny before they spoil. Please deliver this message for me?'

You receive Leatherfoot Raider Orders Return to Draxiz N`Ryt in Neriak Commons and hand him the orders. Do not hand in the note until you are ready to kill the level 20 halfling spy, because handing in will spawn the quest mob. If you hand in and do not kill the mob then you have to repeat this step of the quest to get a new mask and note.

Draxiz N`Ryt says, 'I see you are more cunning than you appear, _____. These orders to Whoopal bring disturbing news indeed. It seems there is a Leatherfoot spy somewhere in Neriak who has been providing the raiders with information. Find this spy and return his head and your initiate holy symbol of Innoruuk to Ithvol and if he deems you worthy he will promote you within the ranks of the Spires.'

In a hidden passageway around -180, -560 in Neriak Commons, accessed either by swimming up the waterfall or through a false wall in "Toadstool" bar. - the spy - yellow to level 19 - aggros you. Run around in the passage back there until you either pass through a false wall on the left, or walk to the top of the path where you a false floor will give out. If you fall through the false floor, you will fall on top of the spy, be prepared.

a leatherfoot spy says 'I have been discovered | ! You will never stop us from reclaiming the Nektulos for Karana, _____ | '

I had a lvl18 necro with me for the spy kill, it was pretty easy. The spy will attempt to flee at low hp.

Loot the 'Head of a Halfling Spy' and return to Ithvol K`Jasn in Neriak 3rd Gate and give him the Head of a Halfling Spy and Initiate Symbol of Innoruuk. If you do not give him both items at the same time, you will have to redo the quest(s). It does not appear to be multi-quest-able. Handing in just the head results in the message "I don't need this." following that up with handing in just the necklace results in the same message and no disciple symbol. (11th June 2020: This seems incorrect. MQ is possible, I just handed in head and necklace one at a time, and I got the next necklace.)

Ithvol K`Jasn says 'You have focused the hate within you and discovered that hate and rage are not the same. Hate can be calculating and deceptive. For your service in defending the Kingdom of King Naythox Thex from the halfling invaders, I award you the disciple symbol of Innoruuk. Wear it with pride, _____.'

sections.heading: Regent Symbol of Innoruuk
sections.text:
You will need 2 Steel Bonings for this portion of the quest. Find a smith or make them yourself. I went from 0 smithing skill to having the bonings in about 15 minutes.

- I found all the supplies in Neriak underground at the Blind Fish.
- Get 2:1 Small Piece of Ore to water flasks. In the forge combine 2 ore and 1 flask until you have some metal bits.
- Next make a File using a File Mold, 1 Metal Bits, and 1 water flask in the forge.
- Lastly, combine the file, water flask, and a Small Brick of Ore (not stack-able) to make the steel boning. (You get the file back whether you fail or succeed.)

Get this lined up and ready to go before you start the next part of the quest.

Hail Ithvol K`Jasn and tell him 'I am a disciple of Innoruuk.'

He says 'I have an important task for a Disciple of Hate such as yourself. It is no secret that King Naythox Thex wishes to expand the Teir'Dal Empire to the continent of Feydwer. We have a camp established in the Lesser Faydark near the stronghold of the vampire lord Mayong Mistmoore. The camp is constantly under siege by the Feir'Dal and Koada'Dal and must rely on the support of Neriak for supplies necessary to the survival of the camp. Are you willing to serve your King and Empire by delivering the provisions?'

Tell him 'I will deliver the provisions.'

He will tell you 'The provisions are crated and prepared for shipment by Dran Slug Rembor. Go to his establishment in the Foreign Quarter and tell him Ithvol sent you. Make haste young Disciple of Hate, the fate of the Empire hangs on our support of the Faydark Camp.' Go the Neriak Foreign Quarter and tell Dran `slug` Rembor that 'Ithvol sent me.'

Dran is in Slugs Bar in area 5 on the map.

Dran will ask you for two steel bonings. After you give the bonings unstacked, he will hand you a crate and says 'Heres the crate of provisions. Take this to Dragoon Szorn in the Lesser Faydark immediately!

Travel to Lesser Faydark to the camp at (loc -900, 1155) and give the crate to Dragoon Szorn. He will hand you the Receipt for Provisions Crate and ask you to find the [missing shipment]. If you ask about it he will tell you to 'Seek out Ennixy and tell her [hate be my guide]. She typically works from her homeland in the Steamfont Mountains.'

Travel to Steamfont and talk to Ennixy Frennor (a gnome at 1350, -850). You say, 'Hate be my guide'

Ennixy will ask you to slay a paladin named Crusader Swiftmoon. When I talked to Ennixy, Crusader Swiftmoon (Spawns at 782, 2000 near Lesser Faydark zoneline and eventually walks to Ennixy and stops there) spawned right in front of me (although he can take 5-8 minutes to arrive, be patient). He is a level 28 Paladin. He has LoH and heals.

NOTE: anyone can spawn Swiftmoon. So you can log to a high level alt, say 'Hate be my guide' to Ennixy, and wait a few minutes for Swiftmoon, kill him, then log back to your cleric. You will get faction hits for Faydarks Champions, King Tearis Thex, and Soldiers of Tunare.

Travel back to Lesser Faydark and take the Missing Teir`Dal Crate back to Dragoon Szorn.

Dragoon Szorn says, 'What is this | The items of importance have been removed from the crate | This is most unfortunate. However, you have done well in your service to the Teir'Dal Empire. Take this voucher of services rendered under the command of Naythos. Then back to Ithvol along with the head of that slain Fier'Dal, the receipt for the provisions, and your disciple symbol of Innoruuk.'

He will give you a Voucher of Service to Naythox, experience, and 2-5pp.

Travel back to Neriak 3rd Gate and give to Ithvol K`Jasn: the Voucher of Service to Naythox , Swiftmoon's Head, the Receipt for Provisions Crate , and your Disciple Symbol of Innoruuk.

Ithvol K'Jasn says, 'Your devotion to the ideals of hatred and your service to our King Naythox Thex has proven your usefulness within these spires and within our great city. I award you the Regent Symbol of Innoruuk. Congratulations, Regent !'

Ithvol will then give you your Regent Symbol of Innoruuk and experience. You will get positive faction hits with Priests of Innoruuk and King Aythox Thex. You will get negative faction hits with Priests of Marr, Clerics of Tunare, Priests of Life, and Primordial Malice.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Renth McLanis may be found in McDaniels Smokes & Spirits at +370, -280 (he is a Warrior Guildmaster).

You say, 'Hail, Renth McLanis'

Renth McLanis says, 'Hail, _______! Have ye come to train? I train all warriors. All Wolves o' the North must be strong warriors and swift as well. Are ye a young wolf, then? If so, maybe ye can [assist Renth] with his wee problem, eh?'

You say, 'I will assist you.'

Renth McLanis says, 'I was ordered by Kylan O'Danos to personally escort a young warrior sent to fetch the remains of his cousin, Ivan McMannus. I forgot and spent me greater time testing out the fine spirits. Now I must find the courier and the remains. Will ye [search for the courier]?'

You say, 'I will search for the courier.'

Renth McLanis says, 'Thank ye, _______! Go to Everfrost Peaks and seek out Arnis McLish. Ask him where Megan, the courier, is. Once ye find Megan, would you ask her where Ivan's remains are? Please go, at once!'

Search for Arnis McLish in Everfrost Peaks near the entrance ramp to Blackburrow at -1595, -175. He will run eastward to the tree at -1090, -960, attacking monsters along the way.

You say, 'Hail, Arnis McLish'

Arnis McLish says, 'My word | I cannot believe how cold it is out here. I must keep running around just to keep warm.'

You say, 'Where is Megan?'

Arnis McLish says, 'I heard she got lost on the plains. You should ask her dog, Snowflake, where she is. I hear he is somewhere around the pass to Halas.'

Snowflake may be found at +2020, -1160, near Bryndin McMill and Lish McMarrin.

You say, 'Hail, Snowflake'

Snowflake says, 'Grrrrrr | '

You say, 'Where is Megan?'

Snowflake says, 'Ruff.. Ruff.. Woof..'

Follow Snowflake east until he stops at the pillars of the tower at (+2045, +3835). Regardless of whether Megan is there or not, he will slowly walk back to the tree by Bryndin McMill. You can make him return to Megan's tower during the return trip by asking asking him again "Where is Megan?"

Megan OReilly stands outside the tower to the right of the pillars at (+2060, -3870) and will frequently walk to the bank of the frozen river at (+2025, -4240). Wandering orcs will sometimes attack her, so you might have to wait for her.

You say, 'Hail, Megan OReilly'

Megan OReilly says, 'Brrrr.. It.. Is sooo.. c-cold | I never.. sh-should've j-joined.. the.. the W-wolves of the N-north | '

You say, 'Where are Ivan's remains?'

Megan OReilly says, 'You were sent to retrieve the remains? I am sorry, I lost them. It was not my fault! There was no escort as I was told. I got lost returning to Halas and ended up on a frozen river. The ice broke and the remains were scattered into the freezing water. Will you [dive for the remains]?'

You say, 'I will dive for the remains.'

Megan OReilly says, 'Thank the Tribunal | I would have, but I cannot swim. Take this chest. Fill it with the four pieces which fell below the surface. I know not what else lies within. When you fill the box and combine the items, return it to Renth. Good luck, _______.'

You receive a 4-slot Empty Box, which identifies as Box For Ivan's Remains.

Southeast of Megan's tower, there is a hole in the frozen river at +1375, -4585; grab an Enduring Breath from someone and go diving. Under the ice are various goblins ("goblin diver" and "ice goblin diver") who are KoS. Three of the pieces of the remains are ground spawns found on the river bottom and look like bags.

• Barbarian Femur: +1405, -4570, -190
• Barbarian Jaw: +1465, -4500, -230
• Barbarian Skull: +1580, -4485, -245

The final item, Barbarian Rib, is dropped by a "goblin diver". There are two spawns between the Femur, and the Skull, and one more spawn slightly north of the Skull. The monsters that can spawn in these spots are: ice goblin scout, ice goblin diver, and a rare goblin diver. Kill the placeholders until the goblin diver spawns and kill it for the final item, a Barbarian Rib.

Some tips to accomplish this:
• You don't actually need to have enduring breath. If you simply swim straight up, and continue to do so, after a couple seconds your breath will refill
• All of the ice goblins flee when at low health. Unless you have a swimming skill of 100, or a high level speed buff, you will never catch them. Instead, fight them on the surface of the ice and you will not regret it

Combine the four items in the box to craft a Box of Remains . Head back to Halas and give Renth the Box of Remains.

Renth McLanis says, 'Good work | Kylan will never know o' me negligence. I owe ye one, young warrior. Let's call it even with this. Twas found by one of our foraging parties. It is still useful. And... I believe ye can assist with a more [dangerous matter] as well.'

• Your faction standing with Wolves of the North got better.
• Your faction standing with Shamen of Justice got better.
• Your faction standing with Merchants of Halas got better.
• Your faction standing with Steel Warriors got better.

You gain experience.

You receive 1 copper from Renth McLanis.

You receive a random minor item.

The more "dangerous matter" is the quest for the Langseax.

sections.heading: Bar of Ronium
sections.text:
Obtain the Sol Cauldron from Lord Searfire, the Dwarven smith, in The Temple of Solusek Ro. This container is used for the combine to make A Bar of Ronium. He must consider you Amiably before he will deal with you. To raise faction with him, you can either hunt Shadowed Men or you can give gold, 30gp at a time, to Rathmana Allin in the Southern Desert of Ro until he cons Amiable to you (see the quest Rathmana's Traveling Offer). Once your faction is high enough, return to the Temple of Solusek Ro and hail Lord Searfire and then say "What Ronium" and then he will give you the sol cauldron, and then he will tell you the ingredients that you must acquire to make the metal ronium.

The ingredients to make the Bar of Ronium are the following:
Melatite (Dropped by various CWG Model Clockworks in Solusek's Eye). Sometimes you can buy this from merchants in and around Solusek's Eye (Sol A) because many players sell them there. This will prevent you from taking any negative faction hits with Ak'Anon.
Two Enchanted Platinum Bars. Enchanters level 34 and higher can enchant Platinum Bars using the spell Enchant Platinum.
One Mistmoore Granite (found on flouting gargoyles, jeering gargoyles, and leering gargoyles in Castle Mistmoore). The granite is an uncommon drop from the Gargoyles outside of the castle, but is more common on the Gargoyles inside of the castle. Also note that you will need another Mistmoore Granite to turn in to Leaf Falldim with your Bar of Ronium, so make sure to get two of them before leaving.
One Sands of Ro (from various Sand Giants in the Northern/Southern Deserts of Ro or the Oasis of Marr)
One Soil of Underfoot (from the Priestess Ghalea in the North Kaladim Cleric's guild for four Fairy Dusts). You need at least Kindly faction for this, you can raise your faction with Priestess Ghalea by turning in skeleton bones to Gunlok Jure in the North Kaladim Paladin's guild (see the quest Bone Chips Kaladim). Also, try not to kill faeries because you will need good faction with them later to complete the Epic quest to Enchant your Trueshot longbow into the Raincaller. It is advised to buying the Fairy Dust or use an alt/ask another player to kill the fairies.

Once all of the above ingredients have been obtained, place them in the Sol Cauldron and hit the combine button and you will receive one Bar of Ronium. You do not need any blacksmithing skill to combine these.

You will find that while wielding the crook, Tunare grants you a boon of strength and the power to smite enemies who would otherwise be impervious to physical attacks.'
