sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
Chardok
Quest Giver:
Herald Telcha
Minimum Level:
51
Classes:
All
Related Zones:
Temple of Droga, Frontier Mountains, Warsliks Woods
Related NPCs:
A Sarnak Spy, Warlord Skargus, a goblin traitor, a shady goblin, an angry goblin

sections.heading: Checklist
sections.text:
• Obtain Di'Zok Signet of Service (warmly faction)
• Give a goblin traitor your Signet ring (to receive quest text)
• Speak to the Traitor to receive Traitor's note
• Give Traitor's note to a sarnak spy (to receive quest text)
• Speak to the Spy to receive Forged Note to Courier
• Loot Drogan Warlord's Insignia from various Drogan goblins
• Give a shady goblin a Forged Note along with Drogan Insignia (to receive a Report to Skargus)
• Give an angry goblin the Report to spawn Warlord Skargus
• Loot Head of Skargus from the corpse of Skargus
• Obtain Ally faction with Di`Zok
• Once allied, Give Herald Telcha your Signet ring and Skargus's head to receive Regal Band of Bathezid

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
NOTE: You will need to obtain the Di'Zok Signet of Service (ring #1) before proceeding with this quest.

Talk to a goblin traitor (2-3 hour spawn) in the Temple of Droga on the northwest wall of the dining room, /location:(0, -115).

You say, 'Hail, a goblin traitor'

(He is on Di'Zok faction so he is a good way to test your faction standing.)

a goblin traitor says 'Serve the Sarnak do ya? You the one they say they send? I don't know that I believe ya, show a token. Humm show me ya ring if ya got it. '

You give a goblin traitor your Di`Zok Signet of Service. He hands it right back to you.

a goblin traitor looks relieved when he sees your signet of service and eyes you with a bit more respect. 'Good! They tell'd me to wait here for ya, can't say I like it but here I sits. Itbe good to be rid of Skargus though, so I be a happy one, oh yes. Want to know the [plan] then?'

You say, 'What's the plan?'

a goblin traitor says 'Alrighty, listen listen. Skargus used to be a low rankin' nogood. He made fake story 'bout Gragbar who was the warlord and caused him much trouble with the chief. Gragbar was cast down, chief made Skargus the warlord now. Gragbar is very angry, would take back his position and kill Skargus if he get [evidence] of his treachery. '

You say, 'What evidence?'

a goblin traitor makes a terrible face, then spits on the ground before continuing. Gragbar are workin' with the Iksar, bleh Iksar. He sellin' goblin troopsas slaves to Cabilis when he can, sayin' they died in battle at the lake. If we get evidence of that, we get Skargus and kill him. You go to Frontier mountains, find Sarnak there, he knows where we get evidence from. Give him this note from me, and he help ya. Off with ya now, before I get seen with ya.'

You receive Traitor's note.

Take this note to a sarnak spy in Frontier Mountains at 1880, 3600.

a sarnak spy reads the note slowly, turning it around in his claws a few times before completing it. I see you spoke with that half-wit goblin! I hate hate hate it when he sends me a note, his penmanship is almost illegible. I hope he informed you of the situation, he's really not the most dependable agent of Di'zok, and sadly his note doesn't really make much sense. No matter though, are you ready to [proceed] in this mission?

You say, 'I am ready to proceed'

a sarnak spy says 'Good, here then is what you must do. It's pretty simple actually and even one such as you should have no troubles. Skargus has been trading in slaves with the Iksar. He has a courier there, visits the outskirts of Cabilis and sends weekly reports back to Droga. If we could get that report, Skargus would be finished. Will you go to Cabilis and [get the report]? '

You say, 'I will get the report'

a sarnak spy scowls at you, clearly unimpressed by your efforts.Of course you'll go get the report fool, but do you think that the courier will just give it to you? The sarnak shakes his head sadly. Okay, look. Go into Droga and try to get a warlord's insignia off one of the goblins in there. Take this forged note to the courier I've written out, along with the insignia to Warslik's woods and give it to the courier. With luck, he'll believe you work for Skargus and give you the report. If you get the report, find Gragbar and give it to him .

You receive Forged Note to Courier.

Take this forged note to a shady goblin (24 hour spawn) in Warsilik Woods near Cabilis at -1650, -1135 on the 2nd floor, along with a Drogan Warlord's Insignia (random drop in Nurga and Droga).

You say, 'Hail, a shady goblin'

a shady goblin says 'If yer not my contact ya best be movin' on. Got no time to waste on ya. '

You say, 'I am your contact'

a shady goblin says 'Are ya? Hum, let me see yer insignia then, and the note Skargus gave ya. '

Give a shady goblin the forged note and a Drogan Warlord's Insignia.

a shady goblin gapes at the note in puzzlement, obviously a bit concerned by it. The courier looks at the note for more than a minute, then looks at you, and back at the note. Errm.. welp, dunno what to make of the note. If I know the right of it, Skargus finally got him some girly to do his writin' for him. Ooooh I bet she a tasty one, graarr. If I was warlord I know I'd have me a girly too. Gah, take this report and get outta my sight.

He despawns and give you the Report to Skargus. Take this report to an angry goblin (3 day spawn with a 10% variance) in the Temple of Droga (location 150, 1950).

You say, 'Hail, an angry goblin'

an angry goblin 'Go away, my life is miserable enough!' The angry goblin looks at you more closely, his rage fading for a moment. 'Are you here with the evidence I was promised? Give it to me if you have it | '

Hand in the Report to Skargus to angry goblin

an angry goblin howls in triumph! 'This is just what I needed! Skargus is mine now, wait until he finds out, just wait! His death is close at hand. Follow me and I'll take you to Skargus's chamber, you can wait there while I take this report to the chief!'

an angry goblin shouts 'I have you now Skargus, you traitor! Even now I'm taking this report of slave-trading to the chief! Your days here are at an end!'

an angry goblin walks up to the dining room, and then to a smaller room north...

Warlord Skargus says 'I've gotta stop Gragbar before he turns in that report!'

This spawns Warlord Skargus (level 56 SK with a 561 HT). Kill Skargus and loot the Head of Skargus.

Take ring #1 and the head of Skargus back to Herald Telcha in Chardok.

Faction needed is ally to do final turn-in?[https://web.archive.org/web/20030216222355/http://www.how.to/chardok/]

Herald Telcha says 'Ah hah! You are notworthy indeed amongst the servants of the Sarnak! Perhaps I should have you killed, before your deeds outdo mine.. Hmm.. Guards! Guards! Haha, do not panic menial being, in fact I am most impressed with your service. Here is the ring I promised you in exchange for your efforts.'

You receive the second ring: Regal Band of Bathezid.

The effect on the ring, Aegis of Bathezid, is a 25dmg Damage Shield, and lasts 25 minutes.

The ring comes with 5 charges and is rechargable by giving it back to Herald Telcha as long as you keep your faction at ally.

Note: This quest continues further to obtain the final item, see Spirit Wracked Cord Quest.

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
Kael Drakkel
Quest Giver:
Staff Sergeant Drioc
Minimum Level:
45
Classes:
All
Related Zones:

sections.heading: Checklist
sections.text:
The length of time needed to complete this quest depends on your accessibility to the Tower of Frozen Shadow. You will need the sixth
floor key to complete this quest.

Quest requires a minimum of Indifferent faction. This quest can be completed at KOS faction by having an Enchanter charm Noble Helssen with Dictate.

Quest can be MQ'd by having one person turn in the Ancient Rusted Key and one person turn in the Arcanum of Rosh.

Part One

OPTIONAL: Give 2x Panther Meat, 1x Raptor Meat and 1x Tar Goo Strands to Lieutenant Krofer.

OPTIONAL: Kill a Sifaye Messenger and give report to Lieutenant Krofer. Receive Velium Studded Cloak

START HERE: Tell Lieutenant Krofer "I am prepared". Krofer hands you Krofer's Requisition.

Give Krofer's Requisition to Staff Sergeant Drioc in the Kael Drakkel bank and receive Signed Requisition.

Return to Lieutenant Krofer and give him the Signed Requisition to spawn 4 giants at WL/Kael zoneline and receive Mission Report.

OPTIONAL: Follow squad of giants to Sifaye village and command them to "troop attack".

Return the Mission Report to Lieutenant Krofer for the Report of Failure. This can be done anytime; the attack does not need to complete.

Give the Report of Failure to Staff Sergeant Drioc and he will return it to you.

Next give the Report of Failure to Noble Helssen, he will hand you an Inscribed Velium Tablet. Receive Enchanted Velium Mask

Part Two

Speak with Corudoth - a turtle in Ice Clad Ocean - hand Corudoth the Inscribed Velium Tablet from Noble Helssen and receive a Lock of Dwarven Hair.

Spawn a Lucid Spirit of Abrams by killing Incoherent Spirit (with a Capital I) on floor 6A of Tower of Frozen Shadow.

Hand Lucid Spirit of Abrams the Lock of Dwarven Hair to receive the Arcanum of Rosh (you have limited time before he despawns).

Kill Petcas Coldbeard in Thurgadin and loot an Ancient Rusted Key

Take Arcanum of Rosh and the Ancient Rusted Key to Noble Helssen for a voucher.

Give voucher to Kellek Felhammer. Receive Collar of the Storm OR

Give voucher to Wenglawks Kkeak. Receive Girdle of Reflection OR

Give voucher to Noble Helssen. Receive Helssen's Prismatic Trinket

sections.heading: Part One - Wakening Land and Kael Drakkal
sections.text:
You say, 'Hail, Staff Sergeant Drioc'

Staff Sergeant Drioc glances over at you with a sneer and says, 'I have much to do and organize. If you have anything of importance to say you had best speak up now or leave before I lose my patience.'

You say, 'I am looking for work.'

Staff Sergeant Drioc stops looking over his papers and takes a moment to size you up. You fight the urge to run in fear as the collosal humanoid considers you. After a moment he says, 'Very well. Our campaign to conquer the so called Tunarean Court has need of reinforcements. The Kromrif are already spread to thinly in the Eastern Wastes so mercenaries will have to do. Take these orders to the commanding officer in the field and follow his orders. Payment will be discussed after you complete your assignment.'

Receive a Mercenary Assingment . Bring this to Lieutenant Krofer, who can be found outside the city gates in the Wakening Land.

You say, 'Hail Lieutenant Krofer.'

Lieutenant Krofer says, Unless you are the new mercenary reinforcements I suggest you remove yourself from my presence before I decorate the bottom of my boot with your intestines.'

Upon handing the Mercenary Assingment to Lieutenant Krofer, he says:

Lieutenant Krofer says, 'Drioc sent you? I suppose one cannot expect much from a mercenary. Well then, (player name), your first assignment will be to clear out some of this forest's annoying populace. Bring me the meat of one of the raptors, the meat of two panthers, and the remains of one of those living puddles of black sludge found in the caves. You will then have your payment.

Bring him two panther meat, one raptor meat and one Tar goo Strands. Return these to him for some coin and faction.

Lieutenant Krofer says, 'Well, I suppose you may be worth something more than fodder after all. Here is your payment. Speak to me again when you are ready for your next assignment. For now, get some rest, you will need it.'

• Your faction standing with Kromrif got better.
• Your faction standing with Kromzek got better.
• Your faction standing with King Tormax got better.
• Your faction standing with Claws of Veeshan got worse.

You receive 10 platinum, 2 gold, 1 copper pieces.

You gain experience.

sections.heading: A Sifaye Messenger
sections.text:
You say, 'I'm ready for my next assignment.'

Lieutenant Krofer says, 'Well, ready or not, this must be done now. Out there in the forest are our enemies. For us to be successful, we must know what they are doing and how they are going about it. Our probing attacks have revealed little so we've decided to send you out to gather any info you can. There must be some sort of messenger out there, bring any info you might find.'

He will then need you to catch a messenger roaming the Wakening lands and return proof of its death. This is a Sifaye Messenger, which roams between along the north and northwest region of the forest.

Upon killing the Sifaye Messenger

• Your faction standing with Tunarean Court got worse.

You gain experience.

Loot the note and return it to Lieutenant Krofer and receive a Velium Studded Cloak.

Lieutenant Krofer says, 'Excellent, (Player Name). With this we can plan an attack that might actually accomplish something. Here is your payment. You have also earned this cloak, it should help protect you from the clawing undergrowth of this savage land. Your next mission will be more complex and dangerous, however we may be able to spare a laborer or two to assist you. Rest now, and tell me when you are prepared.'

• Your faction standing with Kromrif got better.
• Your faction standing with Kromzek got better.
• Your faction standing with King Tormax got better.
• Your faction standing with Claws of Veeshan got worse.

You gain experience.

Tell Lieutenant Krofer that you are prepared and receive a requisition to take to Staff Sergeant Drioc in Kael.

sections.heading: Attack on the Sifaye village (You can start the quest here)
sections.text:
Lieutenant Krofer can be found in Wakening Land. Sometimes he paths around but he's usually at the laborer camp at (-700, -4300) just outside Kael Drakkel.

You say, 'I am prepared'.

Lieutenant Krofer says, 'Very well. We've decided to attack the small Sifaye village northeast of here and I want you to coordinate the attack. I will send you into Kael Drakkel with a request for troop assistance. After the squad is assembled you will lead them to the staging point where you will oversee the battle. Here is the request. Take it to Drioc in the city and return here with the troops.

You are given Krofer's Requisition.

Safest way to do this if KOS:

Nothing in the area sees invis but there's a few mobs that could easily ruin your day. The main one is Captain Bvellos which paths from
king tormax to arena, stopping at bank for a few minutes right next to Staff Sergeant Drioc. Ideally you'll wait for him at bank and start
your business when he leaves. First, cast wake of tranquility on the watchman guarding the left door where drioc is. The longer timer will
give you enough time to work (05/28/2025: calm is 3mins, pacify 3.5mins, WoT 7mins). Invis, run inside bank and target Lieutenant Vellos.
Run out and run up the ramp toward EW and almost at the top you'll see a nook in the wall (-138, +1238). Gnome illusion and look through wall,
you'll see your targets and you'll be in range for lulling. The giants in the area, even the green cons, have a fair bit of MR so they'll
resist you a couple times. By looking through the wall you'll see if you get a crit resist and that will give you enough time to gate.
Calm Vellos. Then "/target watchman" and calm him too. Once that's done invis again and run down the ramp, open the door and target Drioc.
Back out, open up inventory and put the quest item on your cursor. Dictate drioc and he'll come to you. So will Pollos Stormkeeper from the
other side of the room but ignore him. You'll have about just a bit more than enough time to quickly do the turn in with Drioc. The moment
Pollos hits you, Drioc will engage and keep him busy. Now is your time to back off and gate.

Give Krofer's Requisition to Staff Sergeant Drioc in Kael Drakkel, inside the bank.

Staff Sergeant Drioc takes the note and begins reading. Seeing a certain passage, he squints and rereads, his brow furrowed. He glances over at you and says, 'Very well. I will assign you a squad lead by Corporal Hlash. They will rendezvous with you out in the field. Oh, and take this back to Krofer.

You gain experience.

You receive the Signed Requisition.

Note: Turning in the Signed Requisition to Krofer, will spawn 4 level 50+ giants INSIDE the Kael/WL tunnel, which path to the laborer camp.
Ensure there are no faction groups in the tunnel and advise the zone you are spawning them.

Return to Lieutenant Krofer in Wakening Land. Give him the Signed Requisition.

Lieutenant Krofer takes the note and looks it over, then sighs and says, 'This will have to be enough. The squad should be here shortly. When they arrive you will march with them to the staging area near the village of those insect Sifaye. When you are satisfied with the formation, give the corporal the order to attack and observe the battle. After the village is destroyed return this report to me and we'll plan our next move.

You gain experience.

You receive the Mission Report. Despite the narrative of the quest, you do not need to follow the squad. Despite some reports otherwise, giving Krofer the report back immediately, i.e. before the script finishes or the squad depops, may result in you having to restart the quest.

Lieutenant Krofer says, 'Failure! Incompetence! The whole squad annihilated! I knew this would happen if left in the hands of a worthless mercenary! Well, you can take this report back to Drioc then. Now get out of my sight, mercenary.'

You receive the Report of Failure and Krofer immediately despawns. Return to Drioc in Kael.

The following dialogue is optional, if you choose to follow the squad for the sake of completing the story.

Follow them to the northeast camp of Sifaye (+1762, -285) and wait for the Corporal to say his squad is ready.

Upon reaching the village, Corporal Hlash will say, 'Hold here Squad.'

Say "Troop Attack" and they will charge the Sifaye Village. Four Sylvan Guardians and multiple invisible A Phase Puma will spawn and defend the Sifaye camp.

Corporal Hlash says, 'Destroy them!'

Suddenly, all around the Sifaye Village, several beings phase into reality. Their eyes glow with the golden light of divinity, obviously sent from a higher plane of existence. The Kromzek assault squad is surely doomed. You decide to withdraw and report what you have found, perhaps the Lieutenant will understand.

Berzerker Voldak says, 'Lieutenant! Look! Where did they come from?! We're d... AARRGH!'

Corporal Hlash says, 'Grraaaggh! Ambush! Die well!'

Your troops will not survive. Return to Krofer with the mission report and he will send you inside to see Drioc again.

Lieutenant Krofer says, 'Failure! Incompetence! The whole squad annihilated! I knew this would happen if left in the hands of a worthless mercenary! Well, you can take this report back to Drioc then. Now get out of my sight, mercenary.'

Return to the bank in Kael Drakkel. Give the Report of Failure to to Staff Sergeant Drioc.

Staff Sergeant Drioc reads over the report, his face begins to turn red with anger. Drioc shouts, 'How can this be?! I sent you a squad of some of our best trained men and you had them destroyed | This was supposed to be a routine raid and you return in FAILURE | I would crush you under my boot right now if I wasn't so angry but I think I'll send you to my finacier (sic). YOU can explain what happened and why his investments have been lost. Now take your carcass out of here!

Drioc gives you back the Report of Failure. The financier he mentions is Noble Helssen, who stands next to Wenglawks Kkeak in the nobles house nearby, just opposite of the bank.

Note: Wenglawk's will not assist Noble Helssen or aggro you despite being right beside him, a KOS 60 Enchanter can invis into the
room, stand in the corner, cast Dictate on him, do the turn in, and gate out

Give the Report of Failure to Noble Helssen.

Noble Helssen takes the report from you and places it in a pocket without even glancing at it. He says, 'Do not worry, (player name). I know of the planar creatures who eliminated my troops. The fault is not yours but of that fool Drioc. The Savage land is not just a simple forest as these idiots in the field believe. It is a cradle of life and the forces that drive it. Within that forest is a nexus, a gateway to another plane of existence, The Plane of Growth.'

• Your faction standing with Kromrif got better.
• Your faction standing with Kromzek got better.
• Your faction standing with King Tormax got better.
• Your faction standing with Claws of Veeshan got worse.

You gain experience.

You receive an Inscribed Velium Tablet and the Enchanted Velium Mask as a side reward.

You say, 'What plane of existence?'

Noble Helssen says, 'Our soldiers fell victim to the denizens of that plane and unless we can find some way to stop this from happening, the land of Wakening will never be under our control. Many have suggested just destroying the Nexus but they are short-sighted fools. My vision is not only to control the resources that forest provides, but also to control the very force of Growth itself! You will help me do this, mercenary.'

You say, 'How can I help you?'

Noble Helssen says, 'The tablet I have given you is inscribed with runes of binding. I am owed a favor and it has come time to use it. Their is a venerable sea turtle that lives along the warmer part of the coast, there the ice floes begin to break up. His name is Corudoth. Find him and speak with him. Remind him of his obligation to me and if he is not forthcoming in his answer, tell him he owes me. Then show him the tablet. He will tell you what to do. He will most likely be beneath the ocean. The mask I gave you should help.'

Seek out a turtle by the name of Corudoth in Iceclad Ocean. He can be found under a chunk of ice at approximately (-5718, 5931).

sections.heading: Part Two - Ice Clad Ocean, Thurgadin and Tower of Frozen Shadow
sections.text:
You say, 'Hail Corudoth'

Corudoth seems to completely ignore you. After close examination you begin to wonder if this creature is actually alive.

Tell Corudoth "You owe Helssen", he will deny owing Helssen anything.

You say, 'You owe Helssen, help me with his plans.'
Corudoth says, 'What?! I owe him nothing.! Nothing at all! I didn't ask him to.., err. What proof do you have? How do I know he sent you? Bah, leave me, (Player Race).'

Handing Corudoth the Inscribed Velium Tablet, in return he will give you Lock of Dwarven Hair

Corudoth curses and goes into a fit of frustration before finally giving in. The ancient sea turtle finally says, 'Fine. I dont know what Helssen wants with that but I know where you can find it. Years and years back I traveled with what was called the Icy Mugs. We were a mercenary company out for fun and profit, and there was plenty of that. During our adventures we ran across a great many foes.'

You gain experience.

You say, 'What great foes?'

Corudoth says 'Yes. One of note was the vile and evil sorcerer Rosh. A better example of depravity and anti-morality I cannot think of. He researched magics destined to end all life on this cold chunk of rock and snow. We made it our mission to destroy him. In the end we defeated him, but alas our friend and comrade was slain. Poor Abrams was left cursed forever to wander that spire of ultimate loathing, the Tower of Frozen Shadow.'

You say, 'Who is Abrams?'

Corudoth says 'Abrams was a brave warrior and a good friend. His great maul could always be counted on to strike true as he used his body to shield others from greivous wounds. He sacrificed himself to save us from the eternal suffering he now endures up in that dark tower. The book you now seek, is in his possesion. You must first destroy his tormented form to free him from his madness. Tell him you seek the Arcanum and then give him the lock of hair I just gave you. You also will need the key.'

You say, 'What key?'

Corudoth says 'We ambushed Rosh on an expedition into the cursed Tower. When we faced him, Abrams ran forward and grabbed the Arcanum. He held it to his chest as lightning and flame rained down upon him. With Rosh busy trying to save his book it gave Petcas and I enough time to strike Rosh down. We went to Abrams and found our friend left a smoking pile of Coldain ruin. He underwent a strange transformation in which the Arcanum was lost. We decided Petcas should keep the key.'

You say, 'Who is Petcas?'

Corudoth says 'Petcas has retired from the life of an adventurer as I have. I would not tell you where he is as he is a good friend, but what I owe Helssen is stronger than comraderie or even friendship so I must comply; it is the word of Veeshan. Petcas now owns a small bar in the Coldain city of Thurgadin. To get the key you must fight your way into the city and kill Petcas. I wish you a most horrendous death Dark Elf. Now leave me to my sleep.'

sections.heading: Petcas Coldbeard
sections.text:
Petcas Coldbeard can be found in The Icy Mug just to the right of the Thurgadin zone when facing out from Icewell Keep. He drops an ancient rusted key, and will lower your Dain Frostreaver IV and Coldain faction. He is somewhat of an undercon and is surrounded by other NPCs that will social aggro and would appear to be of similar level range.

Note: As a 60 Enchanter I was unable to Calm all but one of the dwarves in the room with Petcas despite 10+ attempts, it's possible they
are immune to magic. I ended up engaging him with just Charm to pull him out of the building and to the Icewell Keep zoneline. He will
call for help, 2 of the dwarves will despawn, but the rest of the dwarves wont despawn and may assist if not using Charm

sections.heading: Lucid Spirit of Abrams
sections.text:
Abram's ghost can be found on the floor 6A of theTower of Frozen Shadow. His ghost goes by the name of Incoherent Spirit. The placeholder for Incoherent Spirit is called incoherent spirit with a lower case 'i'. There is only one spawn and the respawn time is 54 minutes. Killing the Incoherent Spirit will spawn Lucid Spirit of Abrams.

Hand him Lock of Dwarven Hair and he will hand you the Arcanum of Rosh. (You have a limited time before the lucid version despawns. The lucid spirit of adams will despawn after 7 minutes.)

Return the Arcanum of Rosh and the Ancient Rusted Key to Noble Helssen and he will give you a voucher.
There are three rewards here and it is your choice which path to take. This turn-in IS MQable

Noble Helssen says "Ahhh, you surprise me mercenary. You have found the book as well as the key to open it. I must begin my research as soon as possible. But first, your reward. With this voucher, you can receive 1 of the three treasures I will offer you. If given to Kellek, you will receive an item worthy of a hearty and rugged combatant. If given go Wenglawks you will acquire an item to be worn by only the most pious. And if given to me I will give you a sorcerous trinket of my own design. **READ THIS LINE CAREFULLY**

• Your faction standing with Kromrif got better.
• Your faction standing with Kromzek got better.
• Your faction standing with King Tormax got better.
• Your faction standing with Claws of Veeshan got worse.

You gain experience.

Give the voucher to Kellek Felhammer for Collar of the Storm. He also gives you the Noble's Seal. The seal has no known use and may be destroyed.

Give the voucher to Wenglawks Kkeak for Girdle of Reflection.

Give the voucher to Noble Helssen for Helssen's Prismatic Trinket.

Kellek Felhammer says, 'So you are the mercenary I have been hearing about! Not what I expected. Anyways, here is your reward. Carry it well. Also, this noble's seal will prove your loyalty to anyone who is skeptical.'

• Your faction standing with Kromrif got better.
• Your faction standing with Kromzek got better.
• Your faction standing with Coldain got worse.
• Your faction standing with Claws of Veeshan got worse.

You gain experience.

Noble Helssen says, 'Excellent choice, Gnome. Competence and a sense of style. When we are ready to take the Wakening I will most definitely welcome your participation. Here is your reward.'

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, 'Hail, Keeper Pain'

Keeper Pain raises his gaze from his tomes to greet you. 'Ahh | Welcome, seeker of knowledge! Come to fill your brain, have you? Look closer, adventurer. I have scribed some very powerful spells.'

You say, 'What about the Wand of Pain?'

Keeper Pain drops his tome and monocle and looks at you sharply. 'What? | Have you seen Revenant Vytrix? I let him borrow my wand for a quest. That was half a season ago | I fear he is dust and my precious wand is lost.'

Hand in Wand of Pain from a coerced revenant in Dalnir, a.k.a. Revenant Vytrix. (A small note identifies him as such.)

Keeper Pain begins jumping for joy. 'Yoohoo | My wand | Thank you. You must be some powerful adventurer. You can help me collect a few components. Fill this chest with a frost crystal, a cockatrice egg, a giant hornet egg and a plains pebble. Return the full chest to me and I shall offer you a spell I recently researched.'

• Your faction standing with Brood of Kotiz got better.
• Your faction standing with Legion of Cabilis got better.

You receive 4 gold from Keeper Pain.

You receive a Component Chest , a combinable container with four small slots.

Forage the following (all are tradeable):

• Frost Crystal - the Dreadlands
• Plains Pebble - any of the Plains of Karana
• Cockatrice Egg - The Overthere
• Giant Hornet Egg - the Burning Woods

Combine the four items in the chest to get the Full Components Chest . Hand this in to Keeper Pain.

• Your faction standing with Brood of Kotiz got better.
• Your faction standing with Legion of Cabilis got better.

You receive Spell: Renew Bones.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, 'Hail, Lendiniara the Keeper'

Lendiniara the Keeper says 'Greetings Ayama . I am the keeper of relics. If you are brave I have tasks to test your might and perhaps rewards.

You say, 'What rewards?'

Lendiniara the Keeper says 'One should ask of the tasks before worrying about rewards, Dark Elf.'

You say, 'What tasks?'

Lendiniara the Keeper says 'Enter into the halls of testing to complete these tasks. Seek out the ancient ones inside and see if your might is as great as theirs and fear not, those who you slay will be returned to the temple by the gift of Veeshan's great power. I have three tasks, which any may complete, as well as a request of both the arcane and the strong.

You say, 'What request of the arcane?'

Lendiniara the Keeper says 'Those who seek knowledge, will seek this task out for its reward is great. Three tears and a glowing orb will garner one an ancient mask. The White Tear and the Black Tear for balance the Runed Tear to hold the balance and a glowing orb(Glowing Drake Orb) to return raw energy to the ancient mask.'

Be careful turning in lightstones to this NPC or vendoring items at lower levels there are aggressive NPC everything from lower level wolves, to higher level griffawns, that would pose a challenge to any new adventurer that path through the area that will attack.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Faction Note: Dubious will eat your lightstone(s). Suspect apprehensive and above is required. This rules out Iksars from being able to turn in unless using faction tricks like sneak or wolf form.

This quest begins with Mrysila at location -671, -170 in North Karana.

You say, 'Hail, Mrysila'

Mrysila says 'I am Mrysila, custodian of the [Concordance of Research].'

You say, 'What Concordance of Research?'

Mrysila says 'The 'Concordance of Research' is an aid to those who follow the path of academia. It, and its sister books, 'Runes and Research,' volumes I and II, help those who are [interested] in researching spells.'

You say, 'I am interested'

Mrysila says 'I have several copies of each book. If you want a copy of 'Runes and Research', volume I or II, bring me a lightstone and I will give you whichever book I have more of at the moment. Bring me a greater lightstone, and I will give you a copy of the 'Concordance of Research.'

Lightstones are a common drop from willowisps.

Upon handing in a Lightstone:

Mrysila says 'A lightstone? Thank you very much. Here is a copy of 'Runes and Research.

Upon handing in a Greater Lightstone:

Mrysila says 'A greater lightstone? Thank you very much. Here is a 'Concordance of Research' for you.'

WARNING! Agnostic dwarf rogue con's dubious and Mrysila will not give a reward for hand-ins.

Talk to Armorer Dellin in West Freeport's Militia House. Location: -84, -123, 3 (upstairs).

You say, 'Hail, Armorer Dellin'

Armorer Dellin says, 'Hail | If you be a new reserve member show me your militia armory token. If you are not yet initiated, I suggest you head to the toll gate in the Commonlands and speak with Guard Valon.'

The Militia Armory Token he speaks of is a reward for completing the Cutthroat Insignia quest from Guard Valon in the Commonlands.

You must have at least amiable faction with the Freeport Militia before Dellin will accept this item.

Armorer Dellin says, 'Welcome to the Freeport Militia. As a reserve member we require you to wear this tunic and fight whomever, whenever, and wherever Sir Lucan commands, no questions asked | There is no turning back | Remember to keep clear of North Freeport. You have made a wise decision. Hail Sir Lucan | '

sections.heading: Summary

Give Ostorm (+430, -80, +35) a Ruby

All specialization skills will be reset to 49

(Optional) Give Ostorm a 50 gold (has no effect on specializations, but gives Temple Of Sol Ro faction

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Ostorm can be found in the east upper hallway in the Temple of Solusek Ro, at +430, -80, +35, through the door behind the throne along the corridor to the right.

You say, 'Hail, Ostorm'

Ostorm says 'I am Ostorm of the Temple of Solusek Ro, guardian of the sacred crystal of Kintaz. Be wary and keep your distance, lest the proximity of the crystal [steal] your [memories].'

You say, 'Steal my memories?'

Ostorm says 'It is the nature of the crystal of Kintaz to steal the memories of those around it. Only I am safe, and then only because of the strong wardings placed on me by Solusek Ro himself. Are you interested in [losing] any [memories]?'

You say, 'Losing my memories?'

Ostorm says 'Recently, I have been experimenting with the crystal, and have found that those exposed to ruby light filtered through it tend to lose the memories of their most specialized arcane skills. Are you sure you want to [lose advanced memory] of specialization?'

You say, 'Lose advanced memory?'

Ostorm says 'Be warned that once exposed to the crystal, I can not reverse the effects. If you desire exposure, fetch me a ruby.'

Give him a Ruby.

Ostorm ..hear me? Ah, you seem to be coming out of your stupor. I think you have been exposed to the crystal long enough. By the time you leave the temple, your memories should have faded. Do you have the [fifty gold] coins that you owe me?

• Your faction standing with Temple Of Sol Ro got better.
• Your faction standing with Shadowed Men got worse.

Your specialize skills have all been set to 49.
You gain experience |

Note: The following portion of the quest is schmuck bait. Your specializations were reset after simply turning in the ruby, but you can give him the gold for faction.

You say, 'What fifty gold?'

Ostorm says 'You do not remember? You promised me fifty gold coins for allowing you to be exposed to the sacred crystal of Kintaz.'

Give him 50 gold.

Ostorm says 'Thank you.'

• Your faction standing with Temple Of Sol Ro got better.
• Your faction standing with Shadowed Men got worse.

Remember, only one specialization skill can exceed 50. Make sure the one that hits 50 next is the one you really want.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Just to the south of the Kejekan Village in a small grassy area with two trees spawns a spirit (470, -39). This spirit is a level 1 shadow knight type creature that is factioned with the Heretics of Paineel.

You say, 'Hail, a spirit'

a spirit flares brightly as you attempt to speak with it. By listening very closely you're barely able to make out it's frantic whispering. It keeps referring to one of the Kejekans, one that apparently slew him as he attempted to cleanse the land of them. It wants nothing more than to destroy who killed him, but it cannot in this [form].

You say, 'What form?'

a spirit flares brightly again as it explains there isn't enough time for it to explain. It then begins to whisper again, telling you that it commands you to aid it in it's revenge. You make out, through the barely audible whispering, that if you do help it, you will be rewarded.

You say, 'I will help you get revenge'

a spirit whispers that he will need to become whole again before he can defeat the fool animal that slew him. The spirit admits to one mistake before coming here to wipe the Kejekans. In an earlier campaign, he lost a very powerful weapon. That weapon would enable him to take on a form likened to his former self. If you return this weapon to the spirit, and then help him to defeat his enemy, the reward will be yours.

You say, 'What earlier campaign?'

a spirit seems hesitant to go into details and reacts harshly when asked further. He does say that he went to enlist an army of lesser beings to do it's bidding, but they refused. The spirit scoffs and says they believed the lord they shared favored them more than it. It goes on, explaining their utter foolishness and eventual demise in great detail.

Go to the Temple of Cazic Thule and slay a lizard ritualist that spawns on the small pyramid in the maze. Loot from him the Grimy Lance. .

Return to Stonebrunt and give the Grimy Lance to a spirit.

a spirit says, 'Yes, the lance!' and begins to glow as it draws power from the lance, which now floats in mid air next to the spirit. The form of the spirit expands and takes on a humanoid shape. The air itself then seems to condense about the spirit as bits of matter appear within the glowing form. The bits soon take the shape of bones and ropes of muscle. Within minutes, an emaciated Erudite male stands before you. Despite his frail appearance, he stands upright and strong, a fierce red light burning in his eyes.'

You gain experience.

You receive an Idol of Fear.

Ridossan the Unliving gazes upon his lance and begins to laugh maniacally. He says, 'AH HAH! I am corporeal once more! I cannot hold this form for long, but it will be long enough for me to rip open that flea brothel and... well, I won't spoil it for you, heheheheh. Come! Assist me in the attack on the Kejekan village! The one that wears the iron beads must die at my hands and NO OTHER! Just make sure I get to him and you will be rewarded.'

Ridossan the Unliving begins running up to the Kejekan village.

Ridossan the Unliving says 'Kejekan! You smell it? That's the smell of death!'

Once inside the village, Ridossan runs and stands before Disciple Okarote. Kill him to exact Ridossan's revenge.

Ridossan the Unliving may despawn during the fight, but his ghost will spawn after the death of Okarote:

Ridossan the Unliving says 'He's escaped. I've failed.' Ridossan suddenly collapses into a pile of dust and is gone.'

You have slain Disciple Okarote!

Disciple Okarote says, 'You may have slain me, but your conscience will slay you in the end, and it will be a hundred times more painful.'

• Your faction standing with Kejek Village got worse.
• Your faction standing with Peace Keepers got worse.

Ghost of Ridossan spawns.

Ghost of Ridossan says, 'I will soon move on from this world to meet my ultimate fate. But before I go, I must reward the stranger that assisted me. Hand me the idol I gave you and you will be rewarded.'

The ghost will despawn in roughly one minute, so move quickly!

Give Ghost of Ridossan the Idol of Fear.

Ghost of Ridossan takes the idol into his spectral hand and shoves the lance into your arms. After letting go of the lance, the ghost immediately begins to fade away. Before it is gone completely, it looks into your eyes and says, 'Suffer.'

• Your faction standing with Heretics got better.
• Your faction standing with Deepwater Knights got worse.
• Your faction standing with Gate Callers got worse.
• Your faction standing with Craftkeepers got worse.
• Your faction standing with Crimson Hands got worse.

You gain experience.

You receive Soulfiend Lance.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Joyce will make a Robe of the Elements if you bring her the following:

• Fire Goblin Skin (Fire Goblins in Solusek's Eye)
• Frost Goblin Skin (An Elite Goblin Guard in Permafrost)
• a "Twice-Woven Cloak" (A Faerie Guard in Lesser Faydark)
• a scroll of Elemental Armor.

You say, 'Hail, Joyce'

Joyce says 'I am Joyce of the Temple of Solusek Ro. I am the guardian of four of the items of the elementalist. If you are a magician, ask me about the [Robe of the Elements], the [clay bracelet], the [earthen boots] or the [Circlet of Mist].'

You say, 'What Robe of the Elements?'

Joyce says 'The Robe of the Elements is a fine cloak for a Magician. It provides protection from the elements, protection from melee attacks and aids the Magician with her focus. Are you [interested in the robe]?'

You say, 'I am interested in the robe.'

Joyce says 'I will make for you the Robe of the Elements, but I will be needing the proper components. I will be needing a fire goblin skin, a frost goblin skin, a Twice-Woven Cloak which can be found on Faerie Guards in the Faydark, and a scroll of elemental armor. Return to me with these items and I will craft your robe.'

[Hand in the items]

Joyce says 'You have done well. You are truly a powerful Magician. Here is your Robe of the Elements.'

Your faction standing with TempleofSolusekRo got better.

Your faction standing with ShadowedMen got worse.

sections.heading: Checklist
sections.text:
Sultin in The Temple of Solusek Ro requires:
• Amiable Faction with Temple Of Sol Ro
• Golden Rod from a froglok priest in Upper Guk
• Glowing Glamour Stone by handing Tarn Visilin in High Keep 5 pp and a Glamour Stone
• Glamour Stone by handing Cynthia in Rathe Mountains 5 pp and a Shining Stone
• Shining Stone (NOT no-rent) from a shadowed man

DO NOT TURN IN TO SULTIN WITHOUT AMIABLE FACTION OR YOU MAY LOSE BOTH ITEMS. Turn Ins worked to Cynthia and Tarn Visilin with indifferent faction.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
The opening dialog is optional. Sultin can be found in The Temple of Solusek Ro, in the lower library of the west wing.

You say, 'Hail, Sultin'

Sultin says, 'I am Sultin - keeper of the three [Incandescent]s of power and the [Rod] of Insidious Glamour. If you are an Enchanter, perhaps we can deal.'

You say, 'rod'

Sultin says, 'I am keeper of the Rod of Insidious Glamour - a device of guile and deceit. The rod will increase the Charisma of whomever holds it. Are you [interested] in obtaining the [rod]?'

Sultin's response to the next prompt depends on your faction standing, and is indicative of whether or not you may complete the quest.

Sultin regards you indifferently -- You would probably win this fight..it's not certain, though.

You say, 'I am interested in the rod'

Sultin says, 'There is much service to Ro which you must perform. I cannot trust you until you have proven your worth to us.'

You begin casting Benevolence.

Sultin looks friendly.

Sultin judges you amiably -- You would probably win this fight..it's not certain, though.

You say, 'I am interested in the rod'

Please note that even when amiable he may not give you this dialog.

Sultin says, 'If I am to give you this rod, you must bring me the parts to make another. I will need the Golden Rod from the froglok priest in Guk, as well as a Shining Stone from our mortal enemies, the Shadowed Men. Once you have obtained the Shining Stone, you will need to get it enchanted. Cynthia of the Rathe Mountain Gypsy Clan will enchant the Shining Stone for you - give it to her with 50 golden coins. When the Stone is fully enchanted, bring it and the rod to me and I will give you a Rod of Insidious Glamour.'

Go to Upper Guk and obtain a Golden Rod from a froglok priest, who can be found in the same room as a froglok summoner.

Obtain a Shining Stone (NOT no-rent) from a shadowed man (in any of the zones they can be found).

Take the Shining Stone to Cynthia in Rathe Mountains in the gypsy camp near Lake Rathetear. Hand it to her along with 5 platinum pieces.

Cynthia says, 'I have enchanted your Shining Stone. To get it further enchanted, take this stone to Tarn Visilin in HighKeep. Tip him 50 golden coins and he will work his magic.'

She gives you Glamour Stone.

Head to High Keep and find Tarn Visilin on the first floor in a room on the left. Give him 5 platinum pieces and the Glamour Stone.

Tarn Visilin says, ' Your Glamour Stone has been fully enchanted. Take it and the Golden Rod back to the temple of Ro.'

He gives you Glowing Glamour Stone.

Return to Sultin in The Temple of Solusek Ro. Give him the Golden Rod and Glowing Glamour Stone.

Sultin says, 'Well done, adventurer. You have kept your part of the bargain, so I keep mine. Here is your rod.'

• Your faction standing with Temple Of Sol Ro has been adjusted by 5.
• Your faction standing with Shadowed Men has been adjusted by -1.

You gain experience.

You receive the Rod of Insidious Glamour.

sections.heading: Note
sections.text:
You need to be amiable with Sultin to get past the first part of the conversation (and receive your reward). You can increase faction several ways but it's far easier to just cast Benevolence on him. Non-enchanters can complete other temple quests or kill shadowed men.

Faction can also be gained quickly by giving Rathmana Allin in the Southern Desert of Ro 3 platinum pieces per 5 faction. Spells can be sold back to him, and he is factioned to Temple Of Sol Ro.

The Alliance instant cast is usable at level 30.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, 'Hail, Shazda Kaekwon'

Shazda Kaekwon says, 'Shalom, _______! I welcome you to our humble village in these [trying times].'

You say, 'What trying times?'

Shazda Kaekwon says, 'There are many threats currently facing this village. The kobolds of Clan Kolbok are becoming bolder in pushing the boundaries of the territory in which they usually hunt. A few of the kobolds now hunt recklessly, killing for pleasure instead of sustenance. [Rognarog] the Infuriated is the most murderous of such kobolds. Then there are the [heretics] that have been invading both Clan Kolbok and Kejek territories alike, practicing their dark sorceries as a show of devotion to their faceless god.'

You say, 'Who is Rognarog?'

Shazda Kaekwon says, 'Rognarog the Infuriated was once a mighty warrior for Clan Kolbok until his devotion to the kobold god Rolfron Zek devoured his spirit and drove him mad with anguish. Now he wanders the mountains and valleys of Stonebrunt shedding the blood of whatever creatures cross his path. Should you face Rognarog and release him from this life I will reward you for his severed head.'

Find and kill Rognarog in Stonebrunt Mountains. Nearly any kobold in the zone can be a placeholder, and he has a lot of health for his level. Loot his Kobold Head and return it to Shazda.

Shazda Kaekwon says, 'By slaying Rognarog you have spared the lives of those who would have crossed his path. I thank you for your assistance, the spirits have noticed your actions and are pleased.'

• Your faction standing with Kejek Village got better.

sections.heading: High-level Checklist
sections.text:
• Obtain Stanos' Pouch
• (OPTIONAL) Acquire level 50 (will need assistance from a 50+ rogue if you are not high enough)
• (OPTIONAL) Go to the Qeynos Aqueducts and find Malka Rale at +380, -210 (spawns at 8PM game time), tell her 'I can help' to receive Stanos' Pouch.

• Pickpocketing and Travel
• Pickpocket Stained Parchment Top from Founy Jestands in North Kaladim.
• Pickpocket Stained Parchment Bottom from Tani N`Mar in Neriak Third Gate.
• Hand Stanos' Pouch to Anson Mcbale and say "I need to see Stanos" to spawn Stanos Herkanor and then turn both parchment pieces into Stanos in Highpass Hold to receive Combined Parchment.
• Give Combined Parchment, 100pp, and 2 unstacked Bottle of Milk to Eldreth in Lake Rathetear. Receive Scribbled Parchment.

• Renux
• Give Tattered Parchment and Book of Souls to Yendar Starpyre to spawn Renux. Kill Renux Herkanor , loot Translated Parchment and, if it drops, Jagged Diamond Dagger*.

• General V`Ghera
• Return Translated Parchment to Stanos. Receive a Sealed Box from Stanos.
• Travel to Kithicor Forest, hand in a Sealed Box to any of the Dark Elves to spawn General V`ghera.
IMPORTANT: Do not use hide or invisibility / IVU while turning in the box, but do use sneak. Verify that you are sneaking but not hidden and that the mob cons indifferent before turning-in or you may lose your progress!
• Kill General V`ghera. Loot General's Pouch and, if it drops, Cazic Quill*.

• *Auxiliary Questing (if they did not previously drop)

• Get Robe of the Kedge from Phinigel Autropos in Kedge Keep or a rare drop from Coercer Q`ioul in Kithicor Forest.

• Get Robe of the Oracle from Oracle of K`Arnon in Ocean of Tears.

• Jagged Diamond Dagger

• Get Painbringer from Kobold champion in Nagafen's Lair.
• Get Mithril Two-Handed Sword from The froglok king in Lower Guk (live side).
• Get Gigantic Zweihander from Karg Icebear in Everfrost Peaks.

• Final Turn in
