sections.heading: WARNING
sections.text: While this quest is currently in Everquest Legends, it requires traveling to Tower of Frozen Shadow which is in Velious and not currently accessible in Everquest Legends.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Travel to the Kejek Village located in Stonebrunt Mountains by going through the Warrens. (not to be confused Steamfont Mtns) and locate Saemey Wirewhisker

Apprehensive is high enough for both hand-ins needed to acquire the soulforge hammer. (Will dubious work?)

You say, 'Hail, Saemey Wirewhisker'

Saemey Wirewhisker says 'Welcome to Kejek friend. I am the seer of this village for I have been gifted by the spirits with an affinity for their realm. The barrier between the spirit and physical realms is thin in these lands. The heretics know this and must be prevented from committing [atrocities] similar to those that have been committed in the past.

You say, 'What sort of atrocities?'

Saemey Wirewhisker says 'Long ago when our noble ancestors the Vah Shir were destroyed by an explosion that devastated the warring Heretic and Erudin armies an evil creature by the name of Tserrina Syl'Tor was attracted to the sudden abundance of new spirits in these lands. Tserrina was capable of capturing these spirits before they were able to cross over beyond the mortal realm and through her dark magic transformed them into a [crystalline shadow] substance.

You say, 'What crystalline shadow substance?'

Saemey Wirewhisker says 'The crystalline shadow substance was used as building blocks for Tserrina's tower on an Island near the frozen lands to the south as well as fashioned into armor and weapons for her mindless servants. Emylie Steelclaws has developed a means to purify the armor and weapons using the special properties of our Kejek forge and a smithy hammer blessed by the Titan Spirits. The purifying process transfers the imprisoned spirits into [soul orbs]. Ask Emylie about the purification process.

You say, 'What are soul orbs?'

Saemey Wirewhisker says 'I have perfected a ritual that will free the imprisoned spirits within the soul orbs. I simply require some kejek [spirit powder] to scrawl the proper sigils and a soul orb upon which to perform the ceremony. My apprentice will perform the ceremony on fading soul orbs. Simply bring him a fading soul orb and some kejek spirit powder.

You say, 'What is kejek spirit powder?'

Saemey Wirewhisker says 'The spirit power of which I speak is composed of ground spiritling stones. I will grind some powder for you if you would bring me a Valley Spiritling Stone, a Jungle Spiritling Stone, and a Mountain Spiritling Stone. Collecting the stones does not truly harm the spiritlings for when slain in this realm their essence simply disperses until it eventually reforms into a new spiritling.

Approach Emylie in the same fort.

You say, 'Hail, Emylie Steelclaws'

Emylie Steelclaws says 'Shalom friend. My mate Kalaaro is the primary blacksmith of our village. I mostly create his tools, do touch ups and refurbishes, and maintain the [kejek forge].

You say, 'What kejek forge?'

Emylie Steelclaws says 'Our forge has received the blessings of the Titan Spirits to burn with a supernatural flame! This flame has many beneficial properties but most importantly it can aid in freeing the spirits that have been imprisoned in materials by evil sorcerers.

You say, 'What about the purification process?'

Emylie Steelclaws says 'The crystalline shadow must be purified in the kejek forge using a special hammer blessed by the Titan Spirits. I will craft a hammer for you to take to the Titans for their blessings if you bring me a Large Brick of High Quality Ore and an Oak Shaft. Once the hammer is blessed you may use it in the kejek forge to purify the crystalline shadow and transfer the spirits contained within it to a Soul Orb that must be taken to our village seer.

Give Emylie a Large Brick of High Quality Ore and an Oak Shaft.

Emylie Steelclaws takes the supplies and begins to work on the hammer. She works swiftly and efficiently then cools the finished hammer and hands it to you.

• Your faction standing with Kejek Village has been adjusted by 5.
• Your faction standing with Peace Keepers has been adjusted by 5.
You gain experience.

You receive a Kejekan Smithy Hammer.

Locate a giant panda by the name of Giang Yin in Stonebrunt Mountains. Unfortunately he also has loot and unrelated quest so is possibly contentested and killed on sight by incentivized players. Advise doing a CampCheck and if called asking them to allow you to do Quest Turn before they kill him.

You say, 'Hail, Giang Yin'

Giang Yin looks down upon the creature standing beneath him and speaks. 'You are brave to approach a titan such as Giang Yin. I pray that the spirits have granted you honor and respect as well as courage.'

Give him the Kejekan Smithy Hammer.

Giang Yin says 'Freeing long imprisoned spirits is a noble cause. Your hammer has our blessing to free the souls from their crystalline shadow tombs.

• Your faction standing with Kejek Village got better.
• Your faction standing with Peace Keepers got better.
You gain experience.

You receive a Soulforge Hammer.

💡 Do not trust the Allakhazam posting saying that *any* of avatars can be used; tested with Prowler and ate the hammer and Ghostback also ate it. but Giang Yin does work though.

NOTE: The next steps require drops from Velious. The remainder of this quest cannot currently be completed in EQ Legends.

Place the Soulforge Hammer and one Crystallized Shadow or Fading Shadow item into a Forge and combine. There is a Forge located inside the Kejek Village. The trivial for all combines is 15 (no-fail) and the Soulforge Hammer will be returned after each combine just like a regular Smithy Hammer functions

• A Faded Shadow weapon results in the Purified weapon and a Fading Soul Orb.
• A Crystallized Shadow weapon results in a Purified Crystal weapon and a Soul Orb.
• A Crystallized Shadow armor piece results in a Purified Spirit armor piece and a Soul Orb.

This is where remainder of the quest may be broken or incomplete ( Unsolved on Live too--according to discussion on allakaZAM).

You could stop the quest here and just continue using your Soulforge Hammer to purify more Fading/Crystallized weapons and armor as many times as you want.

Note: You will need to complete the Spirit Powder quest to continue to the next step.

Give one Kejek Spirit Powder and a Soul Orb to Saemey Wirewhisker:

Saemey Wirewhisker says 'I require a Soul Orb and Kejek Spirit Dust in order to perform the ritual that will free the imprisoned souls. Saemey Wirewhisker scrawls an arcane symbol on the ground with an odd powder and places the orb in its center. He then begins reciting an incantation and waving his arms over the symbol and orb. Moments later the orb shatters and an apparition appears.

• Your faction standing with Kejek Village got better.
• Your faction standing with Peace Keepers got better.
You gain experience.

You receive a Shattered Soul Orb. ( No known use for this item )

This triggers nearby a heretic apparition who paths out of the town. Gave no faction and no loot.

Giving one Kejek Spirit Powder and the other kind Fading Soul Orb (from purifying the Fading shadow items) to Mrowro Wirewhisker results in:

Mrowro Wirewhisker says 'I require a Fading Soul Orb and Kejek Spirit Dust in order to perform the ritual that will free the imprisoned souls. Mrowro Wirewhisker scrawls an arcane symbol on the ground with an odd powder and places the orb in its center. He then begins reciting an incantation and waving his arms over the symbol and orb. Moments later the orb shatters and an apparition appears.

• Your faction standing with Kejek Village got better.
• Your faction standing with Peace Keepers got better.
You gain experience.

You receive a Shattered Fading Soul Orb. ( No known use for this item )

This triggers nearby a fading erudite apparition who paths out of the town. Gave no faction and no loot.
v

Notice: The quest is either broken at this point, or further steps have never been discovered.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, 'Hail, Queen Velazul Di`zok'

Queen Velazul Di`zok says 'Hail, minion! It is good to see a member of a lesser race striving to improve themself through service to the Dizok. We are feeling especially generous as of late, and if you would do us a [service], we shall reward you handsomely.'

You say, 'What service?'

Queen Velazul Di`zok says 'We are not sure you are worthy, but shall assign you this task in hopes you prove mighty enough to resolve it. Gather your broodlings about you, and journey to Charasis. There you shall find a Urn of spirits. We require this, as well as [additional components].'

You say, 'What additional components?'

Queen Velazul Di`zok says 'Very well, if you feel you are up to it, lead your broodlings to fallen Sebilis and return to us with a portion of undead dragon sinew. Bring us the Sinew, the Urn, and your Regal Band of Bathezid as proof of service, and a worthy reward shall be yours.'

• The Undead Dragon Sinew drops very rarely from Sebilite Juggernauts and Trakanon in Sebilis. Trakanon seems to drop the sinew about one in three kills, occasionally dropping more than one.
• The Spirit Wracked Urn drops sometimes by Drusella Sathir in Charasis.

Hand the Undead Dragon Sinew, Spirit Wracked Urn and Regal Band of Bathezid to the Queen in Chardok.

(This turn-in is multi-questable, but the original ring's owner will lose their ring in the process. MQ confirmed done on a level 10 as of today, 2/27/2023)

Queen Velazul Di`zok says 'Amazing! You have returned the trophies I asked for, against impossible odds. Here is your reward, worthy minion, may it serve you well.'

You'll receive the Ring back as well as the Spirit Wracked Cord. This is an innate (non-triggered) AoB effect.

sections.text:
Start Zone:

Quest Giver:
Gardern
Minimum Level:
30-35 if you're alone. 25 if you bring friends. Staff will not be clickable until 20.
Classes:
Wizard

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
The quest start in Temple of Solusek Ro. Gardern is on a balcony at +425, -70, 2nd floor near the spell vendors.

You say, 'Hail, Gardern'

Gardern says 'I am Gardern, listed among the chosen of Solusek Ro. I hold the [lore to the staff] of Temperate Flux and the [lore] to the Weeping [Wand] - items which are highly coveted by my wizardly brethren.'

You say, 'What lore to the staff?'

Gardern says 'The staff of Temperate Flux is a boon to those who dabble in the elemental arts, for it can increase the susceptibility of a creature to both fire and cold. Are you [interested] in the [staff]?'

You say, 'I am interested in the staff.'

Gardern says 'I will craft you a staff of Temperate Flux, but you must bring me the components I require to make it. I will need a heart of fire from an inferno goblin wizard in the caverns of Solusek, a heart of frost from a goblin wizard in the caverns of Permafrost, a rod of bone from a stone skeleton by the shores of Lake Rathe and a Staff of Ro. Bring me these items, and I will make you your staff.'

He wants four items:
• Darkwood Staff obtained by giving Romar Sunto in Temple of Solusek Ro a Lambent Stone
• Heart of Fire from inferno goblin wizard in Solusek's Eye (Sol A)
• Heart of Frost from a goblin wizard in Permafrost
• Rod of Bone from a stone skeleton in Lake Rathetear (note: Rod of Bone, not Heart of Stone)

Hand in the four items:

Gardern says 'Well done, ______ - here is the staff of Temperate Flux. Use it with the blessings of the Temple of Solusek Ro.'

You gain experience.

Note:

The most difficult part of this quest is getting the Rod of Bone in Lake Rathetear. Stone Skeletons spawn in a tower in the southeast corner of the zone. There are two of them, very close to each other. They both have earth pet, who cast Root. So, you will have trouble single pulling them, which makes soloing this part mostly impossible before level 30 (while the skeletons are level 24-26). You might want to look for another wizard in his 20's or get a few partners to help you for this part.

Note: At lvl 29 you can use Bonds of Force (aoe snare) on one of the pets, and then run to zone. At zone root the stone skeleton and zone dance, then root the pet again and quickly burst down stone skeleton. Use leatherskin.

Note: The above method did not work for me. However, I found a method that does, and I was able to solo them at 31 with a Stein of Moggok as my only int gear. Bind yourself at the tower off to the side. Port to WC and grab a sow from a druid, and stock up on bloodstones for Leatherskin, and bat wings for levitate. You will need these buffs up at all times. You can tip a cleric for buffs if you want another safety net. As always, clarity will speed up the process here. Root the stone skeleton you want to kill and then high tail it for Rathe Mountains. After you zone in, gate. Run in and fight the skeleton. Fight him in melee range so he casts less. If you get two resists, you won't have enough mana to kill him. After you kill him, it takes about 10-20 seconds for his elemental earth pet to get to you. You must root him and camp or gate out to west commons. It takes about a minute for the other skeleton and pet to get back because they walk. Rinse and repeat until you get your staff!

Multiquestable

The quest may be multiquestable? The helper should be able to hand in all the no-drop items, then the recipient must hand in the staff.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
THIS DESPAWNS GENERAL UPON TURN-IN

This is actually a subquest of the Rogue Epic Quest. General V`ghera is a triggered spawn by turning in a Sealed Box to one of his minions.

Ask General V'ghera about 'stanos' and he says:

General V'ghera says, "Stanos? Stanos | That dog, I WILL see him dead for what he cost me. Outcast I am, stripped of my position, my god has forsaken me, blaming ME for the loss of some tome. And you, Melchiord, you have aided him. For that, you will die first. Please, struggle and beg, I do so enjoy watching my victims squirm, and I have little joy left in my life now. If you want my favor, perhaps if you came bearing Stanos' head I would be more forgiving. But I doubt it."

Head over to Highpass and kill Stanos Herkanor. Loot Head of Stanos. When you bring it back to V'ghera, you get a nice reward.

General V'ghera says 'Life is indeed sweet! Thank you, ______, you have done me a great service this day. Take this, Stanos was kind enough to return it to me, and I have no use for it now. Know that you have the blessing of Innoruuk for this deed! But of course, I leave it to you to leave here alive. A leader has to feed his minions,you know.'

You receive Guise of the Coercer. THIS DESPAWNS GENERAL UPON TURN-IN

sections.heading: Full Checklist
sections.text:
• Obtain Stanos' Pouch
• (OPTIONAL) Acquire level 50 (will need assistance from a 50+ rogue if you are not high enough)
• (OPTIONAL) Go to the Qeynos Aqueducts and find Malka Rale at +380, -210 (spawns at 8PM game time), tell her 'I can help' to receive Stanos' Pouch.

• Pickpocketing and Travel
• Pickpocket Stained Parchment Top from Founy Jestands in North Kaladim.

• Hand Stanos' Pouch to Anson Mcbale and say "I need to see Stanos" to spawn Stanos Herkanor and then turn both parchment pieces into Stanos in Highpass Hold to receive Combined Parchment.

• Book of Souls

• Renux
• Give Tattered Parchment and THEN Book of Souls to Yendar Starpyre to spawn Renux. Kill Renux Herkanor , loot Translated Parchment.

• Return Translated Parchment to Stanos. Receive a Sealed Box from Stanos.
• Kill Stanos Herkanor. Loot Head of Stanos.
• Travel to Kithicor Forest, hand in a Sealed Box to any of the Dark Elves to spawn General V`ghera.
IMPORTANT: Do not use hide or invisibility / IVU while turning in the box, but do use sneak. Verify that you are sneaking but not hidden and that the mob cons indifferent before turning-in or you may lose your progress!
• Give Head of Stanos to General V`ghera
• Receive Guise of the Coercer. THIS DESPAWNS GENERAL UPON TURN-IN

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Vira may be found on the balcony to the left, at +410, +85. She will give quest dialog and rewards to a level 10 Magician as of 9/29/2019 (perhaps lower).

You say, 'Hail, Vira'

Vira says 'I am Vira, elementalist of Solusek Ro. I guard the secrets of the tools of [elemental summoning]. If you are a magician, you might be interested.'

You say, 'What is elemental summoning?'

Vira says 'I hold the secrets to the construction of four tools which assist magicians with the summoning of elementals. I know about the [broom of Trilon], the [shovel of Ponz], the [torch of Alna] and the [stein of Ulissa].'

You say, 'What of the stein of Ulissa?'

Vira says 'The stein of Ulissa was found and used by the mistress of water of the same name. Are you [interested] in the [stein]?'

You say, 'I am interested in the stein.'

Vira says 'I will devise a replica of the stein of Ulissa for you, but I will need the following items to make it: a sapphire, a scale from a mermaid, a stein from a magician in Najena and the toes of an ice giant. Bring me these four components, and I will make for you an object of elemental power.'

She wants the following four items:

• A Sapphire may be purchased from a jewelry merchant.
• A Mermaid Scale drops from various mermaids around the world.
• A Stein (of Water) drops from magicians in Najena or alligators in Cazic Thule or Lake Rathetear.
• Ice Giant Toes drop from various ice giants around the old world (everfrost, permafrost, Gornit in ocean of tears). These are not to be confused with Frost Giant Toes which drop from Velious giants.

Turn in the four items:

Vira says 'The four components required for the stein of Ulissa?! I am impressed! As you have displayed valor, I grant you this stein.'

sections.heading: Walkthrough

Sentry Kcor in Skyshrine requires Storm Giant Toes to be handed in 1 at a time. These drop commonly off storm giants in Kael or Wakening Lands.

Sentry Kcor may be found at +50, -640 in Skyshrine (near the Wakening Lands zonein). Note: This quest lowers faction with Kromzek.

You say, 'Hail, Sentry Kcor'

Sentry Kcor says, 'Halt, who goes there? Hmmm. What manner of strangers are you? Let it be known that the Kin hold no love for outsiders, only those truly worthy may walk amongst the Kin.'

Sentry Enots says 'It was because of an outsider that the dragons were forced to flee.'

Sentry Kcor says 'Perhaps, but then again these strangers may be worthy of our trust unlike that vile Kragen Morshire, perhaps we should give them a chance to prove themselves truly worthy to walk amongst the Kin.'

Sentry Enots says 'Perhaps you are right Kcor, but we will see.'

Sentry Enots says 'I must speak with the Herald, Kcor please see to the gate until I return. '

Sentry Kcor says 'Very well Enots, but do not be long, Lord Yelinak would have your hide should invaders arrive while you are not at your post.'

Sentry Enots says 'I shall not be long.'

Sentry Kcor says, 'Ahh these will go nicely with the rest of my collection. Here is a small reward for your trouble.'

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
completed this with dubiously faction on 11/5/2015

This quest begins with Semkak Prophet of Vallon in Kael Drakkel. He is found in the quarters connected to the city's arena.

You say, 'Hail, Semkak Prophet of Vallon'

Semkak Prophet of Vallon says 'You have entered the sacred temple of Vallon Zek. This is the Temple of Strategy. We teach what must be done to be a great leader. Forethought is a powerful tool.

You say, 'Will you teach me?'

Semkak Prophet of Vallon says 'I cannot teach one of your kind the arts of war at this time. I must teach the other Kromzek and Kromrif that proper strategy will allow us to win the war against the dragons. If you were to serve the temple of Vallon, I might consider giving you a few words of advice about strategy.

You say, 'I will serve the temple of Tallon Zek'

Semkak Prophet of Vallon says 'The dragons of Velious are ancient and wise beyond belief. They have ageless strategies to destroy their foes. The Temple of Strategy must gain the knowledge they hold. I have heard rumors of a great dragon burial ground. If this tomb indeed exists, find it and seek out the knowledge of the dragons who are now dead. Bring whatever you believe will teach us their strategies and tactics of the past.

Bring back either a Golden Tablet of Draconic Strategy or a Scroll of Scaled Tactics (dropped by a dragon constructs in the Dragon Necropolis) in exchange for a reward.

Handing in a Golden Tablet of Draconic Strategy:

Semkak Prophet of Vallon says 'This tablet holds great knowledge. The Temple of Strategy thanks you, ______. Take this and know that your own strategies are wise indeed if you have acquired this tablet from the depths of the dragons' graveyard.'
Receive Book of Strategy.

Upon handing in a Scroll of Scaled Tactics:

Semkak Prophet of Vallon says, 'These scrolls are ancient beyond belief. They describe the maneuvers dragons use to avoid being injured by mighty warriors. This will aid the cause of King Tormax greatly. Take this gift from the temple of Vallon and know that you are wise indeed.'
The reward may vary depending on which scroll you bring back or is random. Identify scrolls and update?

Clrakk Blackfist looks down at you. 'What is it you want, _____? Why do you speak to the great Knight Clrakk Blackfist?'

You say, 'I want to bring strife'

Clrakk Blackfists says 'The Coldain have grown complacent. The defenses of their city are built to keep my kind and dragonkind at bay. However, their defenses against the smaller races such as yourself are not nearly as sophisticated. I wish to kill many Coldain, but now is not the time for that. There is a particular Coldain whose death will strike fear into the hearts of many. His name is Deaen Greyforge, a Coldain knight. He is both feared and respected by his kind. If you can destroy him, it will send a message to the Coldain that they are not safe from the wrath of the giants. Kill him and chop his body into bits. Bring me a few pieces as proof that the fool is dead.'

Deaen spawns in the same hut as Garadain Glacierbane in the Eastern Wastes. Kill him and loot either a Hand of Deaen Greyforge or a Legs of Deaen Greyforge.

You say, 'Hail, Crusader Iktra'

Crusader Iktra says 'Hail yourself, [Race]. I've got multiple ships worth of people to watch over, and I could use some [supplies]. If you're not here to help, and you were going to make the mistake of attacking us, do it quickly.'

You say, 'What supplies?'

Crusader Iktra says 'If you want to help restock our supplies, we could use more bits of metal, in batches of four. They aren't worth a lot, but many of our ships were lost in the storm that landed us here, and we need nails if we're going to make new ships. Though, if you have [better ore] you'd be willing to part with, we can talk.'

You say, 'What better ore?'

Crusader Iktra says 'A lot of our weapons and armor went overboard in the storm, and our stock for repair and outfitting the growing recruits is getting... Slim, to say the least. If you can bring me small pieces or small bricks of high quality ore, it'd go a long way to helping us keep our people safe.'

Hunters have flocked here in search of a trophy or profit and glory. Instead, they find the deadly accuracy of my arrows.'

He would be quite a trophy to some hunter. And quite profitable to a poacher. Even the infamous [Talym Shoontar] has tried his hand at the hunt.'

He has also been spotted running to and from Qeynos. No doubt he is selling hides to some merchant. End his life of hunting. Bring me his head to collect the bounty.'

sections.text:
Travel to Everfrost to find Sulgar at the edge of the tundra.

You say, 'Hail, Sulgar'
Sulgar says 'Hail, traveler! Would you happen to [know] the location of any of the spokes of Tartons Wheel?'
You say, 'What is Tartons Wheel?'
Sulgar says 'Tartons Wheel was a device that Tarton constructed to let him travel through the planes. If you are [interested] in helping me reassemble it, I will [reward] you well.'
You say, 'What reward?'
Sulgar says 'If you bring me the [Staff of the Wheel] and the [Star of Eyes], I will reward you with a rune of frost and a rune of the astral - for personal use, of course..'
You say, 'What is the Staff of the Wheel?'
Sulgar says 'The Staff of the Wheel and the Star of Eyes are made by combining the ten spokes of Tarton's Wheel in a [wheel case].'
You say, 'What wheel case?'
Sulgar says 'I will lend you this wheel case - put the ten spokes of the wheel in it when you have collected them. I did say lend, however. I shall need the case back. Once you have constructed the Staff of the Wheel and the Star of Eyes, I will trade you them for a rune of frost and a rune of the astral.'

Receive Tome of the Wheel and Glowing Chest, a ten slot combine container that identifies as "Tartons Wheel Case."

The chest is a TEMPORARY container. Any stored items will be LOST after camping.

You say, 'I am interested in helping you assemble it.'
Sulgar says 'Tartons Wheel was split into 10 separate pieces. These pieces were then scattered across the face of Norrath. I have a [tome] that I can [give] you detailing the Wheel of Tarton, as well as a [Wheel Case] that you can have when you are ready to assemble the pieces.'

There are ten pieces of the staff scattered across Norrath, each called Rod. Combine them in Glowing Chest.

You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Staff of the Wheel.
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Star of Eyes.

Despite what Sulgar said, the wheel case is destroyed when this combine is made, and he does not require it to be returned. Give Staff of the Wheel and Star of Eyes to Sulgar to receive the spell Ice Comet

He will NOT return the staff or star. The trade is PERMANENT.

sections.text:
Hand it to a dwarven slave (female).

a dwarven slave says 'You killed the taskmaster?! Absolutely amazing! The orcs will be fighting among themselves for power now and I can disappear in the commotion. Thanks, friend! Take this for your deeds!'

You gain experience.

You receive a Small Wood Carving, which reads:

I've had enough o' this 'field research' Kalameky. I'm quittin' and ye can take yer low wage pay and do what ye know what to do with it.

Kalameky Darkfoam is at location 168, 389 inside Tanned Assets in South Kaladim. Hand in the carving.

Kalameky Darkfoam says 'Why, that..! Bah! Fine. Stupid as a newborn gob. He's not gonna get this, then. Hey, you might as well take it. It was gonna be his reward fer a job well done.'

You gain experience.

You receive a Targ Shield.

sections.heading: High Elf, Female
sections.text:
Give it to any female High Elf Slave and she replies:

You killed the taskmaster?! Absolutely amazing! The orcs will be fighting among themselves for power now and I can disappear in the commotion. Thanks, friend! Take this for your deeds!

You gain experience.

She gives you A Torn Drawing, which reads:

Mistress Niola - My research is close to, if not completely, finished. Our suspicions may not have been as well founded as thought. I will be back within our halls soon.

Then take A Torn Drawing to Niola Impholder, located at 795, -599 in the northmost room of the Magicians Guild in Felwithe.

Niola Impholder says, 'What? Not as supposed? What can he... Well, that's all well and good. You, I assume, wish a reward for your 'valiant work'? Well, here you go, adventurer.'

You gain experience.

You receive a Gossamer Robe.

sections.heading: High Elf, Male
sections.text:
Give this to any male high elf slave.

an elven slave says 'You killed the taskmaster?! Absolutely amazing! The orcs will be fighting among themselves for power now and I can disappear in the commotion. Thanks, friend! Take this for your deeds!'

You gain experience.

You receive A Ragged Cloth Note (identifies as "Csb I.O.U. Hie 1"), which reads:

Dear Settine. Your inability or reluctance to leave your post in order to even attempt a rescue has shown me the quality of your heart. Hopefully our eyes will never meet again

Guard Settine is located at -10, -171 (near zone in bridge on ground level) in North Felwithe. Hand in the note.

Guard Settine says 'I.. but.. she.. You can take this. I guess I don't need it any more.'

You gain experience.

You receive a Silver Amber Ring.

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
South Qeynos
Quest Giver:
Vicus Nonad
Minimum Level:
3
Classes:
All
Related Zones:
North Qeynos, Qeynos Hills
Related NPCs:
Captain Rohand, Fhara Semhart, Fish Ranamer, Flynn Merrington, Mira Sayer, Nesiff Tallaherd

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest begins with Vicus Nonad at location 255, -285 (second floor of a small white building to the east of the Lion's Mane Tavern and to the south of Nesiff's Wooden Weapons and the Bag and Barrel.

You say, 'Hail, Vicus Nonad'

Vicus Nonad says 'Greetings, _____. My name is Vicus Nonad. I am the official tax collector for the fine city of Qeynos. I serve the will of Antonius Bayle, our glorious leader. Please excuse my [cough]. '

You say, 'What's this cough you have?'

Vicus Nonad says 'Oh, I am sorry, but it seems I have fallen a bit ill. I was caught out in the rain the other day and my chills have gotten the best of me. If only someone would [help] me with today's [collections].. '

You say, 'I'll help with today's collections'

Vicus Nonad says 'Oh thank you so much Here is the official collection box. Please collect from each merchant on the [list]. Then bring me back the combined total of all your collections.'

You receive a Tax Collection Box.

You say, 'Tell me about this list'

Vicus Nonad says 'Oh. I am sorry.. I forgot to give it to you. Here you go. Be sure to give that back when your job is finished. '

You receive a List of Debtors. In South Qeynos, you need to see:

• Ton Firepride (175, -330, 3)
• Mar Sedder (535, -85, 3)
• Nesiff Tallaherd (440, -245, 3)
• Fhara Semhart (400, -80, 3)
• Tasya Huntlan (260, -70, 3)
• Captain Rohand (15, -40, 3)
• Fish Ranamer (-290, -270, 3)
• Voleen Tassen (-190, -265, 3)

In North Qeynos:

• Sneed Galliway (130, 240, 3)
• Flynn Merrington (35, 330, 3)

In Qeynos Hills:

• Mira Sayer (1400, 300, 8)

You say, 'Hail, Ton Firepride'

Ton Firepride says 'Greetings, adventurer! A mighty warrior such as yourself deserves only the finest in armor and we here at Firepride's were trained by the finest dwarven smiths. We shall be branching out and crafting [other items] soon, also.'

You say, 'I'm here about your tax collection'

• Your faction standing with Corrupt Qeynos Guards got worse.

Ton Firepride says 'Oh I see, Vicus has got some other sap to do his work. Fine. Here are your stinking taxes. If Kane were in charge, things would be different around here.'

You receive Firepride's Tax Payment.

You say, 'Hail, Mar Sedder'

Mar Sedder says 'Hail, _____. What brings you to the Tin Soldier? We have the finest in previously owned weapons and armor. Feel free to browse.'

You say, 'I'm here about your tax collection'

• Your faction standing with Merchants of Qeynos got worse.

Mar Sedder says 'Here are the taxes, _____. Boy, you call the guards and they take their time to show up but be a few days late on your taxes and they send the goons after you. Sheesh!'

You receive Sedder's Tax Payment.

You say, 'Hail, Sneed Galliway'

Sneed Galliway says 'Hello, _____. I am Sneed Galliway, merchant and citizen. I run the only general store in all of Qeynos, serving the needs of the many adventurers who call Qeynos home. If only one of them would take the time to help me with my er... [problem]...'

You say, 'I'm here about your tax collection'

• Your faction standing with Merchants of Qeynos got worse.

Sneed Galliway says 'Hey, _____, how the heck did Vicus convince you to do his job? He better be paying you well. Here you go.'

You receive Galliway's Tax Payment.

You say, 'Hail, Nesiff Tallaherd'

Nesiff Tallaherd says 'Greetings, _____! Nesiff Tallaherd, owner and operator of Nesiff's Wooden Weapons, at your service. I am the finest woodworker in all of Qeynos. Even the Qeynos Guard uses my arrows, thanks to [Guard Weleth].'

You say, 'I'm here about your tax collection'

• Your faction standing with Merchants of Qeynos got worse.

Nesiff Tallaherd says 'Tax time again already?? It seems like I just paid yesterday.. High taxes and low sales mean I won't be able to stay in business much longer. Good thing ol' Weleth is taking care of me. Here are my taxes.'

You receive Tallaherd's Tax Payment.

You say, 'Hail, Mira Sayer'

Mira Sayer says 'Welcome, _____. What brings you out this way? Be careful, we have had problems with bandits of late. As if the gnolls were not enough | '

You say, 'I'm here about your tax collection'

Mira Sayer looks up with tear-filled eyes and sobs uncontrollably.

• Your faction standing with Merchants of Qeynos got worse.

You say, 'why are you crying?'

Mira Sayer .sniff.. Oh, dear. We do not have the money. We were just robbed by a dreadful halfling bandit named Flynn something-or-other. He took the money we had set aside for Antonius. Please. Find this highwayman and retrieve our tax payment. ..sob..

Back in Qeynos:

You say, 'Hail, Flynn Merrington'

Flynn Merrington says 'I didn't know Slime could speak common..go back to the sewer before I lose my temper.'

You say, 'Did you steal Mira Sayer's taxes?'

Flynn Merrington says 'Ha! Yeah, I took their tax money. What are you going to do about it, little gnoll pup? Tell you what.. I will cut you a deal. You tell me you are a [gnoll loving weakling who isn't fit to comb my feet] and I will give you that merchant's tax money.'

You say, 'I am a gnoll loving weakling who isn't fit to comb your feet...'

• Your faction standing with Circle Of Unseen Hands got worse.

Flynn Merrington shouts 'BWAH! HA HA HA! Did you all hear that?! _____ is a gnoll loving weakling who isn't fit to comb my feet! BWAH HA HA! MY FEET! HA HA HA! Oh.. too rich.. Heh.. HA HA HA! Oh.. Heh heh heh.'

Sabnie Blagard says 'Hee hee hee! Oh.. how sad! HEE HEE HEE HEE HEE!'

Crow says 'Bwah! Ha! Ha! I love it when he does that! HA HA HA! You are too much, Flynn!'

You receive Sayer's Tax Payment.

You say, 'Hail, Fhara Semhart'

You say, 'I'm here about your tax collection'

• Your faction standing with Merchants of Qeynos got worse.

Fhara Semhart says 'Taxes? How can I afford more taxes!? You tax us poor merchants right out of Qeynos. Freeport is looking better and better every day.'

You receive Semhart's Tax Payment.

You say, 'Hail, Tasya Huntlan'

Tasya Huntlan says 'Hail, _____! Are you just visiting Qeynos? We have plenty of rooms available or, if your throat is parched, you can always visit Earron in our pub.'

You say, 'I'm here about your tax collection'

• Your faction standing with Merchants of Qeynos got worse.

Tasya Huntlan says 'Taxes? Oh, that time again huh? Here you are. Give Vicus our best. I hear he is under the weather.'

You receive Huntlan's Tax Payment.

You say, 'Hail, Captain Rohand'

Captain Rohand says 'Greetings, friend, and welcome to the Mermaid's Lure. Here, we sell fishing supplies and some imported goods from far-off lands. And, if you've got a few minutes, I could even tell you a [story] or two.'

You say, 'I'm here about your tax collection'

• Your faction standing with Merchants of Qeynos got worse.

Captain Rohand says 'Argh! You scurvy sea goblin! Taxes, you say?! Peh! I got your taxes right here! I sure don't get the services those taxes are supposed to provide! You can tell them ol' Captain Rohand said so!'

You receive Rohand's Tax Payment.

You say, 'Hail, Fish Ranamer'

Fish Ranamer says 'Hail, _____! Welcome to Fish's Ale. I am Fish Ranamer, owner of the joint. Come in and have some brew but don't be startin' no trouble or Bruno will bust you open!'

You say, 'I'm here about your tax collection'

• Your faction standing with Merchants of Qeynos got worse.

Fish Ranamer says 'Taxes?! Taxes?! Tax me right out of business is what you folks are doing! Take your taxes and get out of my pub! Unless, of course, you care to buy some drinks...?'

You receive Ranamer's Tax Payment.

You say, 'Hail, Voleen Tassen'

Voleen Tassen says 'Oh, it's so nice to see you again _____. Why don't you have a look around and buy something nice for yourself today?'

You say, 'I'm here about your tax collection'

• Your faction standing with Merchants of Qeynos got worse.

Voleen Tassen says 'Oh dear. We had forgotten about those pesky taxes. Here you go, _____. Sorry you had to come collect them. We will try to be on time from now on.'

You receive Tassen's Tax Payment.

By this time, you should have all tax payments in the box. Hit combine to create a Full Tax Collection Box. Take this along with the List of Debtors to him to complete the quest.

Vicus Nonad says 'My family is personally indebted to you for your assistance today Torrin. Please speak to my brother. I'm sure he will have some small reward for your dutiful service.'

Vicus Nonad says ' Great! Thank you so much. Here is a small gratuity for a job well done. Thank you again. Antonius Bayle and the People of Qeynos appreciate all you have done.'

• Your faction standing with Antonius Bayle got better.
• Your faction standing with Guards of Qeynos got better.
• Your faction standing with Ring of Scale got worse.
• Your faction standing with Kane Bayle got worse.
• Your faction standing with Merchants of Qeynos got better.

You gain experience.

Rewards range from a few silver pieces to minor items (Copper Amulet; Brass Ring; Turquoise).

NOTES: The faction hits for collecting the tax payments are minor. The final faction hit makes up for them. You can say "tax collection" to the NPCs without having spoken with Vicus first. You can bypass Mira Sayer by just speaking with Flynn.

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
North Qeynos
Quest Giver:
Brohan Ironforge
Minimum Level:
1
Classes:
?
Related Zones:
East Cabilis
Related NPCs:
Half Elf Maiden, Mare X`Lottl

According to Allakhazam, "the story is a bit quirky, so here's some clarification: Tayla first wanted to move to Kelethin, but probably never made it to there, then was last seen in Neriak. There she worked as a dancer or prostitute, or both, in a night club, but her NPC got removed from there by the devs after some turmoil including a court case against a fantasy writer.

Before or after her stay in Neriak she gets enslaved, and after a stop in Highpass Hold she gets sold to Haggle Baron Klok, an iksar. She then appears as an "Half Elf Maiden" in a prison cell in Cabilis East, still stating that she want to move to the Faydark to live among the elves. This girl got around quite a bit." ref (https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=529)

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Brohan Ironforge tells you that his daughter Tayla is missing and was last seen near Nektulos Forest. Bring him proof that she is safe and he will reward you.

Head to Neriak 3rd Gate and talk to Mare X`Lottl in the basement of Maiden's Fancy. Ask her about Tayla, and she will say: "Why do you seek that little scamp when you have Mare right here? If you really want to know where she is, it will cost you. Did I ever tell you that my heart belongs to Jasper?"

Go next door, buy a jasper and give it to her.

Mare X'lottl says 'Jasper! My one and only love! All right.. That Tayla creature was lost in a game of King's Court with a very important and secret merchant. Belyea will not speak of him but that he was some sort of Baron. He did give me this trinket from his new friend and owner of the half-elf scamp. You keep it. It is worth nothing compared to sweet, beautiful Jasper.'

--You receive Klok's Seal--

There is a Half Elf Maiden that spawns in a locked room in Cabilis, that is Tayla. She was won in a game of King's Court, which Carson Mccabe rigged so that the Iksar Haggle Baron Klok would win. She was taken to Cabilis, and is simply called 'Half Elf Maiden'. Find 'Key' as a ground spawn in front of Haggle Baron Klok, and use this key to open the door to the maiden.

--Give 'Klok's Seal' to Half Elf Maiden.--

Half Elf Maiden says 'Oh! thank you! I did not expect to hear of my family ever again. This seal should grant me protection out of the city if I am careful. Please take this note to my father and let him know I am safe!'
You gain experience |

--You receive 'a sealed letter'. The letter says 'Father, I am well, I will be living among the elves now. Love, Tayla'

Take the letter to Brohan Ironforge in North Qeynos

--Give 'a sealed letter' to Brohan Ironforge--

Brohan Ironforge says 'Oh! thank you! Now I know she is safe. My sweet Tayla. Here is your reward, as promised. A hero such as yourself deserves a weapon with which to uphold your noble values.'

• Your faction standing with Merchants of Qeynos got better.
• Your faction standing with Circle Of Unseen Hands got worse.
• Your faction standing with Antonius Bayle got better.
• Your faction standing with Coalition of Tradefolk got better.
• Your faction standing with Guards of Qeynos got better.
You gain experience.

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
Neriak Commons
Quest Giver:
Seloxia Punox
Minimum Level:
1
Classes:
All
Related Zones:
Oggok
Related NPCs:
Ambassador K`Ryn
quest require amiable or better faction.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Hail Seloxia Punox and she will say that he has a little test for the young warrior. She wants you to deliver a report to Ambassador K`Ryn {sic} in the Ogre city of Oggok. Tell her you will venture to Oggok and she gives you a note.

Take it to K'rynn (yes it is spelled differently) for some xp and change. He spawns near the Shaman's Guild and is not always there. He spawns at 8am right after Bouncer Gronk despawns and stays until 7pm.

He will then give you a report to deliver back to Seloxia. She will reward you with a minor item.

You say, 'Hail, Seloxia Punox'

Seloxia Punox's eyes flare with fury as her beautiful features twist into a snarl of hatred that echoes her hissing voice, 'How dare you address me in such a fashion?! I am the leader of the Indigo Brotherhood! You are lucky I do not strike you down where you stand! You shall address me as 'Mistress.' Many warriors have died so that I might gain this title.'

You say, 'Mistress'

Seloxia Punox maintains her imposing posture as she indifferently eyes _______, 'You stand now in the Cauldron of Hate -- the Indigo Brotherhood. We are an organization of Neriak's finest warriors whom remain dedicated to Neriak, the Dark Father, and our founder -- his majesty, King Naythox Thex. I am Seloxia Punox, second to only his majesty in command of the Brotherhood. From the Cauldron of Hate, we maintain the protection of the city both within our city walls and beyond in the forest of Nektulos. Perhaps you would wish to prove yourself worthy of our ranks and perform a [little test] of your skills and dedication?'

You say, 'What little test?'

Seloxia Punox says 'My little test is this - I desire a report from Ambassador K'rynn in the ogre city of Oggok. You shall run to him. I will not wait until you raise your fighting skills. Combat is not your test. Overcoming the odds is. Fast, agile warriors are we. We desire nothing less. Will you [venture to Oggok]?'

You say, 'I will venture to Oggok'

Seloxia Punox says 'Then you must go at once. Find your own way. Deliver this note to Ambassador K'rynn and he shall give you another note to return to me. Do not stop to practice your skills. I offer this test only to young warriors. If you die, then so be it. We need no inferior warriors. Now go!'

Give Ambassador K'Rynn the Sealed Letter from Seloxia:

Ambassador K`Ryn says 'Another young warrior. I pray you shall not meet the fate of the last twelve. Here then. Take this report to Mistress Seloxia at once. And stay clear of the froglok lair called Gukk.'

You gain experience.

Give Seloxia Punox the Sealed Letter from Ambassador K'Rynn:

Seloxia Punox says 'Very fine work, my young warrior. You may soon be ready to become a Teir'Dal courier. For now, we shall reward you. This will assist you in further service to the Indigo Brotherhood and King Naythox Thex.'

• Your faction standing with Indigo Brotherhood has been adjusted by 10.
• Your faction standing with Emerald Warriors has been adjusted by -1.
• Your faction standing with Steel Warriors has been adjusted by -1.
• Your faction standing with Primordial Malice has been adjusted by -20.

You gain experience.

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
Ak'Anon
Quest Giver:
Tobon Starpyre
Minimum Level:
1
Classes:
Wizard
Related Zones:
East Freeport, Greater Faydark, Lesser Faydark, Steamfont Mountains
Related NPCs:
Bidl Frugrin, Fodin Frugrin, Phiz Frugrin, Trudo Frugrin, Zenita D`Rin
Requires Amiable or better faction, quest is multiquestable.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Tobon Starpyre (1049, -989) can be found in the Library Mechanamagica.

You say, 'Hail, Tobon Starpyre'

Tobon Starpyre says, 'It is good to see the young show an interest in the ways of magic. Its circles can be used in tandem with our unique ways of tinkering. Have you [joined the Eldritch Collective] or are you [merely curious]?'

You say, 'I have joined the Eldritch Collective'

Tobon Starpyre says, 'Very good. Would you like to [go on a little mission] or are you busy studying?'

You say, 'I would like to go on a little mission'

Tobon Starpyre says, 'Fabulous! Here is a list of the observers outside Ak'Anon. Go and ask each for a [spare telescope lens]. Each should give you one. We have need of them. I await your return as does your reward, either Fire Bolt or Fingers of Fire. Meant for a skilled wizard of the eighth trial.'

You receive a List (item). It indicates that there are 3 observers in Steamfont Mountains (Fodin Frugrin, Tindo Frugrin, and Phiz Frugrin) and 1 observer in Lesser Faydark (Trudo Frugrin). Seek ye these observers and ask each if they have a spare lens. They're very easy to find. Look for the little gnome house with the telescope sticking out of one end.

The first one, Fodin Frugrin, is just outside of the entrance of Ak'Anon.

You say, 'Hail, Fodin Frugrin'

Fodin Frugrin says, 'Hello [name]. Have you ever peered beyond our little world? Somewhere out there in the vast darkness is a world filled with great technology and adventure. Our people should concentrate on reaching these distant worlds beyond the sparkling skies.'

You say, 'Do you have a spare lens?'

Fodin Frugrin says, 'Spare Telescope Lens?? I am sorry but I do not have any spares right now.. Oh wait | I do. Here you are my friend. Careful with that. They are very rare.'

The second one, Tindo Frugrin (1870, -280), can be found at #2 on the map of Steamfont Mountains.

You say, 'Hail, Tindo Frugrin'

Tindo Frugrin says, 'Greetings! It is good to see a new face around here. I am Tindo Frugrin, observer for the Eldritch Collective.'

You say, 'Do you have a spare lens?'

Tindo Frugrin says, 'I was hoping you were not the one they sent. I have a slight problem. My brother Bidl Frugrin is holding the lens. He went to Kelethin for a little observation. He has been there for quite some time. I fear he has found the local tavern. He will no doubt spend the day in the forest and every night at the tavern.'

The third observer, Phiz Frugrin (-1570, -1820), is located at #11 on the map of Steamfont Mountains.

You say, 'Hail, Phiz Frugrin'

Phiz Frugrin says, 'Hello my friend. Good to meet you.'

You say, 'Do you have a spare lens?'

Phiz Frugrin says, 'Oh my. I have bad news. It was stolen by a dark elf rogue. She fled very quickly. My little legs could not keep up. Here. She dropped this. You must find her. Get it back. We have very few Lenses.'

You receive a Filthy Towel which reads "Chops N Hops Finest Drinking Establishment in Freeport".

The last observer, Trudo Frugrin (1069, -1676), is in Lesser Faydark, just outside the zone to Steamfont Mountains (marked #5 in Lfay).

You say, 'Hail, Trudo Frugrin'

Trudo Frugrin says, 'What. what? | I am quite busy here. I have studies to complete and charts to make!'

You say, 'Do you have a spare lens?'

Trudo Frugrin says, 'Yes, of course. Here you are. Now be off.'

Travel to Kelethin to find Bidl Frugrin, the inebriated gnome, in the tavern on the same platform as Trueshot Bows. Please note that he only shows up there at night.

You say, 'Hail, Bidl Frugrin'

Bidl Frugrin says, 'Greetings! Do you not find the wine of Kelethin as sweet as their women?'

You say, 'Do you have a spare lens?'

Bidl Frugrin says, 'Oh my | I forgot I had that. Here you are. You better take it back I need to go elsewhere, bye now.'

Travel to East Freeport and look for a dark elf rogue named Zenita D`Rin. You can either kill her for the lens (quite hard at level 8, and it earns you faction hits) or play a card game with her. To play, hand her Innoruuk's Kiss of Death repeatedly until you draw a King card, then hand the King card back to her to receive the lens she stole.

You say, 'Hail, Zenita D`Rin'

Zenita D`Rin says, 'Greetings. I would love to chat with you, but I just realized something.. I do not waste time with whelps.'

You say, 'Did you steal a lens?'

Zenita D`Rin says, 'So you seek the Spare Lens. Yes. I have it. There are only two ways you can obtain it, [fight] the great Zenita or [play a game of chance].'

If you choose the game

You say, 'I will play a game of chance'

Zenita D`Rin says, 'Great. It is rather simple. I have five cards and only one is King Naythox. Find it. In order to get one card all you need to do is buy me a bottle of Innoruuks Kiss of Death from the barkeep in Chops N Hops. One bottle for one card. Return the King Naythox card to me and you shall get the Spare Lens.'

If you choose to fight

You say, 'I'll fight'

Zenita D`Rin says, 'Darn | I was hoping not to hear that word, fight. Oh well.'

(She will attack you here. Be warned, you will take faction hits upon her death. The hits can be repaired with the quest Note for Rebby and similar tasks.)

Hand all four lenses back to Tobon Starpyre for your reward.

• Your faction standing with Eldritch Collective got better.
• Your faction standing with Dark Reflection got worse.
• Your faction standing with The Dead got worse.
• Your faction standing with Gem Choppers got better.
• Your faction standing with King Ak'Anon got better.

You gain experience.

You receive 1 platinum pieces.

Receive any of several wizard spells.

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
South Qeynos
Quest Giver:
Chesgard Sydwen
Minimum Level:
1
Classes:
All
Related Zones:
Western Plains of Karana
Related NPCs:
Rongol, Tukk, Minya Coldtoes

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Chesgard Sydwen may be found at -270, -500.

You say, 'Hail, Chesgard Sydwen'

Chesgard Sydwen says 'May Karana guide you. Are you a [citizen of Qeynos] or a visitor?'

You say, 'I am a citizen of Qeynos.'

Chesgard Sydwen says 'Then I would urge you to attend daily services in the Temple of Thunder. You are a [member of Thunder], are you not? Or maybe I am mistaken and you are just lost..?'

You say, 'I am a member of Thunder.'

Chesgard Sydwen says 'I welcome you. Karana cares for all of His flock. He bestows a touch of His power upon the souls of the Clerics and Paladins of our temple. We look after His flock. Speaking of which, I require the assistance of a young paladin to [deliver provisions to needy members].'

You say, 'I will deliver provisions to needy members.'

Chesgard Sydwen says 'Good show | Here you are, young knight. Take these blankets to any resident who desires warmth. Ask them if they are followers of Karana, then ask if they require temple blankets. Be careful, the plains are quite dangerous for a young knight.'

You receive Temple Blankets (identifies as "Temple of Thunder Blankets"). Find Rongol in West Karana.

Rongol's location: Your Location is -3701.52, -9286.79, 0.19

You say, 'Hail, Rongol'

Rongol says 'Great | I have fifty acres to seed and now I have visitors stopping by to waste my time | '

You say, 'Are you a follower of karana?'

Rongol says 'Yes. I am a follower of Karana, the Rainkeeper. It is He who keeps the plains fertile.'

You say, 'Do you require a temple blanket?'

Rongol says 'With the frequent rains, I find my only need is a blanket to keep me warm during the long cold nights. Thank Karana the temple has begun to send young paladins to deliver extra blankets.'

Upon turning in the temple blanket:

Rongol says 'Thank you, protector of Karana. This will be handy when the cold rushes into the valley. Allow me to offer you some provisions for your journey. And, might I add, the [Karana bandits] have begun to operate much closer to Qeynos.'

• Your faction standing with Karana Residents has been adjusted by 5.
• Your faction standing with Guards of Qeynos has been adjusted by 5.
• Your faction standing with Priests of Life has been adjusted by 5.
• Your faction standing with Knights of Thunder has been adjusted by 5.

You gain experience.

You say, 'What about the Karana bandits?'

Rongol says 'The Karana bandits are rogues who operate in the plains. I have heard there are bounties for the bandits. Within the Temple of Thunder in Qeynos, Cleric Gehna offers one for bandit spectacles and Paladin Chesgard offers one for bandit sashes.'

This quest also worked with Tukk. Tukk's location: Your Location is -3694.14, -7672.21, 2.60.

You say, 'Are you a follower of Karana?'

sections.heading: Book Contents
sections.text:
Volume 1 - History of the Verishe Mal

We were forged from the Earth by the hands of our lord, Brell Serilis. He molded us into an image that suited him, and we were glad. Such is our role to learn and expand, and be one with the underworld. We were born to know many things, and we shall. Our lord told us that we suffered not the curse of the others, and for this, we are grateful.

Volume 2 - History of the Verishe Mal

Our forefathers gave us many tasks to better us. We learned the way of the sword, and the way of magiks. At each test we proved victorious, and for a time, quite prosperous. In time, we grew to be a large race, and created a ruthless empire that spanned many a mile. Our worth was broken down into a caste system, and many were made slaves.

Volume 3 - History of the Verishe Mal

The Verishe Mal were then ruled by the Ishva Mal, hard and stern rulers. In the old tongue, Ishva meant Supreme and Mal meant ruler. Beneath the Ishva, there were the Rosch, and the Tesch, the caster and warrior castes. Above the Rosch and the Tesch were the Nisch, the spiritual leaders of the Verishe Mal. sections.heading: Checklist
sections.text:
• Kill Dyllin Starsine in Highpass Hold for Page 30 of a Book
• Give Moodoro Finharn at Crow’s Pub & Casino 2 gold to get the book
• Give Moodoro Finharn at Crow’s Pub & Casino 4 gold as many times as it takes to get Jester card
• Give Jester card back to Moodoro Finharn to get Page 34 of a Book
• Combine page 30 and 34 in the book to get the Testament of Vanear

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
In Highpass Hold, there is a secret area under the pond near the Orc side.

This hidden area is a smugglers den that can only be entered from an underwater tunnel (-158, 335 in the water by the Tiger's Roar).

Once through, walk around until you find Dyllin Starsine (Only person in there that looks like a Qeynos Guard). If he is not up, there is a tent with boxes near it in the smuggler area and this is where he will spawn.

Dyllin Starsine is on a 7 hour timer with no PH (place holder). He can spawn in a range of levels from 12 to 16 and hits relatively hard for a moderately under geared player in the teens and has about 600 HP (hit points).

Dyllin Starsine at average faction will not aggro, nor will the smugglers, so it's a safe area to bind point for those that can, and it's a safe area to stay at for hours on end.

Careful, although the smugglers may not be KoS (kill on sight) they will assist Dyllin Starsine if they get too close. BEWARE - at least one of the smugglers who paths this area is higher level (backstabs for 360, and quads for 120). To avoid a smuggler joining the fight, wait for the high level smuggler to path to the southwest or harmony the high level smuggler if you are a dru or rng, or lull him if you are high enough level before engaging Dyllin. Depending on your level, other Smugglers may join if they get too close. For This reason, don't pull Dyllin away from the tent or engage when he paths out of that area. Fight him under his awning while the smugglers are away using root or snare so he doesn't flee.

Kill him and loot page 30.

Now you will need to travel to Qeynos and find the Crow’s Pub & Casino.

Moodoro Finharn is in the Crow’s Pub & Casino but you can wait until he comes out of the tavern to puke in the pond.

Moodoro is on one of the Erudite caster factions, but you can do this part at dubious. If you are KoS inside Crow's and feeling brave or scared, he can be pulled to the zoneline by someone else and no other NPCs will assist him. You can also wait and he leaves Crow's during the 6 PM in-game hour and goes back inside during the 10 PM in-game hour.

Give Moodoro Finharn 4 gold and you will receive a card. If it is a Jester, give it back to him in return for page 34. Other cards are useless and can be destroyed or handed to Moodoro for nothing. You may need several turn-ins before getting a Jester.

When you have both page 30 and 34, Give Moodoro 2 gold and he will give you the book to combine Pages 30 and 34 in.
it of money here.

Note that Zenita D`Rin in the East Freeport slums can be given an Innoruuk's Kiss of Death to get a random card in return, but she gives out Joker cards rather than Jester cards. The Joker card will NOT complete the quest with Moodoro.

Once you have both Pages 30 and 34 in your possession, combine them and create the Testament of Vanear.

Rarnan Lapice is located at -725, -85 outside the Temple of Divine Light in Erudin.

You say, 'I need the Testament of Vanear.'

Illithi Nollith says 'Oh my | You have not heard?! The Testament of Vanear was stolen from the library! It was checked out by a man named Moodoro. He is an Erudite, but I believe he was executed for some crime. Now the book is lost forever. You should speak with Tol Nicelot. He used to know Moodoro. Tol is most likely upstairs.'

You say, 'Hail, Tol Nicelot'

You say, 'Did you know Moodoro?'

Tol Nicelot says 'Yes, I knew Moodoro Finharn. He used to be a good friend until he started visiting Qeynos and indulging in human vices. He was executed for crimes against the state. Not even his sister [Nolusia] could get the charge dropped. There have been some who say he escaped execution and lives in Qeynos. That is insane babbling.'

Moodoro Finharn is located at 165, 325 outside Crows Pub & Casino in North Qeynos.

You say, 'Hail, Moodoro Finharn'

Moodoro Finharn says 'Greetings, fellow traveler! I gotta tell ya. I love this town. Especially Crow's. Although the crowd seems a bit shadier than other places of the sort.'

You say, 'What Testament of Vanear'

Moodoro Finharn says 'So you have heard that good old Moodoro has knowledge of the Testament of Vanear. I care little for that book. Of course I have it | If you want it, I will sell it to you for two gold pieces.'

Give him 2 gold.

Moodoro Finharn says 'HA | I hope you enjoy the book. It is missing pages 30 and 34. It is nothing more than garbage without them. A rogue ripped them from their bindings and sold them to [Ran].'

You say, 'Who is Ran'

Moodoro Finharn says 'Ran Flamespinner is a librarian in Highpass Hold.'

Ran Flamespinner is located at -45, -345 in Highpass Keep.

You say, 'Hail, Ran Flamespinner'

Ran Flamespinner says 'I am very sorry to have to inform you that the library is off limits to strangers.'

You say, 'What Testament of Vanear'

Ran Flamespinner says 'So, you seek the page 30 I recently purchased from an Erudite named Moodoro? He also had page 34, but refused to sell it to me. If you seek page 34, you will first have to find Moodoro. I had page 30 for but a few days when a man swiped it from the library's shelves. I believe he wore the garb of a guard of Qeynos. He darted away so fast I did not have time to cast a single spell! I believe he is still in Highpass, I can feel it | '

Dyllin Starsine is located at 40, 130 in Highpass Hold, in the Smuggler area next to the pottery wheel.

You say, 'Hail, Dyllin Starsine'

Dyllin Starsine says 'Hey | I don't have any spare change, okay?!'

You say, 'What Testament of Vanear'

Dyllin Starsine says 'So you heard Guard Dyllin has page 30 of the Testament of Vanear, eh?! Well, get lost | Over my dead body will you get page 30!'

Auto attack is on. Dyllin Starsine says 'How dare you attack a member of the Qeynos Guard | ' You have slain Dyllin Starsine! You have looted a Page 30 of a Book.

• Your faction standing with Guards of Qeynos got better.
• Your faction standing with Kane Bayle got worse.
• Your faction standing with Circle Of Unseen Hands got worse.

Return to Moodoro Finharn

You say, 'I want page 34'

Moodoro Finharn says 'So, you know I have page 34. Pretty smart of me to tear the most important page out before someone else tried, eh? If you really want it, then sit down and deal in. Ante is 4 gold. I will give you one card. If it is a jester, then I will give you the page. Let's do it.'

Give him 4 gold and receive a card.

Moodoro Finharn says 'Well, what do you have? | '

Give Moodoro the Jester.

Moodoro Finharn says 'Lucky you. We were hoping to really clean you out. Here you go. Take the page. Even together, the book is nothing more than fiction.'

Combine Page 30 of a Book and Page 34 of a Book in the Testament of Vanear.

Receive Testament of Vanear.

If you are looking to get the Testament of Vanear, Your quest is complete and you can stop now, YOU WILL LOSE THIS BOOK IF YOU TURN IT IN ON THE NEXT STEP.

Return to Rarnan Lapice and hand in the Testament of Vanear.

Rarnan Lapice says 'I sent you after that book ages ago! What took you so long? I have already completed my studies. Luckily I found the original manuscript under my bedroll. I forgot I had kept it there. Take this as a token of my apology. Maybe it will aid you in your next book hunt. I know how cunning those books can be.'

sections.text:

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Requires Amiable faction with Priests of Mischief.

Gapeers Johhanis is located at -240, -412 in the cleric guild in Rivervale.

You say, 'Hail, Gapeers Johhanis'

Gapeers Johhanis jumps at your voice, he's obviously very focused on a set of beakers on the table. They seem to be holding samples of rotted flesh. Gapeers says, 'Oh my heart! You could have stopped it! Please be careful when entering these chambers. It would be unfortunate if I had dropped and broken these [specimens].'

You say, 'What specimens?'

Gapeers Johhanis turns to explain the specimens when he accidentally knocks over the beakers. He sucks in a short breath as the beakers crash to the ground, ruining the samples. As Gapeers's skin loses color he says, 'OH NO | No, not my specimens | Now what am I to do?! I needed those badly! You did this! You [owe] me now!'

You say, 'What do I owe you?'

Gapeers Johhanis says 'You bet you do! You big clumsy Half Elf! These were the remains of unfortunates who were drowned. Not only were they drowned but their bodies clung to life and refused to settle. Products of the horrendous curse of unlife. I'll need you to find three [special samples] of drowned and cursed flesh.'

You say, 'What special samples?'

Gapeers Johhanis's eyes widen as he realizes you actually might intend to help him. His voice becomes raspy with desperation as he says, 'Oh! Wonderful....uuhhmmm.... well ....You'll need to find undead creatures found in the waters of three different climates. One from a tropical ocean. One from the muddy and slow moving river of a jungle. And one from the stagnate and polluted water of a city's sewer, Freeport would be ideal. Will you really [do this for me]?'

You say, 'I will do this for you.'

Gapeers Johhanis says 'Oh thank goodness! Thank you so much, ______! Those old specimens were much to ancient anyway, fresh ones will help in my mission to heal those who were unfortunate enough to drown and become cursed. If you bring back the three samples I have a little something you might like. Although it will only fit and be of use to one who heals as a profession and is small of stature like myself. Good luck!'

In Erud's Crossing, kill a zombie sailor. They are around the sunken ship offshore.

--You have looted a Algae Covered Flesh.--

In Feerrott water, kill a a drowned caravan guard.

--You have looted a Swollen Flesh.--

In West Freeport sewers (via secret wall south of Freeport West yard), kill a drowned citizen.

--You have looted a Waterlogged Flesh.--

The 3 drowned citizens aggro'ed on a 23 cleric that jumped down into their pool after entering from the WFP entrance. You have better luck pulling from the opposite entrance.

Return to Gapeers Johhanis and hand him the 3 Fleshes.

Gapeers Johhanis cheers as you hand him the samples of zombie flesh. He says, 'You have them! Excellent! Thank you very much, ______! Now I have much work to do so shoo before you break something else. Oh and here is your reward. It's an anklet that all our acolytes wear. Not only is it functional, but we can show off our beautiful foot hairs at the same time. Us halflings are pretty smart really.'

a gleaming sphere of light

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, 'hail a gleaming sphere of light'

a gleaming sphere of light says 'I greet thee Phazrael you will have to pardon my demeanour I am afraid that I am not in the best of spirits. Recently yet another brother was taken from us from an evil unknown through the dark art of mind rending.

You say, 'what evil'

a gleaming sphere of light says 'Somewhere there exists a group of outcast phantasmists that use their powers to only harvest true evil. These masters of the mind are of origin that we are yet to uncover for they only exist in ones thoughts. Slowly turning one insane from the horrors that pound through their mind.

You say, 'what outcast phantasmists'

a gleaming sphere of light says 'These outcasts were once believe to be part of our circle before turning to the way of evil and using the mindbending abilities that they possess to take over those who knowledge would benefit them most.

You say, 'what mindbending abilities'

a gleaming sphere of light says 'What these beguilers are capable of is unknown, but what we do know is that as each day passes we are all at risk from an attack that could very well end us. But there is a chance that if we could find the ancient tomes of their weaknesses, this evil could be stopped.

You say, 'what ancient tomes'

a gleaming sphere of light says 'Legend exists that there are two lost tomes that cover the darker sides of Mind control. These tomes were last believed to be possessed by mortals much like yourself that stumbled upon them not knowing what they possessed because they could not understand the unknown code the books are scribed in.

You say, 'what code'

a gleaming sphere of light says 'To prevent those that could not control the powerful abilities that these tomes described how to perform. These tomes were scribed of ancient language that not many could decifer. In search of someone that could assist them these heros fell in the city of giants.

You say, 'What ancient language?'

a gleaming sphere of light says 'As I told you before these books are distinctly coded to only be understood by those that have the abilities to perform and contain these magics. If these tomes were recovered it is very possible that I could decode them and develop an immunity to the mind altering attacks that I feel are upon us.

The tomes are found in the Western Wastes,

• 1. The First Half of Vin`Pekir's Tome drops off random dragons (like Hechaeva, Glati, Yeldema, Bratavar, etc).
• 2. The Second Half of Vin`Pekir's Tome drops off of dragons in the Sapara brood (Jen Sapara, Mav Sapara, etc).
• 3. The First Half of Al`Tarlkal's Tome is dropped by Harla Dar, who roams near the zone to Siren's Grotto
• 4. The Second Half of Al`Tarlkal's Tome drops from Esorpa of the Ring, a static spawn in the scar outside of Veeshan's Temple.

Hand in all four tomes.

a gleaming sphere of light says 'In my hands I hold the teachings of those who gave their lives to produce a defense against the evils of mind control. For what you have done for me I cannot thank you enough; please accept this magical item as a reminder of my gratitude.

You receive the Wreath of Nature.

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
Qeynos Aqueducts
Quest Giver:
Commander Kane
Minimum Level:
25
Classes:
All
Related Zones:
East Freeport, Highpass, Surefall Glade, Ak'Anon, South Ro
Related NPCs:
Frenway Marthank, Mammoth, Mutt Rootlit, Pietro Zarn, Rathmana Allin, Dyllin Starshine

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Note: Warmly faction required.

[ ] Complete Blackburrow Stout Delivery or kill Mutt Rootlit for Bayle List I
[ ] Complete The Regurgitonic quest or kill Mammoth for Bayle List II
[ ] Kill Dyllin Starshine for Bayle List III

This a long and involved quest, and can be started in a number of different places, but revolves around Qeynos, Surefall and Freeport. The details I was given are still unclear in spots, but it ultimately results in a high powered shadowknight weapon. It involves getting all three parts of the Bayle List. Each part can also be gotten separately for a different reward, as listed on the separate quests.

sections.heading: List I
sections.text:
For Part one of the list, talk to Commander Kane in the Shrine of Bertoxxulus in Qeynos Aqueducts and he will ask you to deliver Blackburrow Stout (NO DROP version) to Barn Bloodstone who is outside the Golden Rooster in Highpass. Make sure your faction with Barn is at least indifferent. To raise, do the Note for Janam and Note for Rebby quests in the East Freeport. If Commander Kane doesn't talk to you at first, just Hail him and say, "The disease is spreading." Then he will be much more manageable. Doing so results in Bayle List I, part one of the list.

As an alternative, you can kill Mutt Rootlit, who stands next to Barn Bloodstone, and she will drop the Bayle List I. Doing this will give a serious faction hit for Coalition of TradeFolk III, Coalition of TradeFolk, Carson McCabe, Corrupt Qeynos Guards, and The Freeport Militia.

sections.heading: List II
sections.text:
For part two of the list, you can choose to kill a named bear or you can do The Regurgitonic quest.

Sidequest background: Talk to Runethar Hamest in the Temple of Thunder, who is investigating corruption among the guards of Qeynos. He asks you to go to Surefall Glade, find Frenway Marthank in the Druids' Guild, and ask him for "The Bayle List." When you do, Frenway is in a state of depression. His son -- who happened to be carrying the very list you're looking for -- was killed and devoured by the great grizzly bear Mammoth, who lives deep in the caves of Surefall Glade. As a Druid, Frenway is forbidden to harm the bears of the Glade, but he wants vengeance.

If you can find and slay the level 20-25 Mammoth behind the waterfall, you will get a the Bayle List II.

As an alternative, you can feed Mammoth a Regurgitonic, which can be obtained from The Regurgitonic quest.

sections.heading: List III
sections.text:
For part three, talk to Raltur Caliskon in the Dismal Rage in Freeport and he tells you to assist Sir Lucan D`Lere in any task he has. But to return any interesting information to him and not Delere. Ralture will then tell you to kill Lady Shae and get the Bayle List. However, Lady Shae will tell you that Dyllin Starshine was sent from Qeynos to retrieve this list, and that he just left for High Pass Hold/Qeynos with it.

He can be found in the smuggler's camp in Highpass. If you have a high faction or use your influence spell on him, he will give you the list. You can also get the Bayle List III by killing him, but you will take a bad faction hit from that that might cause you to not be able to complete the final part of the quest.

sections.heading: Final
sections.text:
Take all three parts to Rathmana Allin in South Ro along with 20 gp and he will give you back a translated list.

If you give this to Pietro Zarn, the shadowknight guildmaster in the East Freeport Sewers, he will usually reward you with a Rage War Maul (you may need very high faction with him to get it - thus you shouldn't kill Dyllin unless you started extremely high).

It is possible that this is used to obtain an even better shadowknight weapon. It also seems likely that there is a good person to give the list to to get a good-oriented reward.

sections.heading: Translation
sections.text:
Translated the list says (substitution cipher: abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz => uxbcadfgehzklminpqrsotqwxy)

BAYLE LIST
QEYNOS DROSCO BERTOXXULOUS
FREEPORT ALAYLE MILITIA
NERIAK FININ INDIGO
ERUDIN GELLIN MERCHANTS
FELWITHE HELSHIN CHAMPIONS

According to [https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=503&mid=1578172128471733&p=1#msg1578172128471733](Zam Thread)

Commander Kane says, Thank you for your help. Soon Antonius' agents will be exterminated like roaches. May the virus of the Plaguebringer run through your veins.

Which suggests the it's a list of spies working for Antonius Bayle and giving the list to Kane/Zarn will cause their exposure and assassination.

Only known 'Good' variant of this quest is the Bonethunder Staff Quest.

Quest Giver:

18

sections.heading: The Captain
sections.text:
Be warned that this quest can really mess with your faction with the deep pockets.

Visit the Captain B standing out on a balcony in Highhold Keep. Hail him and answer his questions.

You say, 'Hail, Captain Boshinko'

Captain Boshinko says 'Greetings, stranger! Are you the [bounty hunter I requested]?'

You say, 'I am the bounty hunter you requested'

Captain Boshinko says 'It is about time. I have been waiting for you for ages! Your [reputation] precedes you.'

You say, 'What reputation?'

Captain Boshinko says 'You humor me, Slaythe! I would have guessed someone like yourself would have little time for humor. Nevertheless, would you [like to hear about the job] I have for you?'

You say, 'I would like to hear about the job'

If too low faction:

Captain Boshinko says 'Your name is as respected as the name of the Karana bandits. Leave my presence while you still have legs to run with.'

---

If adequate faction:

Captain Boshinko says, 'A prisoner named Bronin Higginsbot, a halfling, recently escaped. He was a small time thief and I would care less if it were not for the fact that in the process of obtaining the cell key. he disemboweled my finest guard. We found the bloodied shank still stuck in my guard's gutted corpse. Would you [like to know more]?'

You say, 'i would like to know more'

Captain Boshinko says, 'That little man has now made it to Rivervale. He has ties with the halfling rogues, obviously. I want you to find him. When you find him, take this shank he used to kill my guard and hand it to him. I want him to know why he is about to die. No one escapes my prison | Bring me his head and I shall pay the bounty.'

It seems a petty rogue escaped the dungeon in Highhold Keep but left behind crucial evidence. The rogue's Bloody Shank was sticking out of a guards back!

The Captain gives you the Bloody Shank to take to the rogue to let the rogue know why you are there to kill him.

sections.heading: Bronin
sections.text:
The rogue's name is Bronin Higginsbot and he hangs around the Deeppockets in Rivervale. He may sometimes be found around the southernmost tower in Misty Thicket.

Bronin Higginsbot says, 'Hello. It is dangerous out in the woods. You should go to Rivervale. It's at the end of the path. You will find good times there. Travel safely, my friend!'

Hand him the Shank and he will attack:

Bronin Higginsbot says, 'So Slaythe finally found a lackey. Let us see an end to this.'

Kill him, but be careful because a bodyguard sometimes spawn next to him when you hand him the Shank and also the guards will help him if they are nearby.

• Your faction standing with DeepPockets has gotten worse.

Loot a Halfling Head

sections.heading: Return to Captain
sections.text:
Return his head for decent money and experience, and occasionally a Scouts Blade. You will get the following faction hits:

Captain Boshinko says, 'Well done, Slaythe! What? You look disappointed in the reward. Get moving while you still have legs to carry you | '
