You receive ~20 copper pieces.

There is also a rogue named Shayde Higginsbot (not Slaythe) on the second floor of the Fool's Gold. When you hand him the Shank he does not give the generic (Thank you.) response. Not sure what happens if you slay him too.

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
Beholder's Maze
Quest Giver:
Diggs Duggun
Minimum Level:
49+
Classes:
Paladin
Related Zones:
Various
Related NPCs:
Various

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Diggs Duggun is at 1260, -550 in the Gorge of King Xorbb.

You say, 'Hail, Diggs Duggun'

Diggs Duggun says 'ail, dere! Ain'tcha a sight fer me sore eyes! I knows dat we're strangers an' all, but might I ask a [boon] of ye?'

You say, 'What boon?'

Diggs Duggun says 'Well, me pickaxe is blunted awfully bad and me ale supplies are dangerously low. If'n ye would be kind enough t' get me a new pick and a couple o' bottles o' dwarven ale, I would be f'rever in yer debt.'

Give him a Pick (found at the vendor at the Kaladim Bank) and two Dwarven Ales (not stacked).

Diggs Duggun drinks one of the ales and burps loudly then says 'By Brell's Beard! Yer a lifesaver, ya are! 'ere, take dis bone I've found 'ere in dis maze. Looks human ta me and I'm thinkin that a proper burial is in order. Freeport's the closest place dat has one o Marr's temples. I'm thinkin dis was one o' his Holy Knights by da look o' da tattered tunic I found it wrapped in. I'm thinkin Valeron might be havin an interest in it.'

Receive A Dusty Old Leg Bone.

Now go find the Paladin guildmaster in North Freeport by the name of Valeron Dushire.

You say, 'Hail, Valeron Dushire'

Valeron Dushire says 'I am Sir Valeron Dushire, leader of the order of the Knights of Truth. If your soul shines with purity and strength, I urge you to join our order. The might of Mithaniel Marr stands behind all who join. Soon that might will help us free this city from the tyranny of the [Freeport Militia].'

Give him the Dusty Old Leg Bone:

Valeron Dushire says 'Hail, adventurer! I... what's this? Where did you get this? Never mind.. I.. I never thought we would find [him]!'

You gain experience |

You say, 'Who is Diggs Duggun?'

Valeron Dushire says 'According to this crest on the tunic, you have recovered one of the bones of a lost Paladin [Hero].'

You say, 'What hero?'

Valeron Dushire says 'His name has been long lost but his legend lives on in every young knight who aspires to continue his fight. He attempted to quell an evil that resided within Kithicor, perverting nature itself. Much to his relief, it was an earthly foe he fought against and not a denizen summoned from the planes of evil. Then, suddenly, he was surrounded by dozens of dark elves. He was captured and taken to the Dead to be experimented upon and had his soul twisted by vile necromantic magics. Then the Tier'Dal cast his remains to the winds. Where they landed, no one knew, until now. You have found one of his bones. I hereby charge you with a Holy Quest to bring this Hero's bones back for a burial with honors. Do you [accept], knight?'

You say, 'I accept.'

Valeron Dushire says 'Good! I knew you would. It is one of the highest honors one can receive. Your quest will not be easy for I know not where his other bones lay. A spy of ours within Neriak was able to surmise that six of his bones along with his sword and shield were scattered throughout Norrath. You must search far and wide to find the remaining pieces, as you already have one.. Do not give up. It is now your sacred duty. Once you have retrieved all eight pieces, come back to me and inform me that you [have all the bones].'

You now need to collect six bones, a shield, a sword and a coffin. These are the items and locations:. *These are not actual bones, they are small bags that you pick up.

and Dusty Old Finger Bones ground spawns present.]]
A Dusty Old Skull - Minotaur caves in Steamfont Mountains in Meldrath's room.
A Dusty Old Leg Bone - You received this from talking to Diggs Duggun in Beholder's Maze.
Dusty Ribcage - The Garden in Mistmoore Castle. This is actually in the Fountain Room #7 on the map. This can also spawn in the same room as A Dusty Old Backbone in Unrest.
A Dusty Old Backbone and Dusty Ribcage - Ghost Room Pit in Unrest. Go in the basement, then through the invisible wall, go through the lava, and the bag is in the pit.
A Dusty Old Jawbone - Underwater Ice Cave (Miragul's area) in Everfrost Peaks. There are emblems on the wall in the cave. The item is under the third emblem at about 4535, -5235.
A Dusty Broken Sword - In the mines of North Kaladim in the water. Ground spawn in the water at roughly +761, +291.
A Dusty Broken Shield - On a ledge on right cliffs in Erudin from the docks. Ground spawn at -605, -725. You must swim from the docks to reach the shield.
Dusty Old Finger Bones - Inside Phinigel Autropos's room in Kedge Keep. Beware Swirlspine Seahorse (4 of them, 51 Cleric’s) can see invis! So bring a group! Swim down through the Star which is in the center of the room. There's an alcove on the SOUTH WALL with a large rock, and the bag spawns to the LEFT of the rock. Exact Location is neg 150, pos 127, neg 270.

*NOTE: The respawn timer on bones seems to be 20 minutes. Tested 6/30/2022 with two Paladins in Unrest and Mistmoore.

Gem Encrusted Casket is received from Ping Fuzzlecutter as follows:

You say, 'I have all the bones.'

Valeron Dushire says 'Excellent! You are indeed worthy to bear the title of Holy Knight! Now, about the coffin. I have spoken with Ping Fuzzlecutter, outside the western gates. Ask him about the coffin and once it is made, bring it to Simon Aldicott of Marr. I shall have Simon meet you by the lake in the Commonlands after Ping gives you the coffin.'

Go to Ping Fuzzlecutter, outside the gates of West Freeport.

You say, 'What components?'

Ping gives you an Empty Gem Bag to combine the following items:

Diamond
Star Ruby
Pearl
Fire Emerald
Sapphire
Fire Opal
(2) Enchanted Platinum Bar (Unstacked)

Combine the gems in the bag to craft a Full Gem Bag. Give this to Ping to receive Gem Encrusted Casket.

Ping Fuzzlecutter smiles broadly as he rifles through the bag, then looks up at you and says, 'Bout time! Here is the coffin as promised.'

Put the 6 dusty bones + sword + shield in the casket and combine to craft A Gem Encrusted Casket. See Simon Aldicott in the West Commonlands.

You say, 'Hail, Simon Aldicott'

Simon Aldicott says, 'Hail and well met, ______. I am Simon Aldicott, a cleric in the service of Mithaniel Marr. I've been sent here to prepare a [funeral service] for one of our lost to join Marr in his kingdom.'

You say, 'What funeral service?'

Simon Aldicott says, 'Are you the brave knight whom Valeron sent to meet me here? If so, please place the remains in the coffin and seal it. Then hand me the coffin so that we may bless it in the waters of this lake.'

Give him the casket. note: Was able to hand him casket as Iksar/dubious)

Simon Aldicott places the coffin in the water and begins to pray. 'Lord of Valor high above, take this knight, your loyal child, into thy kingdom and... by all that is holy! What is that thing?!'

A Tortured Revenant will spawn and attack you (some thanks eh?). This mob is immune to changes in runspeed and has a ton of hitpoints for its level. Kill it and loot Revenant Ash (identifies as "Ash of Darak Lightforge").

A Tortured Revenant's corpse says 'At last I can rest..'

Give the Revenant Ash to Simon and he will reward you with your new spell.

Simon Aldicott says, Tis a sad thing. His soul was twisted to its current state somehow and he thought YOU were the foul Teir'Dal who destroyed him in the first place. But that is no matter..you have freed him to stand by Marr's side once more! Now, give me the ash so that I may finally put him to rest. In return for your valor I shall provide you with an ancient spell unknown to most Holy Knights of Marr.'

Simon Aldicott says, 'Thank you Knight. With this task accomplished, I shall reward you with this scroll. It is an ancient spell that only the holiest of knights may cast. Remember your duty!'

sections.heading: Walkthrough

Speak to Innkeep Nasumi in East Freeport at #8 on the map.

The conversation with Innkeep Nasumi:

You say, 'Hail Innkeep Nasumi'

Innkeep Morpa says 'Huh? Oh hi. Weeze got a [problem] here. It not gud.

You say, 'What problem?'

Innkeep Nasumi says, 'Hi Kollins. Times are tough these days. We are finding ourselves running short on baked goods lately. Would you be [willing to help] us out?'

You say, 'willing to help'

Innkeep Nasumi says, 'You'd help us? Oh, you are such a dear! Well, there are two ways you can help us and our little business. If you [can bake] you can make us some muffins so we don't run out. Otherwise, you [can travel] a little way for us and pick up some bread.'

You say, 'i can bake'
Innkeep Nasumi says, 'A free lance baker, well that is nice. Here. Take this crate and make some of your muffins. Bring the Full Muffin Crate back to me when you are done. I'll pay you the same as we pay our regular suppliers. Make sure you bake them fresh yourself, we only sell quality muffins here.'
(note this leads to a different quest)

You say, 'i can travel'
Innkeep Nasumi says, 'How nice of you! There is a man who lives in the plains to the south. I believe his name is Jarlen Meadowgreen. I guess the plague hasn't hit that area too hard. Anyway, he's a talented baker and makes some delicious bread. Just let him know that you want a bag of bread loaves.'

You then head to Jarlen Meadowgreen in South Karana. He is with the group of centaurs that hands out the crafted armor quests and circulates between standing near his brothers and checking his bread rising by the large fire pit (the text while he is checking this is rather amusing.)

Hail him and say, 'I am here to pick up some bread loaves.'

Jarlen Meadowgreen says 'So, ya want some of my bread is that it? Well, you've come to the right place I'd say. My brothers told me the market was ripe for that sort of thing so I decided to move on over here. Anyway, hand over two gold pieces and I'll give ya a sack of bread made by me own two hands.'

Give him 2 gold and you get a Bag of Bread Loaves (LORE NO DROP.)

Bag of Bread Loaves can also be found in RunnyEye Citadel off goblins and Sporali in the moldy area.

Return and give to Innkeep Nasumi.

Innkeep Nasumi says, 'Oh, wonderful fresh bread! Thank you for making the trip, that is such a long way. Here, I hope this covers your travel expenses. You have my deepest thanks.'

• Your faction standing with Coalition of Tradefolk got better.

You receive 3 platinum, 2 gold pieces.

sections.text:
Start Zone:
Erudin at the Docks
Quest Giver:
Beth Breadmaker
Minimum Level:
1
Classes:
All, Good Aligned
Related Zones:
Southern Karana
Related NPCs:
Jarlen Meadowgreen

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Speak to Beth Breadmaker in her leanto by the docks in Erudin.

The conversation with Beth Breadmaker:

You say, 'Hail Beth Breadmaker'

Beth Breadmaker says 'Hi [Name]. Times are tough these days. I am finding myself running short on baked goods lately. Would you be [willing to help] me out?'

You say, 'I'm willing to help.'

Beth Breadmaker says 'You'd help me? Oh, you are such a dear! Well, there are two ways you can help me and my little business. If you [can bake] you can make me some muffins so I don't run out. Otherwise, you [can travel] a little way for me and pick up some bread.'

You say, 'I can travel a little.'
(note that responding to 'can bake' gives a different quest)

Beth Breadmaker says 'How nice of you! There is a man who lives in the plains to the south. I believe his name is Jarlen Meadowgreen. I guess the plague hasn't hit that area too hard. Anyway, he's a talented baker and makes some delicious bread. Just let him know that you want a bag and bread loaves.'

You then head to Jarlen Meadowgreen in South Karana. He is with the group of centaurs that hands out the crafted armor quests and circulates between standing near his brothers and checking his bread rising by the large fire pit (the text while he is checking this is rather amusing.)

Hail him and say, 'I am here to pick up some bread loaves.'

Jarlen Meadowgreen says 'So, ya want some of my bread is that it? Well, you've come to the right place I'd say. My brothers told me the market was ripe for that sort of thing so I decided to move on over here. Anyway, hand over two gold pieces and I'll give ya a sack of bread made by me own two hands.'

Give him 2 gold and you get a Bag of Bread Loaves (LORE NO DROP.)

Bag of Bread Loaves can also be found in RunnyEye Citadel off goblins and Sporali in the moldy area.

Return and give to Beth Breadmaker.

Beth Breadmaker says 'Oh, wonderful fresh bread! Thank you for making the trip, that is such a long way. Here, I hope this covers your travel expenses. You have my deepest thanks.'

• Your faction standing with Merchants of Erudin got better.
• Your faction standing with High Council of Erudin got better.
• Your faction standing with High Guard of Erudin got better.

You gain experience.

You receive 1 platinum, 7 gold from Beth Breadmaker.

Experience was approximately 2% as a level 19 Druid.

You say, 'I can get you loaves of bread.'
(note that responding to 'muffins' gives a different quest)

Innkeep Morpa says 'You go to Plains of Karana. You look for Jarlen Meadowgreen. You tells him dat you there to get Bread Loaves for us. Weeze pay you when you get back. Tanks.'

You then head to Jarlen Meadowgreen in South Karana. He is with the group of centaurs that hands out the crafted armor quests and circulates between standing near his brothers and checking his bread rising by the large fire pit (the text while he is checking this is rather amusing.)

Jarlen Meadowgreen says 'So, ya want some of my bread is that it? Well, you've come to the right place I'd say. My brothers told me the market was ripe for that sort of thing so I decided to move on over here. Anyway, hand over two gold pieces and I'll give ya a sack of bread made by me own two hands.'

Give him 2 gold and you get a Bag of Bread Loaves (LORE NO DROP.)

Bag of Bread Loaves can also be found in RunnyEye Citadel off goblins and Sporali in the moldy area.

Return and give to Innkeep Morpa.

Innkeep Morpa says 'You nice for getting bread loaves for us. You take some money. Weeze happy now dat weeze got more bread for sale. You maybe check back later if weeze run out of bread again.'

• Your faction standing with Clurg got better. (+3)

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Speak to Gretta Mottle in Irontoe's Eats in Kaladim.

Note: Gretta spawns during the day and is replaced with Buggle Palkin at night.

The conversation with Gretta Mottle:

You say, 'Hail, Gretta Mottle'

Gretta Mottle says, 'Greetings, Zokkor. I'm Gretta Mottle. Tumpy has been kind enough to let me to set up my bakery in his fine establishment here. Unfortunately, with that nasty plague corruptin' the crops in the Plains of Karana, things are goin' a bit slow for me. I keep runnin' out of bread and muffins to sell. Because of flour bein' easily spoiled now, it takes longer to make 'em just right. My assistant Buggle is still learnin' how to cook. Hehe.. All he can make is Meat Pie. If I don't get any [help to bake] soon I won't be able to keep the supply up with the demand.'

You say, 'help to bake'

Gretta Mottle says, 'Glad to hear it. Are ye thinkin' of helpin' me to [bake muffins] or did ye want to [fetch some bread] for me?'

You say, 'fetch some bread'
(note that responding to 'bake muffins' gives a different quest)

Gretta Mottle says, 'The only one who can make bread almost as good as I can is Jarlen Meadowgreen. He lives a long way off though.. in the southern Plains of Karana. If ye travel there, tell him that you are there to pick up some bread loaves for me.'

You then head to Jarlen Meadowgreen in South Karana. He is with the group of centaurs that hands out the crafted armor quests and circulates between standing near his brothers and checking his bread rising by the large fire pit (the text while he is checking this is rather amusing.)

Hail him and say, 'I am here to pick up some bread loaves.'

Jarlen Meadowgreen says 'So, ya want some of my bread is that it? Well, you've come to the right place I'd say. My brothers told me the market was ripe for that sort of thing so I decided to move on over here. Anyway, hand over two gold pieces and I'll give ya a sack of bread made by me own two hands.'

Give him 2 gold and you get a Bag of Bread Loaves (LORE NO DROP.)

Bag of Bread Loaves can also be found in RunnyEye Citadel off goblins and Sporali in the moldy area.

Return and give to Beth Breadmaker.

Gretta Mottle says, 'Well now, what do we have here? You actually went out of your way to fetch bread for me? Thank ye so kindly. Please accept this as payment for your service.'

• Your faction standing with Merchants of Kaladim got better.
• Your faction standing with Storm Guard got better.
• Your faction standing with Miners Guild 628 got worse.
• Your faction standing with Miners Guild 249 got better.
• Your faction standing with Kazon Stormhammer got better.

Gretta despawns after turn in, but respawns about a minute later.

He has a large supply of grain and we have been authorized to secure shipments of bread loaves from this individual. Tell him you are there to secure of shipment of bread loaves for the people of Neriak. You shall be compensated upon your return.'

Give him 2 gold and you get a Bag of Bread Loaves (LORE NO DROP.)

You say, 'I am a baker'

You say, 'I will pick up a shipment of bread'

Go look him up and tell him you want a bag of bread loaves. He's one of those fellas that goes by the name of Meadowgreen.

Voleen gives almost the same information, and identifies the person as Jarlen Meadowgreen in South Karana. He is with the group of centaurs that hands out the crafted armor quests and circulates between standing near his brothers and checking his bread rising by the large fire pit (the text while he is checking this is rather amusing.)

Hail him and say, 'I am here to pick up some bread loaves.'

Jarlen Meadowgreen says 'So, ya want some of my bread is that it? Well, you've come to the right place I'd say. My brothers told me the market was ripe for that sort of thing so I decided to move on over here. Anyway, hand over two gold pieces and I'll give ya a sack of bread made by me own two hands.'

Give him 2 gold and you get a Bag of Bread Loaves (LORE NO DROP.)

Bag of Bread Loaves is now only found in RunnyEye Citadel off goblins and Sporali.

Return and give to Karn (or Voleen)

Karn Tassen says 'Ah finally, fresh bread! All right let me get this on the shelves right away. Here is your payment.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Weligon Steelherder is located at -1040, -380 in Erudin.

It appears you need better than Indifferent faction, likely Amiable, for final turn-in

You say, 'Hail, Weligon Steelherder'

Weligon Steelherder says 'Hail, ______! This is the Deepwater Temple. Here you shall find the wisdom and courage of Prexus, the Ocean Lord. I am glad to see you have an interest. Forgive me if I cut our conversation short, but I have many [Deepwater tasks] to complete.'

You say, 'What Deepwater tasks?'

Weligon Steelherder says 'We here at the Deepwater Temple must tend to the [Peacekeeper battlestaff] and the [Deepwater harpoon] as well as other duties such as [ocean protection]. There is always something we must do.'

You say, 'What Deepwater harpoon?'

Weligon Steelherder says 'We do not award the Deepwater harpoon to just any paladin. Nobility is all well and good, but you must still prove yourself. We must shield ourselves from the savage and evil ways of the other races. They say that a list exists. A list of three grand architects who wish to see this bridge erected. You will venture to Qeynos and find the list, then exterminate these three men. Return the list along with their heads and the Deepwater Harpoon is yours. Go | '

Hansl Bigroon says 'My grand plan has always been to erect a bridge which would span the distance between Qeynos and Odus. It would bypass the city of Erudin. Antonius Bayle would take full control of the bridge and its adjacent territories. This has had some opposition in Erudin, but for the most part, they just believe it is impossible to build such a bridge.'

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
If you kill Dorn B'Dynn, on occasion a dark elf spy will appear and head towards the zone. Interestingly, Dorn says something along the lines of "I can no longer
hold this form" when he dies and the faction changes are different, so I think you actually killing a Dorn imposter. You should have sow on at this point because he runs pretty fast. Catch
him and kill him and his body will crumble to dust and a spider-like critter will spring forth and head to the zone at a very fast clip. Killing this creature gets you the Charasis Tome. The tome gives you background on the dungeon Charisis (Howling Stones) and some clues on how to get the key to enter. There is little practical reason to do this.

sections.heading: Walkthrough

At amiable faction:

You say, 'Hail, Opal Darkbriar'

Opal Darkbriar says, 'Greetings! You will have to excuse me. I have no time to talk right now and I prefer to be left alone. Please leave.'

The following text is directly copied from ZAM. [http://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=730]

This ultimately leads to the creation of the Wand of the Burning Dead. My details are still sketchy.

Talk to Opal Darkbriar in the Freeport tunnels and ask her about the wand. She needs three things to help assemble the broken wand.

• The first is Marnek's Wand of the Burning Dead, which can be found in the bottom level of Befallen.
• The second is the Sapphire of Souls, which can be found in Najena
• I am not sure what the third is. A post on Allah's mentions a "Burning Prince's Blessing"

Bring these to Opal and you should get the wand. You need a very high faction to get this quest.

The Sapphire of Souls is speculated to be the Blackened Sapphire, while Marnek's Wand of the Burning Dead is speculated to be the Blackened Wand. Simply returning both items to Opal with kindly faction results in no reward.

sections.heading: Red Sash Quest clues
sections.text:
These speculations are probably based primarily on the dialog within the Red Sash of Order quest as follows: [http://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=592]

Reyia Beslin may be found at -154, -1502, -137.

You say, 'Hail, Reyia Beslin'

Reyia Beslin says 'Greetings, ______. I am Reyia Beslin of the Ashen Order. I help to train our members and I am in charge of handing out the orange and red Sashes of Order. Would you like to know [how you can get an orange sash]? Or maybe you think you are ready to earn the [red sash]?'

You say, 'I think I am ready to earn the red sash.'

Reyia Beslin says 'So, you think you are skilled enough to earn the red Sash of Order, ______? I have just the [task] for you then. But be warned, this will be the toughest challenge you have faced yet. There are many legends and myths of great heroes and ancient evils from all over Norrath. Here in Freeport, we get travelers from all over the world, and we get their tales as well. The point is that most of these stories are just that, stories and fairy tales. Told to amuse people and frighten children. I also thought the tales I'd heard about the [Marnek Jaull] were only legends, but now I know better.'

You say, 'What task?'

Reyia Beslin says 'I've heard a few legends of a powerful wand that Marnek himself used to wield. This was known as the wand of the Burning Dead, and was rumored to instill its owner with mystical energies. The legends I have heard all differed on the wand's creation and powers, but the basic story was always the same. I will [tell you the legend] if you like. The task I have for you is to bring me the two parts that make up the wand of the Burning Dead, before they can be assembled and used for evil once again. Bring me [Marnek's wand] and the [Sapphire of Souls], along with your orange sash, and you will have proven yourself a loyal member of the Ashen Order, worthy of receiving the red sash.'

You say, 'Who is Marnek Jauli?'

Reyia Beslin says 'Marnek Jaull led a cult of necromancers who followed the Burning Prince, Solusek Ro. He built an army, known as the Burning Dead, and spread destruction and fire throughout Antonica. Over the years, the Burning Dead fought many fierce and bloody battles with the paladins of Prexus, the Oceanlord. Though Marnek achieved many victories over the paladins, ultimately they were able to defeat him and destroy the Burning Dead. Legends say that before his defeat, Marnek created many powerful weapons and items, and wrote many books on his findings in the areas of magic. Many of these items were hidden away from the paladin forces, and remain untouched, waiting for Marnek's return, as the legends go.'

You say, 'What is Marnek's wand?'

Reyia Beslin says 'Marnek's wand is rumored to be found in the depths of Befallen. Those who currently hold Befallen are said to be new followers of the Burning Dead. Probably believing that they may one day be able to awaken the evil Marnek again. This group must be stopped, and these evil items destroyed, before their wicked armies grow powerful enough to leave their horrible dungeon and spread throughout Antonica.'

You say, 'What is the Sapphire of Souls?'

Reyia Beslin says 'The Sapphire of Souls is rumored to be held by a thief in Najena. No one knows how this guy obtained the sapphire, but we believe he is trying to strike a bargain with those who are currently holding Befallen. Apparently, we aren't the only ones who know of the wand's powers, and this thief thinks he can make a profit from it. Sadly, his greed will surely lead to his death.'

You say, 'Tell me the legend.'

Reyia Beslin says 'The legend of the wand of the Burning Dead goes basically like this, though you may hear slighty different versions from others. Marnek did a lot of experiments and created an unknown number of diabolical artifacts and weapons. One of his creations was this wand. Marnek fashioned a charred wand from the scorched bone of a paladin of Prexus, and Solusek Ro himself created the wretched Sapphire of Souls. Then, Marnek and his priests combined these, with the Burning Prince's blessing, to create the wand of the Burning Dead. Marnek used this Wand and its powers in his evil and destructive reign over Antonica. Years later, as Marnek starting losing battles to the paladins of Prexus, one of his own followers, a necromancer named Kenox, was able to steal the wand. Sensing Marnek's defeat, Kenox made his way toward Odus, hoping to strike a deal with the paladins for the wand. Would you like me to [tell you about Kenox]?'

You say, 'I would like you to tell me about Kenox.'

Reyia Beslin says 'Well, Kenox was not as sly as he liked to think he was. Marnek knew full well what he was up to, but let him continue with his plans. Kenox had arranged to meet with two paladins late one nght on a small island in Erud's Crossing, a place that would be considered neutral ground. Sir Toran Neshal, leader of the paladins, knowing the power of the wand, was certainly not going to make any deals with a servant of Solusek Ro, and definitely not foolish enough to take any chances with this mission. Imagine the look on Kenox's face when a ship carrying more than 25 paladins, including Sir Toran, arrived at the small island! The paladins immediately captured Kenox and the wand, and headed back to Erudin. Would like me to [tell you what happened to Toran]?'

You say, 'Tell me what happened to Toran.'

Reyia Beslin says 'Below the deck of the ship, Toran and his men questioned Kenox and carefully inspected the wand. Toran ordered one of his men to pick up the wand and try to identify its true powers. The man picked up the wand, but was unable to decipher its magic. He handed it to Toran, just as Marnek and Solusek had hoped, and the wand exploded, instantly incinerating the ship and everyone aboard, and lighting up the night sky with a giant fireball. Marnek's plan had succeeded. With the help and blessing of the Burning Prince, they had destroyed Sir Toran and an entire squad of Prexus' finest paladins. Years later, though, the paladins were able to regroup and ultimately defeat Marnek. The wand of the Burning Dead was destroyed and gone forever. Or least, that's what we thought. This wand must never be allowed to be made whole again.'

Marnek's wand is the Blackened Wand (identifies as "Marnek's Wand"), dropped by Priest Amiaz in Befallen (-487.77, 89.39, -76.61). The Sapphire of Souls is the Blackened Sapphire (identifies as "Sapphire of Souls"), dropped by Ekeros in Najena (-161, -47, -22). Bring them back along with your Orange Sash of Order. You'll need to be at least kindly faction to Ashen Order to finish the quest.

Reyia Beslin says 'Great job, ______! Congratulations. With the destruction of these evil items, the wand of the Burning Dead will never bring harm to anyone on Norrath again. It is my honor to present to you, on behalf of Master Closk and the Ashen Order, the red sash. May Quellious be with you always.'

You receive the Red Sash of Order

sections.text:
This quest begins with Rihtur Fullome located at (357, -450) in the Qeynos Aqueducts.

You say, 'Hail, Rihtur Fullome'

Rihtur Fullome says, 'Hail, _______! I hope the trek into our shrine has not scared you in any way. Our defenses have been increased lately. Many of the citizens have heard rumors about our shrine. I say it is all due to that [soldier].'

You say, 'What soldier?'

Rihtur Fullome says, 'The soldier I refer to is Commander Kane Bayle. The supreme officer himself. Don't get me wrong, I trust Kane. He has quite a black heart. I just don't trust that girl, [Nerissa].'

You say, 'Who is Nerissa?'

Rihtur Fullome says, 'Nerissa Clothspinner. Her sister was a good friend of Kane's. When she left Qeynos to venture into the world, she asked Kane to watch over that girl. Now Kane tries to hide from the child the fact that he is allied with our church. I do not think he has hidden it well. I have told the others, but they do not believe me. I do not care. I have my own [plans].'

You say, 'What plans?'

Rihtur Fullome says, 'Nerissa is well protected by Kane. She will no doubt attempt to inform someone of her suspicions, most likely her sister, Milea. You must find Milea Clothspinner and kill her. No word of our operations must leak out. Return with proof of Milea's death and we shall see to a reward.'

From here, you can speak to Nerissa for hints as to her whereabouts.

You may also complete Nerissa's quest to receive the Monogrammed Cloth to turn in.

Milea can be found in East Karana. For the sake of being evil, we choose to kill her.

You loot a Monogrammed Cloth.

You return to Rihtur Fullome and hand him the Monogrammed Cloth.

Rihtur Fullome says, 'You have done a truly wicked deed. Good work! Milea was a prestigious member of the Hall fo Steel and a friend fo the Knights of Truth. It is better that she now fertilizes the flowers of the Plains of Karana. Here. A fitting reward for such a deed.'

Nesiff Tallaherd says 'Oh dear. I hope my mistake will not bring too much grief down on poor Weleth. He was told not to order arrows from me after the last time I fouled up their shipment. But Weleth knew I needed the account to stay in business. Could you please rush this new invoice to him right away? Thank you.'

• Your faction standing with Merchants of Qeynos got better.
• Your faction standing with Circle Of Unseen Hands got worse.
• Your faction standing with Antonius Bayle got better.
• Your faction standing with Coalition of Tradefolk got better.
• Your faction standing with Guards of Qeynos got better.

You gain experience.

You receive A Slip of Parchment (identifies as "Invoice-Nesiff's Wooden Weapons"). It reads:

INVOICE - NESIFF'S WOODEN WEAPONS
QEYNOS: 19 CRATES
LONG FLIGHT ARROWS
36 GP CREDIT OF 1 GP AND 9 SP REMAINING DUE TO DEFECTIVE CRATE
CUSTOMER: WELETH, ON BEHALF OF QEYNOS MILITIA

Give the slip of parchment to Guard Weleth.

Guard Weleth says 'Thank you so much for the favor. Please be careful here in Qeynos. I have come to suspect that even some of my fellow guards are not to be trusted - Lieutenant Dagarok, for one.'

• Your faction standing with Guards of Qeynos got better.
• Your faction standing with Antonius Bayle got better.
• Your faction standing with Corrupt Qeynos Guards got worse.
• Your faction standing with Circle Of Unseen Hands got worse.
• Your faction standing with Merchants of Qeynos got better.

You gain experience.

You receive 4 copper from Guard Weleth.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Note: This quest requires better than indifferent faction. Keep in mind for low level characters especially, while running around, these donations weigh 10.0 each and you need to collect 6

This is a good faction quest. Daedet Losaren, in the Temple of Thunder, gives you a donation box and asks you to find six residents of Qeynos to donate to the temple. Here's a list of where to get the six donations:

1) Lanhern Firepride - Only at night when she is in Fish's bar. Give her four ogre swills for one (and the following faction changes):

• Your faction standing with Merchants of Qeynos has gotten better.
• Your faction standing with Circle Of Unseen Hands has gotten worse.
• Your faction standing with Antonius Bayle has gotten better.
• Your faction standing with Coalition of Tradefolk has gotten better.
• Your faction standing with Guards of Qeynos has gotten better.

2) Hansl Bigroon - Either at his house, or the office of the people;

3) Kane Bayle - Guard House;

4) Enic Ruklin - Temple of Life;

5) Guard Leopold - Qeynos Hills, wanders;

6) Guard Cheslin - Qeynos Hills, wanders - Frequently dead.

There are other people who respond to "donation", but don't seem to cough one up: The cloth armor salesperson in front of the Lion Mane Inn and Tavern (she says to go away) in South Qeynos. The two gents who make bags in North Qeynos. A bard in the Bard's guild (says he donates to his own cause) in South Qeynos. Also in South Qeynos, a merchant by the Grounds of Fate who only makes three things, axes I believe. He laughs because of the taxes being so high. Oh, so do the bag makers.

Your reward is usually a spell scroll. When you turn in the combined box the following factions change:

• Your faction standing with Knights of Thunder has gotten better.
• Your faction standing with Bloodsabers has gotten worse.
• Your faction standing with Priests of Life has gotten better.
• Your faction standing with Guards of Qeynos has gotten better.

Note that the donations weigh 10 each, so prepare to become encumbered during the quest.

Need all dialogues, current faction hits, /loc of quest mobs.

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
Oggok
Quest Giver:
Marda
Minimum Level:
5
Classes:
All
Related Zones:
Innothule Swamp
Related NPCs:
Slayer Captain, a troll slayer

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest begins with Marda in the Shaman guild hall of Oggok, #1 on the map.

You say, 'Hail, Marda'

Marda says 'Welcome to intelligence, young Tumytuk! Did you think all ogres were inept? Ha | I hope you show the glimmer, we shamans need more within our ranks. Our race needs to evolve | So, are you one of the smart ogres or have I spoken too many syllables?'

You say, 'I am one of the smart ogres'

Marda says 'Well, I suppose your intelligence shall grow. You will have to do. I have a mission for you. First, go and speak with Grevak of the Greenblood Knights. He will have a job for you. After you have performed some manner of service and advanced at least 5 ranks, return to me and ask me about my secret mission.'

Even though the text leads to Grevak, you do not need to do his quests, you simply need to be level 5 or higher and ask Marda about the secret mission:

You say, 'What secret mission?'

Marda says 'I have heard of your advancements. You are a fine addition to Oggok. I require your skill in handling a delicate matter. I want you to run out to the Bouncer's keep near the entrance to Oggok. There, you shall find a froglok named Glib. He will pose no threat to you. He has come on business and I have promised him protection. Tell him the Greenblood shaman sent you. He shall fill you in. Go at once.'

If she does not respond to this key phrase, Emissary Glib will not spawn! In this case, attempt the following respawn command.

You say, 'Where is Emissary Glib?'

Marda says, 'He has just entered Oggok, from what I hear. He should be where you last met him.'

After she has spoken these words, Emissary Glib spawns at the top of the guard tower (#10 on the map). Emissary Glib will take in the view from the tower for perhaps two minutes then walk downstairs, saunter to the Feerrott zoneline and despawn. A single /hail him will stop him for approximately a minute and it is possible to /hail-lock him near the zoneline where no guards path. Once a valid player triggers him with Marda, anyone else can /hail him and hand in necklaces as he appears Indifferent to all races and classes.

NOTE: As a wood-elf druid in dark-elf illusion (Guise), I was dubious to Marda (and not kos to any of the other ogres in the vicinity). When I hailed Marda, she did not respond, but when I spoke the words 'Where is Emissary Glib?' she did respond and Glib did spawn.

You say, 'Hail, Emissary Glib'

Emissary Glib `Gloop.. Are you the one? Who sent you?'

You say, 'The Greenblood Shaman sent me'

Emissary Glib 'Gloop.. Good. I am the secret emissary of the frogloks of Guk. I have come to help your community, provided, that is, that you help mine. Gloop.. I want you to track down and kill the troll hunters called 'slayers.' They are capturing our foragers in the swamps. Return their slayer necklaces to me and I shall pay you, but most important, find the slayer captain. Bring me his captain's necklace and I shall give you a secret. I must leave soon. If you need me, just ask Marda where I am.'

The slayer necklaces are tradeable, not lore and drop off either a troll slayer (rewarded with minor coin only) or Slayer Captain (coin and one of the above listed rewards) in Innothule Swamp. Both versions are called Frog Eye Necklace (but Identify differently.) See Slayer Captain for spawn and placeholder info.

sections.heading: Slayer Necklace
sections.text:
Upon handing in a Frog Eye Necklace (lore: Troll Slayer Necklace) to Glib:

Emissary Glib says '.. Good work. That is one less troll slayer. My people shall learn of your good deed. Please search for the slayer captain. He must be stopped.'

• Your faction standing with Oggok Citizens got better. +1

You gain experience.

You receive 7 silver from Emissary Glib.

sections.heading: Captain Necklace
sections.text:
Upon handing in a Frog Eye Necklace (lore: Troll Slayer Capt. Necklace) to Glib:

Emissary Glib says 'Oooh | .. You have dispatched the slayer captain. It will take them time to reorganize the slayers. During this time the froglok foragers can gather more provisions for Guk. Please take this as a token of my people's appreciation. Your standing with my brethren has grown. As for Marda's information.. within Grobb lies my aide, Groak. He was captured. Tell him Glib sent you.'

• Your faction standing with Oggok Citizens got better. +2

You gain experience.

You receive 1 silver from Emissary Glib.

You receive a random item, which could include the Forager Bag or Hopper Spear.

Handing in the Captain's necklace leads you into the Marda's Secret Mission quest.

46

sections.heading: Checklist
sections.text:
• Pulsating Hyacinth Telesm
• White Gold Necklace from a A froglok noble in Lower Guk.
• Crystalline Orb from a stone spider in Nagafen's Lair.
• Bloodied Piece of Parchment
• Obtain a Prickly Pear from a an icy terror, Lady Vox's guardians in Permafrost.
• Give the Prickly Pear to Xenyari Lisariel for Bloodied Piece of Parchment at the druid ring (5298, 1765).
• Faceted Hyacinth
• Give 2,000pp to Kazzel D`Leryt to receive an Uncut Hyacinth.
• Give 1,000pp and Uncut Hyacinth to Darfumpel Zirubbel to receive the Faceted Hyacinth.
• Turn in White Gold Necklace, Crystalline Orb, Bloodied Piece of Parchment, Faceted Hyacinth to Kazzel D`Leryt and receive Faceted Hyacinth Telesm
• Give Faceted Hyacinth Telesm to Xenyari Lisariel for Pulsating Hyacinth Telesm

• Return the Pulsating Hyacinth Telesm to Kazzel D`Leryt to spawn monstrous zombie.
• Kill monstrous zombie and loot Monstrous Zombie Heart
• Give the Monstrous Zombie Heart to Kazzel D`Leryt for Spell: Life Leech.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest is for the level 47 Shadow Knight spell Life Leech.

It begins with Kazzel D`Leryt in the Mountains of Rathe (roams around -634, -1561 from #24 on map to hill between #22 and #23), who will not speak with you unless you are at least level 46.

He tells players to give him 2,000pp in exchange for an Uncut Hyacinth to be etched by a gnome shopkeeper named Darfumpel Zirubbel (also in the Mountains of Rathe (4093, 896) #5 on map). He tells you the gnome does not like the necromantic arts, so you will have to conceal your identity when dealing with him. Darfumppel appears to be indifferent to good and evil characters. There are some good guards nearby, but they are green to a level 50. Karam Dragonforge gives out the dragonscale armor quests and may be in the same hut, but he is a vendor, so will not aggro unless provoked.

Kazzel tells you to bring back:

• Faceted Hyacinth.
• "A gold necklace like the purest snow" (the White Gold Necklace from a A froglok noble in Lower Guk).
• "An orb of the purest crystal" (the Crystalline Orb from a stone spider in Nagafen's Lair).
• "The blood of Xenyari Lisariel the druid." He tells you that the blood must be voluntarily given by Xenyari Lisariel, so killing her will not suffice.
• Xenyari Lisariel can be found at the druid ring (5298, 1765). She roams around the mesa the unkempt druid ring is on, and stops where Tabien the Goodly spawns (6350, 1500).

To get a Faceted Hyacinth (MAGIC ITEM, is tradeable) start by giving 2000p to Kazzel D`Leryt to receive an Uncut Hyacinth:

Kazzel D`Leryt says, 'Very well, Mazirian. Take this gem to a master jeweler and return it to me with the other three items.'

You receive an Uncut Hyacinth.

Give this, along with 1,000pp, to Darfumpel Zirubbel to receive the Faceted Hyacinth:

Darfumpel Zirubbel says, 'I have not seen a gem such as this in quite some time! It was not since I dabbled in a bit of necro? Wait? What are you going to use this for? Never mind. I do not wish to know. Here, take your gem and leave!'

You receive a Faceted Hyacinth.

To get the blood, you must bring Xenyari Lisariel a Prickly Pear. The Prickly Pear drops off of an icy terror, one of Lady Vox's guardians in Permafrost. As it is edible, be careful and place it deep in your inventory or you might eat it before you return it. As you hand in the pear:

Xenyari Lisariel says, 'Prickly Pears! I just love Prickly Pears | Thank you so much for getting these for me. I really, really appreciate your gift and I shall not... OWW | I hate when I stick myself with the needles! Oh look, I am bleeding now! *Sigh*. Can you hold this note for a moment, please? My hands are full and I must clean up.'

You receive a Bloodied Piece of Parchment.

Take the Hyacinth, parchment, necklace, and orb to Kazzel. In exchange, he gives you a Faceted Hyacinth Telesm:

Kazzel D`Leryt says, 'You are quite cunning. After I fashion this telesm, take it back to Xenyari. She would 'enjoy' another 'gift,' eh?'

You receive a Faceted Hyacinth Telesm.

Give this item to Xenyari. Upon receiving this, she will be struck dead and the Faceted Hyacinth Telesm will be changed into a Pulsating Hyacinth Telesm:

Xenyari Lisariel bounces around with glee at the sight of your gift, smiles at you, and dons the telesm. As she clasps the telesm around her neck, she begins to write in agony, and slowly fades from sight leavign just the telesm, which is now pulsating with vibrant energy.

You receive a Pulsating Hyacinth Telesm.

Take the Pulsating Hyacinth Telesm to Kazzel. On handing it in, a level 53 giant skeleton called "monstrous zombie" spawns and attacks:

Kazzel D`Leryt laughs heartily and whispers to you, 'Well done, worm, your servitude to my will has now expired...'

Kill it, loot a Monstrous Zombie Heart, and give it to Kazzel to receive your spell Spell: Life Leech:

Kazzel D`Leryt says, 'Oh! Umm... Well, I was just playing with you. Certainly you know I was joking! We had a deal and I will abide by the terms of our agreement. HHere is my payment for your services. Bye...'

You receive Spell: Life Leech.

This spell is DROPPABLE

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:

Northern Felwithe
Quest Giver:
General Jyleel

22

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest is offered after you complete the Orc runner quest.

You need will need high faction (kindly is sufficient) to do this quest. Speak with the Paladin guildmaster, Lord Jyleel, in the basement of the Paladin guild. He wants you to prove yourself a faithful Paladin of the court.

General Jyleel says, 'So, the Teir'Dal are behind the recent advances of the orcs? | Your news has shed light on their union. It is time to step forth and prove yourself a [faithful paladin of this court].'

You say, 'I am a faithful paladin of this court'

General Jyleel says, 'I command you to seek out this Ambassor D’Vinn and rip his heart from his lifeless body. Next, find the supreme caster of the orcs and, finally, find the spot where supplies are dropped by the Teir’Dal for the orcs. There you should find the supply crate. Return all 3 items and you shall wield the falchion.'

• The Black Heart of Ambassador Dvinn (found in Crushbone)

• Blue Orc Head (from the Orc Prophet in Crushbone)

• A Large Locked Crate (dropped by Brawn in the Ocean of Tears - about 22nd level - on the rocks with the Sirens just as you enter the Ocean of Tears from Antonica).

Bring the items back to Jyleel.

General Jylell says, 'A noble deed has been done and the alliance of evil has been stalled. I present you with the falchion of the Koada’Vie. You are now an honorable member of our order. Hail Felwithe! May you defend her with honor.'

• Your faction standing with Clerics of Tunare has been adjusted by 9.
• Your faction standing with King Tearis Thex has been adjusted by 9.

You gain experience.

Receive Falchion of the Koada`Vie.

sections.heading: Quest details
sections.text:
Start Zone:
Kael Drakkel
Quest Giver:
Bjoskhua Blackfist
Minimum Level:
50
Classes:
Cleric, Druid, Enchanter, Magician, Necromancer, Shaman, Wizard
Related Zones:
Kedge Keep
Related NPCs:
Phinigel Autropos

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, 'hail Bjoskhua Blackfist'

Bjoskhua Blackfist's lips do not move, though your mind is filled with a voice. 'What is it you want, mortal? I have little patience for those who do not come here to study.'

You say, 'i wish to study'

Bjoskhua Blackfist looks you over and his voice invades your mind again. 'What is it you wish to study?'

You say, 'who is clrakk?'

Bjoskhua Blackfist says 'Clrakk is my youngest brother. He walks a path of shadows and deceit. If he were to battle, it would not be one without weapons or armor. I may use these as a bargaining chip some day. I do not think my family has any more need of these old chest straps.

You say, 'what chest straps?'

Bjoskhua Blackfist says 'The chest straps are simply a status symbol to some gladiators and warriors. They are passed down from generation to generation. When a warrior enters one of these contests of the fist, they wear the chest straps of their family. My family was awarded a set of the enchanted chest straps ages ago. None of my brothers save Clrakk would even consider entering the contest.

You say, 'what contests of the fist?'

Bjoskhua Blackfist says 'Ages ago there was a race of fish men named the Kedge. Prexus spread them throughout the waters of the world and they were prosperous. Rumors abound that even near the waters of velious they had great cities. All at once they seemed to be wiped from the face of Norrath. One of the travelers I recently spoke to informed me that a single Kedge may still live in the lands of Faydwer. As grotesque as it sounds, the backbone of a Kedge may be used to create indestructible scroll cases. Bring me the backbone of this fishman, if he exists, and you will find yourself a richer person.'

Bring him back the backbone of Phinigel Autropos from Kedge (yes, the backbone also used in the bard epic):

Bjoskhua Blackfist says 'Excellent, I guess his entire race is now wiped from Norrath. This will indeed make a wonderful scroll case. I am a giant of my word. Take your prized item and be gone, you greedy little beast!'

Need all dialogues, current faction hits if any, /loc of Bjoskhua Blackfist, info on other quest rewards if any, minimum faction required to get quest, etc.

sections.heading: Checklist
sections.text:
See also: Zimel's Blades (SoulFire), The Sword of Nobility, & Tome of Ages

You'll need Warmly or higher Deepwater Knights faction for the turn ins.

• Swords
• Obtain a Ghoulbane
• Obtain a SoulFire
• Tome of Ages
• Obtain the Torn, burnt book
• Obtain the Torn, Frost covered book
• Turn in 1000pp and the books to Rysva To`Biath or Rineval Talyas to obtain Book of Scale
• Miragul's Robe and Head
• Turn in Book of Scale to Oracle of K`Arnon to obtain Miragul's Phylactery
• Hand Miragul's Phylactery to the Lich of Miragul to spawn Miragul
• Obtain Miragul's Robe and Miragul's Head by killing Miragul- Only to whoever turned in the Phylactery!
• Final hand-in to Inte Akera
• Obtain access to Island 4 (Pegasus Island) of Plane of Sky, this requires several keys.
• In the Plane of Sky Efreeti room, give [Dason Goldblade]] 500pp to spawn Inte Akera -- Doing so will spawn Inte Akera in the Windmill on Island 4. Inte is a Deepwater Knight of Prexus and will unleash the Oceanlord's fury upon those deemed 'evil' in their eyes -- including your raid. Inte Akera only stays up for a few minutes which is why you need to have access to Island 4 ahead of time. You can use invisibility to run up to Island 4 after spawning him.
• Give Inte Akera the Soulfire ALONE for the Blessing of Nobility. Warmly Faction Needed
• Give Inte Akera the Ghoulbane ALONE for the Blessing of Sacrifice. Warmly Faction Needed
• Give Inte Akera the head, robe, and both blessings (TOGETHER) for the :Fiery Avenger. Warmly Faction Needed

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Your final turn-in will consist of SoulFire, Ghoulbane, and Miragul's Robe and Miragul's Head. Note that even though the quest technically begins in Plane of Sky, there is no need to speak with Inte Akera before you have all the items ready to hand in. Also note that Inte Akera is a Deepwater Knight, and you need high faction with Erudite Paladins. It would be wise to have sufficient faction as well before going to Sky.

How to acquire the Head and Robe of Miragul is as follows:

Collect the Torn, burnt book and the Torn, Frost covered book from named dragons (Lord Nagafen, Talendor, and Severilous will drop the burnt book, and Vox, Gorenaire, and Faydedar will drop the frost book)

Rysva To`Biath, a bartender downstairs in the Blind Fish Tavern of Neriak Commons will combine them into the Book of Scale for 1000pp. Simply hand both half books and 1000pp to her.

Alternately, Rineval Talyas is in the North Qeynos newbie yard for good-aligned characters who don't wish to delve into Neriak.

Rysva To`Biath says, 'Phagh! This is not enough. Get out of my sight!'
Rysva To`Biath says, 'Phagh! This is not enough. Get out of my sight!'
Rysva To`Biath says, 'Know this now... I will not be helping your people soon enough. I suggest looking for another to aide you in this process. I hear that there is a woman known as Rineval who may be able to help you in the future. I have done what you asked, now begone from this place, I can bear your stink no longer.'

Alternately:

Rineval Talyas says, 'Take this book quickly and tell no one about this.'

You gain experience.

You receive the Book of Scale.

• Note: since the combined book of scale is tradeable it could be purchased as well.
• note: You *DO NOT* need to do any faction work whatsoever to successfully complete this turn-in.
• note: If you invis to her in Neriak, Rsyva faces away and approached from the back for turn-in.

Give Book of Scale to Oracle of K`Arnon in exchange for Miragul's Phylactery:

Oracle of K`Arnon says, 'Unbelievable! The legendary Book of Scale is mine! Please, take this as a small token of my thanks. I warn you, however, if you ever manage to join the corporeal body to the evil that resides within, you will rue the day.'

• Your faction standing with Oracle of K`Arnon has been adjusted by 10.
• Your faction standing with Oracle of Marud has been adjusted by -10.

You gain experience.

You receive the Miragul's Phylactery.

In the underwater ice caves of northern Everfrost find the Lich of Miragul, whic has a long spawn time, but does spawn on zone creation, so if it's not up you can create a new instance and it should be available in the caves. Turn in Miragul's Phylactery to the lich to spawn the true Miragul (53 necro)! Kill him to get Miragul's Head and Miragul's Robe.

PLEASE NOTE that only the character that turned in the Phylactery can receive the Head and Robe from Miragul!

Spawn Inte Akera (Plane of Sky, 4th isle) by giving 500p to Dason Goldblade in the quest cave and returning the book you are handed.

Inte Akera will spawn inside the windmill on isle 4 and despawn after FIVE minutes. He is a Deepwater Knight and will aggro anyone on the entire island who is KoS to erudite paladins. If you have any evils or people kos to erudite paladins for whatever reason, they should stay on 3 until Inte fully despawns.

Due to Inte's 5 minute despawn timer, you should have a friend waiting in the quest room while you run to the windmill. Do not (have your friend) turn in the 500p until you are in the windmill on island 4 and ready for the turn in. You'll also need Warmly or higher Deepwater Knight faction for the turn ins. Confirmed 7/17/23 kindly faction will eat the items.

Confirmed as of 28/12/21 very beginning of warmly with Deepwater Knights is enough faction to turn in with Inte Akera

Hand in your items SEPARATELY as so:

• SoulFire ALONE for the Blessing of Nobility

• Ghoulbane ALONE for the Blessing of Sacrifice

Now, hand in the head, robe, and both blessings TOGETHER for the Fiery Avenger.

8

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Antus Shelbra can be found on the third floor of the Abattoir at (762, 829) in Paineel. Minimum faction is unknown, but kindly is sufficient.

You say, 'Hail, Antus Shelbra'

Antus Shelbra says, 'Greetings, _______. You have come to me searching for tasks and tasks I have. Would you judge yourself an [experienced heretic] or one who has [much to learn]?'

You say, 'I have much to learn'

Antus Shelbra says, 'Very well, ____. I do have a task for you. There is an old and frail Erudite male that now lives in Toxxulia named Aglthin Dasmore. He has left the ways of Cazic-Thule and no longer practices our craft. He has been stripped of his power and wealth, so he spends his time fishing by the river. Our great Lord of Fear has decreed that his life is forfeit. Slay him, and bring me proof of the deed.'

Find Aglthin Dasmore at location (370, -1670) in Toxxulia Forest.

You say, 'Hail, Aglthin Dasmore'

Aglthin Dasmore says, 'I am so tired. Leave me be. All I wish to do is fish! Can't I have even a few seconds alone?!'

You have slain Aglthin Dasmore!

• Your faction standing with Heretics has been adjusted by -10.
• Your faction standing with Deepwater Knights has been adjusted by 10.
• Your faction standing with Gate Callers has been adjusted by 10.
• Your faction standing with Craftkeepers has been adjusted by 10.
• Your faction standing with Crimson Hands has been adjusted by 10.

--You have looted a Aglthin's Fishing Pole.--

Return to Antus Shelbra and give him Aglthin's Fishing Pole.

Antus Shelbra says, 'Excellent, _______. You have proven yourself to be a true follower of Cazic-Thule. Continue on the path you have chosen, and you will surely become one of the mightiest in the land.'

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Marshall Lanena is located at 90, -174 on the second floor of the Rivervale Bank.

You say, 'Hail, Marshal Lanena’

Marshal Lanena says, ‘Hello. ____. I am Lanenea Wickystick, marshal of all Vale concerns. If there are any troubles brewing in our fine town which concern the Guardians of the Vale, please inform me. You must be a [new deputy] or are you an [outsider]?’

You say, ‘I am a new deputy’

Marshal Lanenea says, ‘It is good to see such fine stock in the ranks of the Guardians. Being new, there is much to learn, in battle and in life itself. If you are not presently obligated, we have need of you here in the hollow. There seems to be a [small problem].’

You say, 'What small problem?'

Marshal Lanena says, ‘For months. Fiddy Bobick has petitioned the marshals to assist him with a problem he has. With the addition of new deputies such as yourself, we can now give him the assistance he requires. Just go down to Bobick’s shop near the lake. Tell him I sent you.’

Fiddy Bobick is usually around 19, -428. He runs between his shop and the dock and occasionally jumps into the water and swims around a little. Hailing him causes him to pause briefly. Just stand on the dock to talk to him and it should work.

You say, ‘Hail, Fiddy Bobick.”

Fiddy Bobick says, ‘Ahoy, mate | The name’s Fiddy Bobick! Perhaps you’ve heard of me.. the greatest halfling to sail the seas of Norrath? I have been to the North. South. East and West, and thank Prexus. I have survived it all! Why I have returned to this little hollow is a wonder to me. Obviously, the salty air finally got to my brain!

You say, ‘Wickystick sent me’

Fiddy Bobick says, ‘Well, it’s about blasted time! The ship was about to sink. Wickystick finally managed to send the troops in! The problem, mate, is piranha | What? | That’s what I said. Pirahna! The lake is infested with the little buggers. More and more every sunrise. They’re chomping down all our food supply. You have gotta get your can in the drink and kill them. Take one of their teeth to old Wickystick and see what she has to say about Fiddy then! I will also give you some booty for any teeth you pull out of this river. Well, get going, Deputy ______!’

Fiddy wants you to kill the piranha that are eating all the fish in the lake.

Piranha sometimes drop a Piranha Tooth

sections.heading: Turn in to Fiddy (faction, exp)
sections.text:
Fiddy Bobick says, 'Whew | We are sure on the way to saving this village, pal! They're gonna erect a statue in our names. Fishslayers is what we are! Let's keep up the good work!'

For now we must collect more. Take this bag. Collect enough teeth to fill the bag. Don't worry, if it takes a while I shall reward you with the [Rantho Rapier]. We will need to examine the teeth.'

With its light weight and special two-hand hilt, it becomes a formidable weapon in the hands of our younger deputies. Only a [new deputy] has the right to earn one.'

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, 'Hail, Windscribe Thaloria'

Windscribe Thaloria says, 'The Icestar once carried our words — not in ink, but on the breath between snowflakes. That wind is broken now. The [pages] no longer know where to land.'

You say, 'What pages?'

Windscribe Thaloria says, 'I've found most of the pages, but four pages of this chapter were [scattered] when the fracture opened. I have traced them to voices that no longer speak — beings caught between warmth and cold.'

You say, 'Scattered where?'

Windscribe Thaloria says, 'Bring me four fragments: scraps carried by wind, guarded by beasts or spirits too long silent in a tower of frost. Then the chapter may form again.'

• Kill any Mob on Floor 1 in Tower of Frozen Shadow : Chance to drop Forgotten Page 1
• Kill any Mob on Floor 2 in Tower of Frozen Shadow : Chance to drop Forgotten Page 2
• Kill An Armored Shadow on Floor 3 in Tower of Frozen Shadow : Chance to drop Forgotten Page 3 (Seems Skeletons can drop Page 1 on this floor)
• Kill any Mob on Floor 4 in Tower of Frozen Shadow : Chance to drop Forgotten Page 4

Hand all four pages into Windscribe Thaloria.

Windscribe Thaloria lays the fragments on a snow-slick slab. A cold wind threads through and glowing script returns to the page. She says, 'Yes... they trembled in silence, but the words still waited. They remember one another. Another breath in the darkness. Another truth reclaimed by the Icestar. Take these combined pages for another chapter of the preamble.'

You receive Chapter III, When Stars Forget Their Light and a Holiday Gift.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Gren Frikniller is a bodyguard for the rogue guildmaster in East Freeport. Ask him about his sister (they share the same surname):

You say, 'Who is your sister?'

Gren Frikniller says 'Ah, my sister Falia has traveled here all the way from Rivervale. I hear that she's been staying up in North Freeport, but I haven't had a chance to find her yet. If you get some spare time, could you take this letter to her for me? Thanks, _____, you're really not so bad after all.'

Take the letter to Falia Frikniller in North Freeport. Note she is on Merchants of Rivervale faction and may not deal with you if your faction is too low (dubious works):

You say, 'Hail, Falia Frikniller'

Falia Frikniller says 'Aye, hello there, friend! How are ye on this fine day? A beautiful day to be alive, I must say! Anyway, I just got into Freeport last month. Wow, is this city big! Way bigger than humble little Rivervale. That's where I'm from. I'm working on setting up my own little business here, Falia's Foot Combs and Footwear, it'll be called. But, I don't have anything to sell yet, so check back in a couple of weeks. Safe travels to ye, friend.'

Hand her the letter:

Falia Frikniller says 'Heh, that good for nothing fool. I've been here for over a month already, and I haven't seen him yet. Bah, anyway, could you take this back to him for me? It was our grandfather's lucky necklace. He passed it down to our father, and now onto my brother. Knowing that little worm, Grenny, he'll probably trade it for a mug of ale. Oh well, thanks for delivering the letter, friend. Good day to you, and safe travels.'

You gain experience.

Receive a Broken Heirloom Necklace in return, which you can take to Gren:

Gren Frikniller says 'What's this? Oh, ol' Grandpa Frikniller's lucky necklace, huh? I'll bet this broken piece of junk won't even get me a sip of ale up at the bar. And lucky? How lucky could this thing be? Poor gramps was lonely and copperless his whole life. Bah | Oh, well. Here's some coin for your efforts, thanks, _____'

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
At the end of the Kobold Shaman Artifacts quest, Breya says "You may want to ask Gans about his brother"

You say, 'Hail, Gans Paust'

Gans Paust glances at you and hurriedly makes a gesture of religious meaning before you and says, 'Yes, yes, I hereby bless you in the name of Prexus. May your catch be plentiful and your nets never snag. Are there any other fisherman seeking a blessing? I'm very busy.'

You say, 'What of your brother?'

Gans Paust says, 'What? How do you know of my brother? Ahh I assume Breya told you. He's been gone for quite some time with no word sent on his progress or his well being. I need to find someone to [check on him].'

You say, 'I will check on him for you.'

Gans Paust says, 'Thank you, adventurer. He's one of our people's most knowledgeable geologists and has left to survey an island out in Erud's Crossing. He was sending monthly reports until two weeks ago when his report never showed up. I'm worried something may have happened to him. Take this note to Yelesom and bring back something to assure me of his safety. A reward fitting a Deepwater Knight shall be yours upon your success.'

You receive Gans's note to Yelesom.

The note reads:
Brother, Your report is two weeks late. I fear something has harmed you and have sent this courier to inquire
about your well being. Please send the courier back with message of your health and progress. Regards, Gans.

Travel to Erud's Crossing to find Yelesom Paust in the volcanic crater.

You say, 'Hail, Yelesom Paust'

Yelesom Paust says, 'Ahh salutations young adventurer. I'd love to chat, but I have much studying to do. Farewell.'

Hand him Gans's note to Yelesom.

Yelesom Paust says, 'Gans sent you to check on me did he? Well you can tell my dear brother that the surveying has been halted. One of those furballs has stolen my tools, making my job impossible. Kerrans, kobolds, gnolls - we're constantly under siege by these primitives...Anyway, perhaps you could [help me]?'

You gain experience.

You say, 'I will help you.'

Yelesom Paust says, 'Wonderful. The beast took my tool kit whilst I slept at camp. I awoke only to see him paddling frantically out into the ocean in a small boat. He couldn't have gone very far. If you stand at my [camp] and look towards the next closest head stone, you will be facing the direction in which the Kerran thief fled. Swim straight out from there and you should see his cunning little boat.'

You say, 'Where is your camp?'

Yelesom Paust says, 'My camp is next to the head stone on the eastern most portion of this island. The Kerran may have dropped some of my tools into the ocean as it fled. Please return the complete tool kit and I'll make sure my brother rewards you.'

Seek out the missing tools:

• The Magnifying Glass is a bag sitting on the ground not too far from the shore. The loc is -600, 2000.
• The Geologist's Hammer looks like a hammer and is on the ocean floor at the bottom of the big drop off. You will have to swim down the deep drop off here to find it. The loc is -526, 2287.
• The frantic kerran is underwater at loc 33, 3158. Avoid the sharks getting to him, and kill him to get the Incomplete Tool Kit. Careful, you end up very far from shore with a 25 stone container.

Combine the Magnifying Glass and the Geologist's Hammer in the Incomplete Tool Kit to create Yelesom's Tools. Turn this in to Yelesom.

Yelesom Paust says, 'You got it! And found the missing pieces! Now, I can finally get back to my studies. Thank you, _______. Please take these reports to my brother, Gans. Your valiant deed will surely win you a reward.?'

You gain experience.

You receive Yelesom's Reports.

Return to Erudin and hand Yelesom's Reports to Gans Paust.

Gans Paust says, 'Ahhh, thank you for your effort, _______. I'm glad he's doing ok despite the theft. I now award you the Sleeves of Midnight Sea. May they protect you until the time of our glorious redemption.'

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
There are random Mobs in the zone that drop A Library Card. Give one to Posie the Librarian and she will give you a 4-slot container called the Book of Mischief.

Also dropping randomly are four page fragments: top left and right, and bottom left and right. Combine these four pages in the book and you will get a Words of Wealth.

Now talk to Bob the Painter and give him your Words of Wealth and you will get an Empty Pot of Gold (2 slot container). Next, you need to combine:

an item from the Deck of Spontaneous Generation Quest. Only 2-throne combination items work (e.g., Green Wristguard, Crown of Distraction), except for Vambraces of Distraction & Mask of Melodies (1-throne), which also work.
Words of Wealth

Combine these two items in the Pot of Gold, which will give you a Funny Money.

Give 2 Funny Moneys to Peachy D'Vicci and she gives you a colored Gift Box. The box has 5 charges. Occasionally you will receive a Frostmaidens Idol instead of a gift box. As far as I know, the color of the box you will get is completely random. Make sure to hand in the money unstacked and do not multiquest the turn in.

If you click on the box, you will summon a doll. The type of doll depends upon the color of the box:

• Black: Twisted Druid Doll (Druid)
• Blue: Sly Summoner Doll (Magician)
• Green: A Maleficent Necromancer Doll (Necromancer)
• Grey: Mad Monkey Doll (Monk)
• Purple: Mischievous Dazzler Doll (Enchanter)
• Red: A Wily Warlock Doll (Wizard)
• Silver: Shamanistic Shenannigan Doll (Shaman)
• White: A Crazy Cleric Doll (Cleric)

Each doll has 1-5 charges of Hug, which is a regeneration spell (A Crazy Cleric Doll has 5 charges while A Maleficent Necromancer Doll and A Wily Warlock Doll have only 1). Each doll is named after a specific class; thus there is one colored box per class.

sections.heading: Plane of Mischief Armor
sections.text: The dolls generated by the gift boxes can then be used in the Plane of Mischief Armor Quest, by combining them with an Armor of Distraction piece in an Empty Pot of Gold to produce Plane of Mischief Armor.

You say, 'Hail, Marton Sayer'

Marton Sayer says 'Welcome. Please stock up on provisions, especially if you are headed toward the lair of the vile gnolls. If so, I wish you much luck and many gnoll pelts | I also have knowledge of a [powerful dog]. I pray you do not encounter him.'

You say, 'What powerful dog?'

The only thing more precious would be my son, Joseph Sayer. I would trade Gnoll Slayer only for him to be safe and sound at home.'

Lord Elgnub can be found in the skull room of Blackburrow. Kill him and loot Baby Joseph Sayer, which you will bring back to Marton.

Marton Sayer says 'Baby Joseph | Look, Momma | Baby Joseph has been rescued by this good adventurer | That evil Lord Elgnub made good on his word and snatched my son from under our noses. You saved the day | For this you shall wield 'Gnoll Slayer' |

The spell would help you fight off disease and call forth a wolf to fight beside you. Alas, the gnoll eye was stolen from the blade by a great, one-eyed, white gnoll. Along with the eye, the only book which explained how to return the enchantment was also stolen. I know not where this gnoll might be. 35

sections.heading: Minimum Level
sections.text: You can get the shackle at lvl 5, you just can't use the clikky until 35.

sections.heading: Checklist
sections.text:
loot Strong Wooden Branch from a holgresh conjurer or a holgresh elementalist

loot Strong Raptor Gut from a tigeraptor or a tigesaurous

Give Branch and Gut to Snowfang fisher (to spawn enraged walrus)

cause enraged walrus to die (you do not have to get the killing blow)

quickly talk to agitated snowfang by hailing and then typing " /say I want the magic thing. "to get Chapter P

give Ami the Chapter P to receive Pirate Grammar Manual

sections.heading: Complete Walkthrough
sections.text:
Speak to Ami at the gnome pirate camp.

You say, 'Hail, Ami'

Ami flips through a few pages of a small book, reading intently before answering you. 'Ye scurvy dog. I'll strike yer colors 'fore ya can put me on a gibbet. Take that, ya crimp!' She flips through a few more pages then smiles at you. 'Arrrr!'

You say, 'Ye scurvy dog!'

Ami grins. 'Hey, that's pretty good. You did it without a book too. Nice to meet you. I'm the bosun here.'

You say, 'What's a bosun?'

Ami says 'Yup. I think it means I'm in charge of the flag cause that's what the Cap'n told me to take care of. I'm the one who made our symbol, so I get to protect it. I even got my own copy of the grammar manual so I can practice my pirate speech.'

You say, 'What grammar manual?'

Ami nods and shows you the book for a moment. 'We don't have many of them and usually we share. My book is missing a chapter, though.'

You say, 'What chapter are you missing?'

Ami nods. 'A mate of mine borrowed the P Chapter to draw a map on but then he went and got himself lost. I've memorized the rest of the book but that chapter. Oh, well, I guess I can get by with what I have. Walk the mizenmast and batten down the boom!' She looks at you proudly. 'Good, eh? I'm one of the best pirates we have.'

Now go find a lost pirate on the northeast side of the island (hug the coast north from the dock).

You say, 'Hail, a lost pirate'

a lost pirate twitches and growls a little. 'Arrr. Grrr. Ahoy, mate. The name's Teep.' He shivers and you notice a little drool at the corner of his mouth. 'Ya ain't lost out here too, are ya?'

You say, 'I am not lost.'

a lost pirate grins and stares through you with a mad gleam in his eye. 'Hehehe. Yah, yer lost aren't ya. I can tell from the crazy sound o' yer voice. Too bad we ain't got me map. The map would lead us straight back ta camp. Yah, that it would, boyo.'

You say, 'What map?'

a lost pirate nods. 'After we got ourselves stuck on this island I got it in me head to draw up a map so none o' the crew would ever get lost. So I set myself to explorin' and drawin'. Now the map is gone. Too bad, too, cause it was a map o' the whole place, not just the first island, but a bunch o' parts.' Mention of the map seems to have sobered him up a bit.

[This is for a related quest to recover The Lost Map.]

You say, 'Ami wants Chapter P.'

a lost pirate stares at the water. 'I'm rememberin' that. Yah. Ami's book. Thats what I drew, erm, the fifth part o'n. It got lost in the ocean too.' He looks at you. 'Yer wantin' ta go out and find all o' these pieces?'

Not sure what the next trigger phrase is, but go find Snowfang fisher on an ice floe south of the Tower of Frozen Shadow.

You say, 'Hail, Snowfang fisher'

Snowfang fisher says 'Furless one wants something with snowfang? You here to help with curse?'

You say, 'What curse?'

Snowfang fisher growls as the other fisher-gnolls bark at the mention of the curse. 'Some days ago we found flat, strong, stretchy thing. Many scribbles, many marks on it. Ever since fish not come to us.. Rest of the snowfang think this is bad magic. To not believe this is foolish. But I not able to just get rid of bad magic.'

You say, 'What magic thing?'

Snowfang fisher says 'To cast away is not something we can do. Snowfang believe bad magic thrown away just make worse magic. Only way to get rid of badness is for friend to bring gift offering. Offering that means much to snowfang. If that is done magic is broken by the giving.'

You say, 'What offering?'

Snowfang fisher says 'Offering must be true and strong. To trade for anything else would be an insult to the spirits. If you want you can bring me true strong wooden pole and fine string for new pole. That would be true strong gift and maybe enough to break bad evil on this thing we find.'

You must go to the Wakening Land to get these items. Strong Wooden Branch drops rarely from holgreshes. Strong Raptor Gut drops rarely from tigeraptors and tigesaurous.

Give these two items to the fisher.

Note: You can't MQ the 2 WL drops. They need to be turned in at the same time.

Snowfang fisher sniffs the offering and seems to relax. 'Very good, very worthy. You take this magic thing, with you maybe this evil is broken.' Before he can hand you the parchment a roar explodes from the ocean and a gigantic dark shadow slams into the ice floe.

An enraged walrus spawns and immediately attacks you. The gnoll fishermen will join in the battle against the walrus. You do not have to get the killshot.

After the walrus dies, an agitated snowfang spawns in its place and will only stay for approx 40 seconds.

WARNING: I failed this quest twice in a row now because my auto-attack on the enraged walrus did not stop when it died and I targeted the agitated snowfang (probably too quickly, before the corpse had completely faded from view). The snowfang began attacking me as a result, rather than allowing me to complete the quest.

You say, 'Hail, an agitated snowfang'

an agitated snowfang shivers and growls to itself. 'Much thanks must I give ______. Furless one still wants magic thing, after all the troubles? Say quickly. Much pain from attack. Must go, shaman help.'

You say, 'I want the magic thing.'

It gives you "Chapter P" and immediately despawns.

Go back to Ami and give her Chapter P.

Ami bounces excitedly. 'Oh! I've been needing this!' She reads over the pages intently. 'Uh. Pirate - A sea robber.' She scratches her head. 'I totally forgot we were supposed to be robbing people. Put down yer weapons and hand over yer platinum and gold ya port side bilge suckers! Heh. This is great. Thank you, ______' She grins and goes back to reading.

She gives you a "Pirate Grammar Manual"

Go see Nilham the Chef in a nearby igloo.

You say, 'Hail, Nilham the Chef'

Nilham the Chef says 'Ahoy, ______. Welcome ta the brig. I didn't get ta the 'B' section of my piratisms manual so I'm not sure what a brig is but I'm guessin' it means 'really small place without enough food or water.' So, ya here ta stay or just visitin'?'

Give Nilham the manual.

Nilham the Chef looks at you with a gleam in his eye. 'Wow. Ya actually got one. Thanks, mate! Here, you can have my cuffs. I'm tired of 'em and they're startin' ta chafe.' He flips through the book with a grin. 'B - Bilgewater. Barnacle brained blunderhead. Blast yer ballast...' Nilham happily reads through the book.

You receive the shackles.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, 'Hail, Watcher Aenwen.'

Watcher Aenwen says, 'Have you seen it? Not the snowfall, but the sky. Not the cold, but the silence beneath it. Something ancient has shifted. A song once sung by stars has stilled. The Icestar — the first gift ever given — is breaking. And with it, the enchantments that bind the Plane of Snowdrift to your world begin to fade.The magic allowing us to read the Ledger is broken. We Snowdrift Elves are oathbound to frost and memory. We may not intervene where the sky fractures. But you…You may still walk the [cracked places].'

You say, 'What cracked places'

Watcher Aenwen says, 'They are echoes. Reflections. Where the Icestar’s light once shone strongest in your world — now dimmed, disturbed. Rifts between our and your worlds that cannot be seen with our eyes, but are known. Go to them. Three places: where a king stands in a land once touched by frostbreath, frozen statues under the rule of a frozen master, and the crossroads of caves in a dreadful land. At each place, speak her name. Say: Aurilias, I remember.’ The fracture will answer, if you are true.'

• Permafrost Resonance Crystal comes from King Thex'Ka IV spawn in Permafrost. 660, -280
• Thurgadin Resonance Crystal comes from Thurgadin at the statue straight across from Icewell Keep entrance. Stand behind the statue at -200, 0.
• Dreadlands Resonance Crystal comes from the Yeti Caves Crossroads in Dreadlands at #1 on the map. 2400, 4845

Hand in all three Crystals to Watcher Aenwen.

Watcher Aenwen touches the crystal, which glows faintly. She says, 'You have walked where we cannot. And the Icestar has heard you. It remembers, just a little. Take this - a fragment of what once was written, and what may still be restored. This story belongs in the Ledger. Let it be remembered.

You receive Chapter I, The Shatter Sky and a Holiday Gift.
