sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Lord Nethryn can be found at (154, -342) inside the first room on the left once you enter the Traveler's Home inn located within Northern Felwithe. This quest was for a GM Event on live. [https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=1223] [https://web.archive.org/web/20050507011032/http://eqbeastiary.allakhazam.com/search.shtml?id=6613]

You say, 'Hail, Lord Nethryn'

Lord Nethryn bows at the waist, his manner sincere and regal with the soft smile upon his lips. 'Greetings and good day , I trust that [you are well]?'

You say, 'I am well.'

Lord Nethryn says, 'Excellent! It is quite a pleasant day, indeed. However, I am curious, and I do not mean not [to pry], but by what grace of Tunare have I the pleasure of your company? Perhaps you merely [travel], or is it [me] you truly seek?'

You say, 'why do you pry?'

Lord Nethryn says, 'Very well, I do apologize if I did offend. May your travels be rewarding and Tunare's good grace upon you, .'

You say, 'I am merely traveling.'

Lord Nethryn says, 'A traveler then? Perhaps for adventure and fame. Indeed. I do remember those days. It has been. . . quite some time. so much that I can hardly remember. In any case. my reminiscence must be of no consequence to you. and I do not wish to keep you. Please. do be well and may Tunare's grace kindly guide you through your path.'

You say, 'it is you that I seek.'

Lord Nethryn blinks in surprise, a sense of pride lighting is face. 'I see. It has been some time since I have been called upon in [this realm]. I am afraid that I cannot leave [my post], however, I shall pray for Tunare's guidance to the answers you seek.'

You say, 'what is your post in this realm?'

Lord Nethryn says, 'I am Lord Nethryn the Arbitrator, once a devout priest of Tunare, and now a most loyal servant. I once resided within the [Realm of Heroes], but she has called upon me again to [serve] as I did once within my [mortal form] and years.'

You say, 'why did you serve in your mortal form?'

Lord Nethryn sighs heavily, a look of trouble and sorrow upon his brow. 'Several centuries past, within the first years of [his majesty's] rise to the throne, I served as the High Priest of Tunare and was head of the [council], that most dreadful council. I do not regret my past work, as I did [what needed to be done] then. It was all for the benefit of our people, both Fier'Dal and Koada'Dal alike.'

You say, 'what council?'

Lord Nethryn says, 'The council I served upon was a council of five priests and a single knight, all of which were devout in the most sincere meaning of the word to the Earth Mother. With the rising [activities] of the most vile [Lord Mistmoore], the council was placed as a judge and jury for all who had become infected with the [disease].'

You say, 'what sort of activities?'

Lord Nethryn says, 'The Vampire Lord, Mayong Mistmoore, who continues his tyrannical and monstrous rise in power within our neighboring forest had begun to manifest is power in attempts to further his rule and dominion over the continent of Faydwer. In the Lord's attempts, he unleashed the Lycanthropy virus upon the forests, infecting many of our nation's people. In time, the virus had been eliminated and was no longer a threat, but the [souls] of those who were unfortunate enough to meet the council did not survive, but were avenged.'

You say, 'what souls?'

Lord Nethryn says, 'There were too many to count. . . Far too many condemned souls. There was nothing we could do for them but ease their pain and assist to keep the virus from spreading to the other inhabitants of our nation. No cure existed, and to this day, a cure continues to evade us. I still remember the [last] victim that I had to condemn before Tunare chose me for ascension.'

You say, 'who was the last victim?'

Lord Nethryn 's eyes swell with pain and fury. 'A young girl by the name of Khasra, was the youngest that our council had to attend and judge. I will never forget her face, nor the voice of her pleading mother. Forever I shall regret that decision, and regret our ignorance to her [threat].

You say, 'what was this threat?'

Lord Nethryn says, 'The young girl's mother had threatened to take Khasra to the Lord's domain and seek a cure there if we did not further our search for one. She would not allow her daughter to fall to the same fate as all the others had. We ignored her threat, and in turn, the girl now walks as a servant of Mistmoore, eternally embraced as one of his monstrous creations. I pray with every waking energy of my being for her, and still I know not why Tunare has chosen me for this [task and glory].

You say, 'what is your task and glory?'

Lord Nethryn says, 'I am a herald, a harbinger, and a judge of the Earth Mother. I have been charged with the duty of [accepting] those who have won the eyes and favor of the gods and returning to them recognition and reward for their deeds.'

You say, 'whom are you accepting?'

Lord Nethryn says, 'Those who have been found worthy in their deeds to accept recognition from the gods are given a [coin] that they mayl give to one of the many [heroes and servants] that the gods have recently returned to this realm.'

You say, 'what coin of heroes and servants?'

Lord Nethryn says, 'There are five coins, five very specific coins that hold a divine light and essence to them. Even the hand and eye of the most crafted rogue or artist cannot forge Honor, Insight, Gallantry, Tranquility, and Faith.'

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Kimble Nogflop of Ak'Anon will give you a Regurgitonic, but requires a Flask of Nitrates first.

Find Te`Anara in Surefall Glades at location -202, -423, 5.

You say, 'Hail, Te`Anara'

Te`Anara says, 'Welcome, friend! I hope your stay in Surefall Glade will ease your mind and soothe your soul. While you are here, we ask you to abide by the [laws of the Jaggedpine].'

You say, 'What are the laws of the Jaggedpine?'

Te`Anara says, 'We ask that you do not start campfires on our land. Do not litter our land with any items. Do not chop down our pines or tread upon any foliage. Please do not take more than a bellyful of fish. Do not harm any other wildlife and stay clear of [the great bear]!'

You say, 'Who is the great bear?'

Te`Anara says, 'The great bear I speak of is Mammoth. He has lived among us for over a century. Tunare has truly blessed us with his presence. As long as Mammoth lives, so too does Surefall Glade. We are currently worried. Corun has reported that there is something [wrong with Mammoth].'

You say, 'What is wrong with Mammoth?'

Te`Anara says, 'Mammoth is not eating. We believe something is lodged in his throat. We require a young druid to [fetch a special potion].'

You say, 'I will fetch a special potion'

Te`Anara says, 'Go to the gnome city of Ak'Anon on the continent of Faydwer. With their great zoo, you will find a gnome named Kimble Nogflop. Give him the flask of nitrates and he shall hand you a special potion which will force Mammoth to cough up whatever may be stuck inside his throat. Be sure to show me what you find inside his throat upon your return.'

You receive Flask of Nitrates.

Head to Ak'Anon, and once there find Kimble Nogflop at location 1329, -808, -61 (one floor below the tiger in the zoo). Hand him the Flask of Nitrates.

Kimble Nogflop says, 'The flask of nitrates I sent for | As was the deal, here is my [Regurgitonic]. Give it to whoever may need it and they will surely cough up whatever may be inside them with no harm to them whatsoever.'

You receive Regurgitonic.

• Your faction standing with Gem Choppers got better.

You say, 'regurgitonic'.

Kimble Nogflop says 'I formulate the Regurgitonic myself. My animals kept eating the occasional spectator here and there. Femurs and ribs kept getting stuck inside, not to mention a few platinum pieces. Sometimes my batch would come out wrong and the animals would go berserk | I hope I got the formula right this time.'

If you choose to give the regurgitonic to Mammoth and give the Bayle List II to Te'Anara

Te`Anara says 'Oh my! This must belong to Antonius Bayle. I shall see that he receives it. You have done a great service to Qeynos and Surefall Glade. I rewards you with this. May it be of good use in your future deeds.'

• Your faction standing with Jaggedpine Treefolk got better.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
During daytime, inside of the Tink 'N Babble on the second floor will be found a city clerk by the name of Clerk Doval (881, -75, 18).

You say, 'Hail, Clerk Doval'

Clerk Doval takes a sip of lager and looks up at you. 'Ahh | An adventurer of sorts? Looking for work, are we? If you have the time, I might have a bit of a [proposition] for you.'

You say, 'What proposition?'

Clerk Doval says 'I was sent by the Legion to deliver a restraining order to a few of the troopers. They have been ordered to stay away from the tavern. They have spent too much time drinking and not enough training. I am to have them initial the restraint order list, but my feet are killing me. Perhaps you could [deliver the restraining order]?'

You say, 'I can deliver the restraining order.'

Clerk Doval says 'Here is the restraint order. Go to the troopers and ask them to [sign the restraining order]. Also, make sure to have them sign it in alphabetical order. I am a very big stickler about this. The troopers' names are as follows; Ozlot, Ogmire, Nish Nish, Frogzin, Gummin, Inkin, Roklon, Taer, Fryp and Selbat. When all is done, I shall pay you.'

Once you agree, he hands you a letter (Legion Order) which must be signed by all ten troopers, in alphabetical order. Find each trooper and give them the restraining order. Each will sign the order, and return it to you, though some require sub-tasks to get them to sign. Once you have finished this task, return to the Tink 'N Babble and give the finished order to Doval.

The troopers' names and what they want to sign are (in alphabetical order):

• Trooper Frogzin (found at the Lake of Ill Omen, at the city gate -- will just sign it),
You say, 'Hail, Trooper Frogzin'

Trooper Frogzin says, 'Mind yourself in these parts! There are many dangers. Stay away from the water. if you know whats good for you.'

You say, 'I need you to sign this restraining order.'

Trooper Frogzin looks very upset at your mention of the order. 'I cannot believe I have been banned from what little enjoyment can be found in Cabilis. Oh, well, I cannot argue with a legion order. Hand me the order so that I may sign it.

Trooper Frogzin grabs the order from your hand and mumbles something unpleasant and vaguely threatening. He then hands the signed order back to you.

• Trooper Fryp (found at the entrance to the warriors' guild -- needs a Quill),
You say, 'Hail, Trooper Fryp'

Trooper Fryp says, 'Hail, citizen! Have you been fishing lately? The water is alive with sewer catfish. Unfortunately, there are also the barracudas | '

You say, 'I need you sign this restraining order.'

Trooper Fryp says, 'Alas. The masters have learned of my long evenings in the tavern. Ok.. Long mornings and afternoons too. Heh heh. Can't fight authority | Hand me the.. Wait. I do not have my quill with me. Go and fetch me a writing quill and hand it to me along with the legion order and then I shall sign it.'

Hand him the Quill along with the restraining order.

Trooper Fryp signs the order and hands it back to you. ' Well.. At least I now have this fancy writing quill.

• Trooper Gummin (Field of Bones in left ruined building -- Needs the order and a Legion Lager brewed)

You say, 'Hail, Trooper Gummin'

Trooper Gummin says, 'Beware the bone field beyond the path. It is said that the bones of a thousand fallen warriors walk its grounds at night.'

You say, 'I need you to sign this restraining order'

Trooper Gummin says, 'Blast | The masters have condemned me to a life of sobriety and bloodshed! At least I still have bloodshed. But I would like one last drink. I would like a bottle of Legion Lager from Cabilis. Bring me the lager and the legion order and then I shall sign it.'

Hand him the Legion Lager along with the restraining order.

Trooper Gummin says, 'What? | I need the Legion Lager and the legion order.'

Trooper Gummin slowly signs the order. '...Love, Innoruuk. There you go. Now run along. Let me enjoy my last brew alone.

• Your faction standing with Legion of Cabilis got better.
• Your faction standing with Cabilis Residents got better.
• Your faction standing with Scaled Mystics got better.
• Your faction standing with Crusaders of Greenmist got better.
• Your faction standing with Swift Tails got better.

You gain experience.

• Trooper Inkin (found at the Swamp of No Hope, at the city gate -- Needs a Skipping Stone from a froglok skipper)

You say, 'Hail, Trooper Inkin'

Trooper Inkin says, 'Many frogloks in here. Beware! They can be a sneaky bunch. I hear tales of a froglok village nearby.'

You say, 'I need you to sign this restraining order'

Trooper Inkin says, 'I have been expecting this. Oh, well... Can't argue with the Baron or he will have both our heads. Keeping that in mind, I will make you a deal. I will sign the order if you bring me one of those grand skipping stones these Frogloks are said to have. Bring me the stone and the order and I shall sign.'

Hand him the Skipping Stone along with the restraining order.

Trooper Inkin So smooth. I shall be the skipping stone champion | Here. You may have my autograph.

• Your faction standing with Legion of Cabilis got better.
• Your faction standing with Cabilis Residents got better.
• Your faction standing with Scaled Mystics got better.
• Your faction standing with Crusaders of Greenmist got better.
• Your faction standing with Swift Tails got better.

You gain experience.

• Trooper Nishnish (found at the gate to the Swamp of No Hope, in Cabilis -- Needs two Barracuda Teeth from pygmy barracuda/barracuda in Cabilis waterways)

You say, 'Hail, Trooper Nishnish'

Trooper Nishnish says, 'Hail, citizen! Keep clear of the waterways which run through this grand city. For swimming they are not. Many times have playful broodlings fallen prey to the sharp teeth of barracudas.'

You say, 'I need you to sign this restraining order'

Trooper Nishnish says, 'So the legion has sent you to have me sign this order, eh? Nay. I shall not do so unless the messenger, you, gathers two barracuda teeth for me. Hand me the legion order when you hand me the two barracuda teeth and then your task shall be complete.'

Hand him 2 x Barracuda Tooth (separately, not stacked) along with the restraining order.

Trooper Nishnish says, 'You shall get my signature when I have the legion order and two barracuda teeth.'

Trooper Nishnish says, 'You shall get my signature when I have the legion order and two barracuda teeth.'

Trooper Nishnish grabs the barracuda teeth and attaches them to a necklace. 'Good. Now this barracuda charm shall keep me safe from slipping into the waters and becoming a feast for the barracuda. And you, take this legion order and be gone.

• Your faction standing with Legion of Cabilis got better.
• Your faction standing with Cabilis Residents got better.
• Your faction standing with Scaled Mystics got better.
• Your faction standing with Crusaders of Greenmist got better.
• Your faction standing with Swift Tails got better.

You gain experience.

• Trooper Ogmire (found at the gate to the Lake of Ill Omen, in Cabilis -- will just sign it)

You say, 'Hail, Trooper Ogmire'

Trooper Ogmire says, 'Greetings. citizen. Looking for healing or other such services? If so. then I urge you to seek out the Temple of Terror. The hierophants will see to it for you.'

You say, 'Sign the restraining order'

Trooper Ogmire says, 'I knew my wicked ways would eventually come to an end. Very well, then. Hand me the legion order and I shall sign it.'

Trooper Ogmire signs the order and hands it back to you.

• Trooper Ozlot (found next to the gate to Warslik's Wood -- Needs two Sabertooth Kitten Canines (not cub) from the Lake of Ill Omen)

You say, 'Hail, Trooper Ozlot'

Trooper Ozlot says, 'Hail. citizen! If it is a good time you are seeking. you should head toward the tavern. You can't miss it. There is only one. The emperor says we should spend most of our time training. not in revelry. We troopers try.'

You say, 'Sign the restraining order'

Trooper Ozlot says, 'I do not believe you were sent by the legion. You do not look as though you could squash a kitten or even a bug. If you truly were sent, then you should be able to hunt down a sabertooth kitten. Tell you what, you bring me two sabertooth kitten canines and the legion order and I shall believe you. Only then will I sign the order for you.'

Hand him 2 x Sabertooth Kitten Canine (not cub; separately, not stacked) along with the restraining order.

Trooper Ozlot says, 'I suppose you were sent by the legion. I will sign. Here is the legion order back. Now, leave, so I can finish my watch.'

• Your faction standing with Legion of Cabilis got better.
• Your faction standing with Cabilis Residents got better.
• Your faction standing with Scaled Mystics got better.
• Your faction standing with Crusaders of Greenmist got better.
• Your faction standing with Swift Tails got better.

You gain experience.

• Trooper Roklon (found outside gates in Warslik's Woods -- Needs Goblin Scout Beads from the Lake of Ill Omen)

You say, 'Hail, Trooper Roklon'

Trooper Roklon says, 'Hail! Beware the giants of the woods. They have a dwelling somewhere out there. Should you stumble upon it, run | Leave the fighting to us.'

You say, 'Sign the restraining order'

Trooper Roklon says, 'I've been ratted out | Very well. I shall sign the order, but first I shall force you to fetch me a set of goblin scout beads. I hear they make fine counters. Bring me the beads and that despicable order and I shall do as instructed.'

Hand him the Goblin Scout Beads along with the restraining order.

Trooper Roklon says, 'No, NO! I want the goblin scout beads and the legion order.'

You gain experience.

• Trooper Selbat (found AT NIGHT in a building in the Lake of Ill Omen, near the city gate -- will just sign it)

You say, 'Hail, Trooper Selbat'

Trooper Selbat says, 'Good evening. citizen! It is a fine night for a stroll. but not in the woods. No. no | That would be far too dangerous!'

You say, 'Sign the restraining order'

Trooper Selbat says, 'I knew this time would come. I will slay you for bringing this to me . . . No . . . I'd best not make the officers angry. Hand me the order and I shall sign it.'

Trooper Selbat signs the note and hands back to you. 'Be off now. Before I do choose to slay the messenger.

• Trooper Taer (found wandering the Field of Bone, he stops at the city gate occasionally -- will just sign it).

You say, 'Hail, Trooper Taer'

Trooper Taer says, 'Hail | I suggest you stay within the walls of Cabilis. This is no place for you. The Field of Bone is far too close.'

You say, 'Sign the restraining order'

Trooper Taer says, 'Oh, no! My good times have come to an end. Hand me the note and I shall sign it.'

Trooper Taer says, 'Ha ha | Look at all the names. Ozlot and Frogzin. What lushes. Here you are. I can't imagine there being any others to sign. This is the entire Cabilis brew brigade. Alas.. Disbanded forever.'

• Your faction standing with Legion of Cabilis got better.
• Your faction standing with Cabilis Residents got better.
• Your faction standing with Scaled Mystics got better.
• Your faction standing with Crusaders of Greenmist got better.
• Your faction standing with Swift Tails got better.

You gain experience.

When you turn in the fully signed order to Clerk Doval:

Clerk Doval says, 'Thank you so much. I am so glad I did not have to deal with such a rowdy band of troopers as these. Please take some coin and perhaps a book from my personal library.'

• Your faction standing with Legion of Cabilis got better.
• Your faction standing with Cabilis Residents got better.

You receive ~17 silver, 4 copper pieces.

Note that you can also sometimes loot a completely signed legion order from frogloks in the swamp.

Return the list and you get a small amount of experience, some coin, and a random book from his library (the book you get may be specific to your class).

Books given out so far are:
• The Code of Combat,
• The History of Combat,
• The Tome of Combat,
• The Book of Knowledge.

Presumably there is more after this.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Eolorn J`Axx is a Rogue Guildmaster in the Rogue guild in Neriak Third Gate (630,-1308).

You say, 'Hail, Eolorn J`Axx'

Eolorn J`Axx says 'It is good to see new blood in our halls. I am the leader of this house. If you are looking for guidance, seek out the masters within. I rarely appoint tasks to new recruits, unless I need to retrieve the [foreign take].'

You say, 'What foreign take?'

Eolorn J`Axx says 'We have rogues operating in a few great cities. We send young rogues to retrieve the monthly take. We have been awaiting the Freeport delivery. The last youth I sent must have been killed along the way. I will need a new runner to [retrieve the chest].'

You say, 'I will retrieve the chest.'

Eolorn J`Axx says 'You seem able enough. Here. Take this note to Freeport. Go through the Commonlands and be careful not to encounter any Freeport guards. There is a network of aqueducts accessible through hidden passages. Search the outside walls of Freeport. Take the note to Giz. She will meet you at night, on an island in the harbor. Good luck.'

You receive a Sealed Letter (identifies as "Letter To Giz") which reads:

Giz Dinree. Freeport. My love, I have sent this young recruit to deliver the shipment to me. I believe he can be trusted. Please allow him to take the chest. E.J. xintldl ii

Eolorn wants you to find Giz Dinree in East Freeport. I found her at -367, -1095. She spawns at night - during the day, an NPC named Bait Masterson occupies her space; he is KOS to evil races.

Once you find Giz, she tells you that the loot is in a strongbox, and that the last courier was killed by sharks before he could deliver it. If you swim off shore a little (mind the shark guarding it) you will find a groundspawn named A Locked Chest (Loc: -406, -1150). Pick the chest up and bring it back to Eolorn for some coin and a minor item.

• Your faction standing with Ebon Mask got better. +10
• Your faction standing with Guards of Qeynos got worse. -1
• Your faction standing with Wolves of the North got worse. -2
• Your faction standing with Guardians of the Vale got worse. -1
• Your faction standing with Carson McCabe got worse. -2
You gain experience.

Lysbith McNaff may be found at (553, -414) in the Pit o Doom of Halas.

You say, 'Hail, Lysbith McNaff'

Lysbith McNaff says 'Hail! Ye've come to [serve Halas], have ye not? We're the Wolves o' the North and it is our task to defend our city from harm.'

You say, 'I serve Halas'

Lysbith McNaff says 'Halas is surrounded by barren arctic tundra. We've many foes. Among them are the [orc troopers], [ice goblins] and the ever-present polar bears.'

You say, 'What orc troopers?'

Lysbith McNaff says 'So. Ye think yerself strong enough to battle the snow orc troopers? I pray to the Tribunal that ye are. If ye can return to me four wrath orc wristbands from the troopers' bodies, I'll reward ye with the [Seax].'

You say, 'What Seax?'

Lysbith McNaff says 'The Seax is a Northman warrior's piercing weapon. Dinnae confuse this with another [weapon] related to the Seax called the Langseax. The local rogues have also learned to master the Seax. I'll only offer it to those who battle the [orc troopers].'

After handing in four Wrath Orc Wristbands:

Lysbith McNaff says 'Ye're becoming a fine champion o' Halas. Take th' Seax. May ye always defend Halas!'

sections.heading: Full Checklist
sections.text:
Please read walkthrough below this checklist carefully to prevent mishaps. It is recommended to have 210 Blacksmithing/128 Pottery

Smith Finished Naginata Blade - Be prepared to redo this section if a combine fails
• Thurgadin: Hail Loremaster Sarl, start dialogue then meet him in library, and hand him 50pp to receive Worn Coldain Tome
• Crystal Caverns: Hand in Worn Coldain Tome to Historian Baenek to spawn the Ghost of Burdael (DESPAWNS IN 5 MINUTES), kill and loot Onyxbrand
• Skyshrine: Hail Oglard, hand him Onyxbrand to receive Dragon Crafted Urn (2-slot container) Requires Ally faction.
• Dragon Necropolis: Run to (+1523, +1109) exactly, say "Remember, Garzicor", wait 95 seconds, pick up two ground spawns (Dragonwing Skin and Dragonbone Dust TEMPORARY ITEMS), put inside Dragon Crafted Urn (2-slot container) and click combine for a new Dragon Crafted Urn (v1) that fits in bags
• Skyshrine: Hail Oglard, hand him Dragon Crafted Urn (v1) to receive a different version of Dragon Crafted Urn (v2)
• Skyshrine: Hail Eldriaks Fe`Dhar, hand him Dragon Crafted Urn (v2) to receive a book (The Blade) and Sanctified bone dust
• The Overthere: Kill a Cliff Golem and loot Starmetal Ore
• Smith 173: Combine Starmetal Ore into two Portion of Starmetal
• Smith 171: Combine Portion of Starmetal + Sanctified bone dust into Dusted Starmetal Block and Remaining Bone dust, then smith Block x5 to create Shaped blade core
• Smith 171: Combine Portion of Starmetal + Remaining Bone dust into Dusted Starmetal Block, then smith x10 to create Blade skin-10th fold
• Smith 206: Combine Shaped blade core + Blade skin-10th fold to create Complete raw blade
• Smith 188: Combine Complete raw blade + Forging Hammer to create Complete shaped blade
• Pottery! 128: Combine Complete shaped blade + Clay/water mixture to create Clay coated blade
• Frontier Mountains: Run to -260, -300 and pick up ground spawn Gray Colored Ice
• Smith 199-200: Combine Clay coated blade + Gray Colored Ice to create Finished Naginata Blade

Obtain Bronzewood Staff
• Burning Woods: Kill Carpenter Grundo and loot Bronzewood Staff

Obtain Finished Tsuba
• Kael Drakkel: Kill Armor of Zek and loot Chunk of Chronium Ore
• Smith: Combine Chunk of Chronium Ore into Chronium Plate (Trivial <157)
• Howling Stones: pick up ground spawn Mandala sketch off table in the East Wing (+140,-510)
• Paineel: Hail Taralani Rahnta and hand him 1000pp to receive Kejekan Tool Kit
• The Warrens: Hail Koajin, hand him Mandala sketch + Kejekan Tool Kit + Chronium Plate to receive Finished Tsuba

Hand in Finished Naginata Blade + Bronzewood Staff + Finished Tsuba
• Skyshrine: Hail Eldriaks Fe`Dhar, hand him Finished Naginata Blade + Bronzewood Staff + Finished Tsuba to receive Assembled Naginata + Vial of Kromzek blood

Raid Garzicor's Wraith
• Obtain 2x Flawless Diamond
• Dragon Necropolis: Run to +1523, +1109 exactly, say "you are one but two. your vengeance shall find a home." to spawn a Ghostly Presence at +1523, +1109 (Stays up for 60 Seconds and then depops, respawn timer is 1 hour). Make sure to have 2 spaces between those two sentences; if you copy and paste from here you may need to add a space. Use say, not ooc, to trigger the spawn.
• Dragon Necropolis: Hail a Ghostly Presence, hand him Vial of Kromzek blood to spawn Garzicor's Corpse at +1523, +1109
• Dragon Necropolis: Kill Garzicor's Corpse to spawn Garzicor's Wraith at +1523, +1109
• Dragon Necropolis: Kill Garzicor's Wraith (raid target) to spawn translucent dragon (v1) on CoV faction at +1523, +1000 and translucent dragon (v2) on CoV faction at +1500, +800 (Stays up Approx 15 Mins before despawning)
• Dragon Necropolis: Hail a translucent dragon (v1), hand him Flawless Diamond to receive Blackened Diamond
• Dragon Necropolis: Hail a translucent dragon (v2), hand him Flawless Diamond to receive Gold Tinted Diamond

Final Smithing Combine
• Smith 160: Combine Assembled Naginata + Blackened Diamond + Gold Tinted Diamond to receive Ethereal Bladed Naginata

Final Hand-in

THIS IS NOT A ROUND ROBIN TURN IN. IF YOU TURN IN AND YOU MISS YOUR ITEM, MUST COMPLETELY REDO THE QUEST

• Skyshrine: Hail Eldriaks Fe`Dhar, hand him Ethereal Bladed Naginata to receive Ethereal Bladed Naginata back plus faction and experience (WAR PAL RNG SHD)
• Skyshrine: Hail Eldriaks Fe`Dhar, hand him Ethereal Bladed Naginata to receive Sanctum Guardian's Earring (CLR DRU MNK SHM)
• Skyshrine: Hail Eldriaks Fe`Dhar, hand him Sanctum Guardian's Earring to receive Pitted Iron Ring (NEC WIZ MAG ENC)

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Assumptions:
• You're 60th Level
• You have a group or raid guild
• You're familiar with all the zones in question
• You have some money to spend on Tradeskills and miscellaneous trades. You'll need approximately 15kpp~ to do this all. (7kpp~ depending on how far you go for blacksmithing/if farming materials/class/cha/wis/int, 7kpp~ for Gems if buying, 1kpp for turn in)

sections.heading: START - SKYSHRINE/THURGADIN
sections.text:
This quest can be done in really any order, however, for simplicity sake, we'll start in Thurgadin. You can, if you would prefer start at Oglard in Skyshrine, but he only directs you to Thurgadin, anyway, so...

Go to Thurgadin and locate Loremaster Sarl in the Statue Room directly across from the Icewell Zone Line.

You say, 'Can you tell me the name of a slain dragon'

Loremaster Sarl says 'The name of Dragon you say? One that was slain? Hmmm, sounds interesting. Like I said, we've had little contact with Dragons, but I vaguely recall an ancient legend about a slain dragon and one of our people meeting. Follow me to the Library and we'll talk along the way.

Once he starts walking, you can say "Black" and he will immediately spawn in the library ready for the next segment of the quest. Run there and hand him 50pp to receive Worn Coldain Tome.

Perfect! Reading the book elludes to someone named Burdael having seen a dying dragon. Also, Sarl mentions something about this being a rescued book from their old home and speak of Froststone. The only other place in Velious with Dwarves is the Crystal Caverns, so that's the next place we go!

sections.heading: Crystal Caverns
sections.text:
Historian Baenek is located on the bottom floor in the Dwarve outpost in Crystal Caverns. Give him the Worn Coldain Tome.
• Your faction standing with CitizensofFroststone got better. (+10)
Handing the book to him spawns the Ghost of Burdael at the rear of the of the Tentacle Terror area (you have approximately five minutes before he will despawn). He's a 50 SK who is slowable, rootable, and can be mezzed, so as long as you have one of those, you should be alright. Do note, though, he's got a boatload of hps, so it may be a long fight.

After you kill Burdael, loot Onyxbrand and head back to Oglard in Skyshrine.

Oglard hand-in requires Ally faction? He eats Onyxbrand with amiable, please update if you know what level is required but, to be safe, be Ally

Hand in Onyxbrand to Oglard. Oglard will scream and blab for a bit, but eventually he'll hand you a Dragon Crafted Urn and instruct you to fill it with the remains of Garzicor in Dragon Necropolis. Great, a crypt. Now's the time you should make a hotkey for "Remember, Garzicor".

sections.heading: Dragon Necropolis
sections.text:
For this next part, it's highly recommended that you have a partner. Once you get to Dragon Necropolis, you'll want to have at least Invis/SoW and if possibly some AC/HP. First head to the large double doors (Number #2 on the map) set nearly in the floor with three-four spiders spread around it. There are many traps on the ramp and in the bones on the first landing. These traps are random in location and respawn, although unlike the bones above these will not always spawn a construct and you'll need to go into them anyway for the items to trigger. The door can also trapped (confirmed to be 7/18/22) so you could end up triggering/aggroing nearby mobs/traps. These traps will need to be triggered and moved or trained off (this is where the partner comes in to play). Once the construct/spiders/traps are trained off, go down to the first landing and you'll find the pile of bones. Spam your Garzicor hotkey (Remember, Garzicor) and run around in here. Eventually you'll get text scrolling. Once you see "I am sorry", look on the floor and you'll see a brown bag. It's actually two: Dragonwing Skin and Dragonbone Dust. These are TEMPORARY items, so recommend combining them in the urn right away. This is a No Fail combine and returns a Dragon Crafted Urn. Once looted have you and your kiter cap out or gate.

This spawn shares the same spawn as the Ghost Prensence. Triggering either one will result in a 1-hour respawn, regardless of which one you trigger.

Do NOT leave a construct (since they do NOT reset) at the zone in or out in the open.

sections.heading: Skyshrine (Finished Naginata Blade)
sections.text:
At this point, head back to Oglard and hand him the urn.(Kindly faction was NOT sufficient for this turn in) He'll immediately hand it back and send you to Eldriaks Fe`Dhar. Hand Eldriaks the urn and he will hand you a book titled: "The blade" (instructions on how to form the Naginata Blade) and a Sanctified bone dust (this is two dusts).

The book gives you instructions on how to fabricate the blade as well as the rest of the components to manufacture the full polearm. You'll need to get the following items in the following zones:
• Bronzewood Staff off of Carpenter Grundo in Burning Woods
• Chunk of Chronium Ore off of an Armor of Zek in Kael
• Starmetal Ore off of a A Cliff Golem in The Overthere
• Mandala sketch off of the table in the East wing of Howling Stones (see below)
• Gray Colored Ice off of the ground in the middle of Frontier Mountains at loc (-260, -300)

sections.heading: Blacksmithing section
sections.text:
Now, this is the part that typically trips folks up. You need Blacksmithing to NO LOWER THAN 206 and Pottery to NO LOWER THAN 128 to ensure the lowest possible chance of failure (always 5% min). Pottery's easy, just follow the guide, but Smithing can take a bit longer and involve some coin. You can attempt this at 200, but I strongly advise against it.

Once you're where you want to be in tradeskills, do the following:

In Forge:
1 x Forging Hammer - Bought, Quested, Dropped, Returned on Failure, Returned on Success
1 x Smithing Chisel - Bought, Returned on Failure, Returned on Success
1 x Starmetal Ore - Dropped

This will return Portion of Starmetal x2. Next:

In Forge:
1 x Portion of Starmetal - Crafted
1 x Sanctified bone dust - Quested

This will return Dusted Starmetal Block and Remaining Bone dust. Next begins the most difficult part. This section Trivial is no less than 171. Proceed at your own peril. The next part has an incremental material output (1, 2, 3, 4, 5). Start with:

In Forge:
1 x Dusted Starmetal Block - Crafted
1 x Forging Hammer - Bought, Quested, Dropped, Returned on Failure, Returned on Success
1 x Smithing Chisel - Bought, Returned on Failure, Returned on Success

This will return Blade core-1st fold. Continue doing the combines like this:

In Forge:
1 x Blade core-1st fold - Crafted
1 x Forging Hammer - Bought, Quested, Dropped, Returned on Failure, Returned on Success
1 x Smithing Chisel - Bought, Returned on Failure, Returned on Success

until you get a Blade core-5th fold. Once you have your core folded 5 times, you'll need to shape it with just the forging hammer:

In Forge:
1 x Forging Hammer - Bought
1 x Blade core-5th fold - Foraged, Crafted, Quested

to get Shaped blade core. At this point you should have the these two items (barring fails) in your inventory:

• Portion of Starmetal
• Remaining Bone dust

DO NOT be confused about this part. There are two bone dust applications and each one leads to a half of the sword so if you fail the first ore/dust combine, you can still do the second part. You'll have to reobtain the Sanctified bone dust to reattempt the first, though.

Now, This is the long part. Do the following:

In Forge
1 x Portion of Starmetal - Crafted
1 x Remaining Bone dust - Crafted, Quested

To get: Dusted Starmetal Block. Next:

In Forge:
1 x Dusted Starmetal Block - Crafted
1 x Forging Hammer - Bought, Quested, Dropped, Returned on Failure, Returned on Success
1 x Smithing Chisel - Bought, Returned on Failure, Returned on Success

and on success you should have Blade skin-1st fold. At this point, it's the same process as above to get to Blade skin-10th fold. At this point it's time to combine your Shaped blade core and your Blade skin-10th fold

In Forge:
1 x Blade skin-10th fold - Crafted
1 x Forging Hammer - Bought, Quested, Dropped, Returned on Failure, Returned on Success
1 x Shaped blade core - Crafted
1 x Smithing Chisel - Bought, Returned on Failure, Returned on Success

This will return Complete raw blade. Once you have your raw blade, you'll need to shape it with just the forging hammer.

In Forge:
1 x Forging Hammer - Bought
1 x Complete raw blade - Foraged, Crafted, Quested

This will return Complete shaped blade. Congratulations | | There's still a bit more to go, but we're in the home stretch!

sections.heading: Pottery Section
sections.text:
In order to get your Finished Naginata Blade you'll need to do some pottery. You need Pottery to 128 in order to trivial this part. No sweat, though, since most of what you need to do it is located in Thurgadin.

Once you have Pottery to 128 (or w/e you feel comfortable risking), do the following combine at the pottery wheel:

In Pottery Wheel:
1 x Small Block of Clay - Crafted, Bought, Dropped
1 x Water Flask - Foraged, Crafted, Summoned, Bought, Quested, Dropped

Then (Trivial < 128),

In Pottery Wheel:
1 x Clay/water mixture - Crafted
1 x Complete shaped blade - Crafted

Ok, so we have the clay on our blade, but the egde still needs to be hardened and quenched. To do this part, you need the Gray Colored Ice you collected earlier. (If you didn't, this may be a good time to just read below and collect the rest). To wrap up this part:

In Forge: (Trivial somewhere between 199-200) success at 198 skill and it was not trivial ---> 1/28/2023, did combine at 200 skill, success "You can no longer advance your skill from making this item".
1 x Clay coated blade - Crafted
1 x Gray Colored Ice - Ground Spawn

BAM | | | Finished Naginata Blade. Congratulations on the hardest combine! Now for the rest of the drops.

sections.heading: Burning Woods (Bronzewood Staff)
sections.text:
In the Northwestern section of Burning Woods, there's a large crater with a spaceship-style hut on stilts. This is the giant fort. Inside the giant fort up the ramp are a series of small huts but 1 big one. This big hut is what you want. There are two static spawns in there and each one has a chance to spawn Carpenter Grundo 6:40 respawn. This may take a while, but the giants aren't super hard, so keep at it and he'll show up.

Once Carpenter Grundo pops, kill him and loot your Bronzewood Staff. This will be the haft of the polearm you're making.

sections.heading: Howling Stones (Mandala sketch - Finished Tsuba)
sections.text:
The next part is tricky. You'll need your Key to Charasis, and if you don't have one yet, now's the time to do it. You'll also need a Leatherfoot Raider Skullcap ready to click. You can go in with a group and fight your way to it, but the easier way to do it is get a Dead Man Floating, Invisibility and Invisibility versus Undead (this is commonly called "Double Invis" for those than can do it).

Once inside and all buffed up, go up the North or South stairs to the landing and then turn to the East Wing. From here run onto the east wing landing (most of the east stairs are fake and you will fall through) be ready to turn back to the center and try again if you don't make it the first time. Changing your frame rate to 100 here 'might' help the levitate stays at mostly the same height (go in to Options under the 'Display' tab and push the slider to 100 if it's lower.

Another trick is to sit and alt-tab to discord (or something else to where you can still see you character) when your floating animation reaches its lowest point then tab back in when your animation is at its highest. Rinse/repeat until you can't go any higher.

From here, you need to head to the section on the map that looks like a horizonal 'H'. The Mandala sketch is located on the table in the top left alcove in the 'H' (loc +140,-410 or so). Once you pick it up, click your Leatherfoot Raider Skullcap and GTFO.

Done.

sections.heading: Kael (Chunk of Chronium Ore - Finished Tsuba)
sections.text:
This is undisputedly the most difficult part as you'll need a raid or large group to pull from the Arena/Temple area. The best time, if you can, is to wait for a Statue or Vindi pop and ask the raid/group to pull an armor after the target's dead.

Alternatively, if you have a bold monk and a raid force, the Armor of Zeks can be split-pulled. This requires Vindi being down, killing all of the mobs around and including Kallis, and all mobs at the opposite side of arena as your raid. Have the monk create a corpse on a mob (3-hour rez timer) and pull the corpse all the way against the ice wall where Vindi roams. The monk should leave a small item on corpse and have them flop-run back to the Armor of Zeks. The monk SHOULD be 54+ so they can void dance if the fail FD. Once back at the Armor of Zeks, perform a rez-box pull. Have a cleric rez your ice wall corpse, throw a projectile at the Armor, and click YES on the rez while the projectile is in the air. Allow the train to gain some ground until you see it leave the temple, and then run it to the side opposite of your raid force. Use standard splitting technique and the Armor is all yours. If both sides of arena are camped, you can clear out the Protector of Zeks and gladiators, and run the train down into the actual PvP arena.
- Krixis

However you do it, you'll need to kill an Armor of Zek and loot the Chunk of Chronium Ore. Once you're done in Kael, grab your Forging Hammer and head to a Forge. Do this combine:

In Forge:
1 x Chunk of Chronium Ore - Dropped
1 x Forging Hammer - Bought, Quested, Dropped, Returned on Failure, NOT Returned on Success
1 x Water Flask - Foraged, Crafted, Summoned, Bought, Quested, Dropped

This should yield 1x Chronium Plate.

Keep this and the Mandala sketch on you and head to Paineel.

sections.heading: Paineel/The Warrens
sections.text:
This part is either going to require factioning in the Warrens until amiably faction (which has its own benefits); starting your own level 1 Evil Erudite; or trusting someone else with the appropriate faction to handle 1000pp. However you do it (the toolkit is tradeable), you need to go to #9 on the map of Paineel and talk to Taralani Rahnta. Simply 'Hail' him to confirm that you can do the turn in (sneak works), then hand him 1000pp and he'll return to you a Kejekan Tool Kit. If you are transferring this to another character: as a reminder, characters who are amiably in Paineel (which includes any freshly-created character) can say "need" to the guards by the elevator, to get a key to access Toxxulia Forrest to transfer the Tool Kit. (If you choose to do the turn-in yourself at a lower faction, such as by sneaking, you will need someone to operate the elevator for you.)

Once you have your Kejekan Tool Kit, take that, your Mandala sketch and your Chronium Plate to The Warrens. Nothing in here sees invis; invis down to the Prison area (take a right coming from Paineel, then the first door on the left). This is marked as #10 on The Warrens map. Hail Koajin.

You say, 'Hail, Koajin'

Koajin slowly looks up at you, his eyes glazed in exhaustion. Obviously the kobolds have worked him near to the point of death. You notice he is strong and his paws are scarred here and there. He must be some sort of craftsman. After gazing at you a few moments he realizes you are not a kobold and says, 'Hurry and leave this place, High Elf. Or you'll end up sharing this cell with us and wishing death upon yourself.'

You say, 'I need your help'

Koajin says, 'You need my help to build one? I can help you, but I'll need my tools first. Then maybe when I have my tools I can break out of this rusty cage and run. My tools were taken when they first captured me. They used to force me to use them, show them our craft. I showed them what I could, fearing death, but I haven't seen them since. If you can find them, bring them here along with a suitable plate of metal and a sketch of the tsuba's design. Then I'll see what I can do.'

Everyone should get this dialogue. Give him the Mandala sketch, the Kejekan Tool Kit and the Chronium Plate and he'll return to you Finished Tsuba (MQed successfully by Chickander of Ex Astra).

WOOT | | Grats on ya!

Now, it's time to get the Assembled Naginata.

sections.heading: Skyshrine (Assembled Naginata & Vial of Kromzek blood)
sections.text:
At this point, you should have three items on you: Finished Naginata Blade + Bronzewood Staff + Finished Tsuba. If they're in the bank, don't worry, Skyshrine has one, but you'll have to refer to the maps since it's hidden near the Cobalt Scar fire pot.

Once you get all these items, head to Eldriaks Fe`Dhar and hand him all three items. He will do the following:

Eldriaks Fe`Dhar takes the staff, blade, and tsuba and looks them over. He says, 'Excellent craftsmanship. These will make a fine weapon. But one part remains to join all the pieces together. That is the fitings.' The Wyvern then hands you the items back along with a vial of blood and says, 'This vial of blood will allow you to awaken Garzicor's spirit.'

You should receive:
• Assembled Naginata
• Vial of Kromzek blood

At this point, it's raid only. If you don't have a raid, get one as there is really no other way to kill the Garzicor's Wraith

sections.heading: Dragon Necropolis (Ethereal Bladed Naginata)
sections.text:
Alright, you got your Raid, you've slushed out the crap from above and now you have your Assembled Naginata, your Vial of Kromzek blood. The last step is to imbue your Naginata with the spirit of Garzicor. To do this, you'll need to purchase 2x Flawless Diamond and then awaken Garzicor's Corpse as well as Garzicor's Wraith and then subdue. Garzicor's is summoned by saying the following phrase exactly at +1523, +1109 (same place as before with 2 item spawns)

you are one but two. your vengeance shall find a home. MUST BE EXACT

This will spawn Ghostly Presence. ****NOTE | | Ghostly Presence despawns very, very quickly ~ 60 seconds and there are several construct spawns in the area. This spawn shares the same spawn as the 2 ground spawns. Triggering either one will result in a 1-hour respawn, regardless of which one you trigger.

Give the Ghostly Presence the Vial of Kromzek blood and Garzicor's Corpse will spawn. Upon death, Garzicor's Wraith will spawn - requires several groups to kill.

Once they are dead, two spirits should spawn; one at the skull you woke him up at and one further down towards the Paebala area. Hand each one a Flawless Diamond to receive:

1 x Assembled Naginata - Player Crafted

If all is successful, WOOT! Ethereal Bladed Naginata | | Yay for you tanks! But what about those clothies and all the rest who don't bash, huh? Luckily, we get some love too!

sections.heading: Eldriaks and the Turn-in
sections.text:
So, ya thought we were done, eh? Fooled you! Head back to Eldriaks Fe`Dhar in Skyshrine and hand him the Ethereal Bladed Naginata you combined. He should hand you back your final one:

• Ethereal Bladed Naginata (Identifies as: Eldriaks Verified Naginata).

But, if you can't use it, he gives you some options:

Eldriaks Fe`Dhar says 'You have succeeded Iustus . Garzicor's spirit no longer calls to us from beyond. Now we ask that you do one more thing. You must wield this weapon against all giant kind to satiate Garzicor's thirst for vengeance. The Naginata has a special power against the Kromzek, they will fall easily before it. However, if you do not wish to, hand the weapon back to me and I'll give you an earring more worthy of a being of faith. If you are one of sorcerous powers, hand me the earring and Ill hand you a ring more suited to you.

Give naginata back to him:

Eldriaks Fe`Dhar says 'Tis sad to see that the weapon will not be wielded by it's maker,
but here is your earring. Wear it well.

• Sanctum Guardian's Earring

Give him the earring:

Eldriaks Fe`Dhar says 'So you prefer the ring? Very well, may it serve you well ___Name___.

• Pitted Iron Ring

YOU'RE DONE! CONGRATULATIONS!

THIS IS NOT A ROUND ROBIN TURN IN. IF YOU TURN IN AND YOU MISS YOUR ITEM, MUST COMPLETELY REDO THE QUEST

You say, 'What is powder of reanimation?'

Nivold Predd says, 'There is a gnome necromancer who has been experimenting with a powder used in reanimating long dead organic tissue. He is known to frequent places populated by undead in order to pursue his research. Seek him out and procure a bit of his powder.'

Give him a Fire Beetle Eye (He will accept at dubious) and A Khrix Abomination will spawn in the room directly behind Khrix's closet (not in it). It is very powerful maybe 35-40.

Khrix Fritchoff says 'At last I may leave this place | Good luck destroying my abomination, you will surely need it against my most powerful yet uncontrollable creation!'

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Miadera Shadowfyre can be found in the Tabernacle of Terror in Paineel at (1130, 535).

You say, 'Hail, Miadera Shadowfyre'

Miadera Shadowfyre says, 'Ahhhahahaha! The terror that lays over this city like a blanket tingles my bones with vigor. I seek a fellow apostle of Cazic-Thule to assist me in the [summoning of Terror].'

You say, 'What is required for the summoning of Terror?'

Miadera Shadowfyre says, 'It will be a frightfully fulfilling summons. Alas there are a few components I need before we may proceed. I would be most thrilled if you would bring me an eye of urd, some basalt drake scales, the lens of Lord Soptyver, and a lock of widowmistress hair.'

Some details on each:

• Eye of Urd - Easiest item to get, as long as you are of sufficient level to group in Lower Guk. You will have the opportunity to pull Urd Wizards from just about every camp in the zone. Not a common drop, but since you'll be there doing the XP grind or hoping for Guk Loot to drop, its palatable.

• Basalt Drake Scales - VERY annoying. Went there at 40, so no xp. Took five hours to get one to drop. Basalt Drakes are the rarest of the Drake spawns, and it took five Basalts before one coughed up a scale. They spawn on the hillside near Zazamoukh the Sphynx. Beware, because he did aggro me once when I got too zealous in chasing down a Drake. Kill all the drakes you see to get Basalts to spawn.

• Lens of Lord Soptyvr - Soptyver is a 4 hour spawn and the lens is rare (much rarer than live where it dropped almost every time if not 100%). It wasn't terrible at level 30, because killing the EEs and lesser Lords is reasonable entertaining, about half provided at least some XP for me, and you can hopefully pick up a PBB or two. Word of warning, when Lord Soptyver spawns, ALL THREE Lords spawn together, regardless of how the spawn has been broken up before that. Soptyver cons even to level 30, and the three Lords together killed me and the few other EE campers that were there (mid/upper thirties).

• Widowmistress Hair - Also terribly annoying. I just did her at 40. Everything in Najena is green then, so no xp off anything but the Widowmistress, but there is no way you can solo her, you need a Tank. I spent SIX hours on her, the SIXTH Widowmistress spawn finally dropped hair, and I had to wait through FIVE PHs.

Upon turning these 4 items in to Miadera:

Miadera Shadowfyre says, 'Yes! Can you feel the terror in the air, prickling your flesh, and standing your hair on end? The chanters have summoned the avatar of Terror! Quickly take this mundane mask to him and he shall forge it into a valuable symbol to be worn by loyal apostles of Terror!'

--You receive a Mundane Mask.--

I will forge one item for the faithful of our Lord Cazic-Thule! Make haste! My time here is short!'

We have yet to receive payment for the supplies but you are more then welcome to purchase supplies for them and deliver them. It has been a most unforgiving season upon the wastes I believe.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This is the quest method of obtaining Ghoulbane. This weapon can also be classically obtained as a mob drop.

The quest dialog is optional. Ruathey will respond to the phrase, 'what bag' and provide you with the container even if you don't give her the note, which makes the errand run between Ryshon, Kanthuk and Llara entirely optional if you know this key phrase.

This quest was implemented when The Warrens went live (Hate & Fear revamp).

Hail, Ryshon Hunsti

Ryshon Hunsti says, 'Hello ________. What brings you to the Karanas? Do you seek [enlightenment]?

You say, 'I seek enlightenment'

Ryshon Hunsti says, 'Ahh, i could see by the look in your eyes that you are looking for something more than just enlightenment. Perhaps you are looking for a [sword] crafted by a noble man.

You say, 'What sword?'

Ryshon Hunsti says, 'It is not just a sword friend. It is much more than that. This sword carries with it special [power], something unlike anything else within this realm.'

You say, 'What power?'

Ryshon Hunsti says, 'It is an instrument fashioned together by noble man. It is said to be blessed by the gods themselves. Only a man whose bloodline comes from nobility may wield it. Do you seek the [sword of nobility]?'

You say, 'I seek the sword of nobility'

Ryshon Hunsti says, 'I see, then take this note to Kanthuk Ogrebane. I've been told he can be found fishing not far from the dwarven city.'

Receive a Note to Kanthuk (LORE / NO TRADE).

Travel to Butcherblock to the boat docks. If you go around the wall on the north side to the shore line and follow that north you will find Kanthuk Ogrebane standing there.

You say, 'Hail, Kanthuk Ogrebane'

Kanthuk Ogrebane says, 'Hello'

Hand Kanthuk the note.

You gain experience.

Kanthuk Ogrebane says, 'Ahh, I see you have spoken to Ryshon. You seem tired from your long journey. Sit with me as I tell you a tale. A tale about a true friend of mine, a great man known as [Amstaf Trunolis].'

You say, ' Who is Amstaf Trunolis?'

Kanthuk Ogrebane says, 'Amstaf Trunolis was a good man. I've followed him into [battle] many times. We've seen many of our friends die by the sword of others.'

You say, 'What battle?'

Kanthuk Ogrebane laughes, 'I remember the first time we charged into battle. I was so scared. My hands wouldn't stop trembling. Amstaf pulled me off to the side before the initial attack began. He held my hands within his. I saw his hands begin to glow and felt his energy pass into me. I felt [courage].

You say, 'What courage?'

Kanthuk Ogrebane says, 'I'll never forget what he did for me that day. He gave me the courage to continue. No one's ever done anything like that for me. I vowed that day that I'd follow him into any battle. I'd be there alongside him, no matter what. As time went on we came across an elven woman named [Ambreen].

You say, 'Who is Ambreen?'

Kanthuk Ogrebane says, 'Ambreen was younger than he and I. She knew of the powers of nature. She was able to control the rain which fell from the heavens and would call upon the spirits to aide her. It was obvious that Amstaf took a liking to Ambreen. She ended up coming with us on our crusades. The last I saw of Ambreen was when we went to the snow covered lands of Everfrost. We were wandering the lands when a freak [snowstorm] hit us. We were separated from one another for quite some time.'

You say, 'What snowstorm?'

Kanthuk Ogrebane says, 'I don't know where it came from, but it was so sudden that it caught us all off guard. The snow quickly became unbearable. I tried to move to higher ground, but was unable to. I was stuck within the snowy confines. I didn't know what to do [next].'

You say, 'What happened next?'

Kanthuk Ogrebane says, 'As I laid there my body began to slowly freeze. I knew death was near and accepted the inevitable. Suddenly I felt something clutching at my cloak. I was being dragged upwards out of the snow. A hand pressed against my chest and began to glow. I felt energy pass into my body. Do you know [how] he had saved me?'

You say, 'How did he save you?'

Kanthuk Ogrebane says, 'He saved my life by laying his hands upon my body. A few moments later we found Ambreen lying in the snow, her body frozen by the harsh surroundings. We lifted her up off the ground and began to look for [shelter].'

You say, 'What shelter?'

Kanthuk Ogrebane says, 'We ended up taking refuge within a deserted cabin not too far from our location. We knew that we didn't have much time left to bring life back into her body. However, the storm didn't pass through and we knew we couldn't venture too far without the fear of freezing. I warmed the cabin and rested for some time thinking about what we were going to do. It wasn't long before my exhaustion took over. I fell into a deep [slumber] that night.'

You say, 'What slumber?'

Kanthuk Ogrebane says, 'That night I dreamt of many things. Random thoughts kept swirling around my mind. I kept seeing the image of a cloaked being and of Amstaf circled around a fire. I saw Ambreen's body convulsing above the fire as if life was being brought back to it. I don't know what happened that night. I don't even know if what I dreamt was real, but before I awoke I saw a [strange image].'

You say, 'What strange image?'

Kanthuk Ogrebane says, 'I saw Amstaf lower his head and walk away in silence. He was surrounded by two beings carrying a torch. I don't know what it meant, but I swear it was so real. When I awoke both Amstaf and Ambreen were gone. Please find Llara and give this pendant to her. This pendant belonged to Amstaf. She too had a vision that night that may clear things up. If she asks where you got it from, mention my name.'

You receive A Pendant (MAGIC / LORE / NO TRADE +1cha, PAL only, HUM HIE DWF ERU).

Next you need to find Llara. She is standing on a rock outside of Unrest.

Give the Pendant to Llara.

Llara says 'Oh my! This belongs to Amstaf. Where did you get it?

You say, 'Kanthuk gave it to me'

Llara says 'I take it you're here to find out more about [Amstaf].'

You say, 'Who was Amstaf?'

Llara says 'I've known Amstaf since he was a child. We grew up in the same city together. Ever since I've known him there's always been something [unusual] about him.'

You say, 'What was unusual?'

Llara says 'When we were growing up we used to venture outside the city gates. Some times we would encounter a wandering ghoul or an undead spirit of some sort. He was always able to quickly dismiss the undead being with very little effort. I [learned] many things growing up with Amstaf.'

You say, 'What did you learn?'

Llara says 'Amstaf told me many things when we were younger. Once Amstaf told me that life isn't about how you get there, it's about where you end up. I miss my dear friend. Its been a long time since I've seen him. The night of the snowstorm I dreamt about him. I remember seeing Amstaf's face. I saw something I've never [seen] before.'

You say, 'What did you see?'

Llara says 'I saw desperation. I spoke to many people who knew Amstaf trying to find out if anyone heard anything about that night. No one knew anything about it. When I had reached the dwarven hunting grounds I ran into a woman named Walnan. She kept rambling on and on about the power of the Orb and something about Magi`kot. I didn't understand what she was saying. She didn't know anything about my situation either, but she did tell me that there were others that may be able to help me. She told me that I should find [Ruathey].'

You say, 'Who is Ruathey?'

Llara says 'Ruathey is known for her ability to look into people's souls and find truth. Though I wasn't able to find Amstaf, I was able to recover his sword. I believe that by having his sword I am closer to finding him. Take this note to Ruathey and tell her that I sent you.

You receive Note to Ruathey.

Next you find Ruathey in Lavastorm at -1512, 275 near the Nektulos Forest zoneline.

You say, 'Hail Ruathey'

Ruathey says 'Hello ______.'

Ruathey says 'I see that you've spoken to Llara. She too came to me looking for Amstaf. Though she wasn't able to find her friend, she was able to recover his [sword].

You say, 'What sword?'

Ruathey says 'I've heard stories about a holy sword. There are many rumored to be hidden all throughout the world, yet only a few have actually been found. Amstaf had one of these swords. It is known for its ability to dismiss the undead. Perhaps by having this sword it'll bring you closer to finding your friend. Gather a Ghoul's Heart, Amstaf's Scroll, the Blade of Nobility, a noblemans hilt and place them in this [bag].'

You say, 'What bag?'

Ruathey says 'Take this bag and gather the items I've mentioned. I've been told that the Ghoul's Heart can be found in the estate of the undead, while the scroll can be found in the Keep not far from the Karanas. One of the others are rumored to be found near the dwarven city among the goblins. While the last should be found in the caverns of Najena.

You receive the Nobleman's Bag.

For those of you who haven't figured it out, you will need to go to Butcherblock Mountains, High Keep, The Estate of Unrest, and Najena to get the drops.

Your target is crazed goblins/goblins at stone camp with 3 spawns in Butcherblock, a crazed ghouls (and other monsters?) in Unrest, Crazed Goblins in HighKeep and skeletons in Najena (named "a skeleton"). Amstaf's Scroll can come off of any goblin in the basement in High Keep, it seems. It can be confirmed a pickclaw warrior dropped it.

All the mobs that need to be killed are 25 to up to 35, and the items appear to be uncommon drops.

You combine these 4 items in the bag Ruathey give you and ... You have fashioned the items together to create something new!

You are holding a Ghoulbane.

(The quest may continue from here, or this may just be an alternative way to get Ghoulbane)

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
At the observatory past the windmills in the Steamfonts a female gnome name Brona Frugrin is a telescope lens crafter and she believes that if you can get the retina of the beholder named Borxx, who may be found in either Runnyeye or Beholder at certain times, and return it to her, she can create a telescope unlike any other.

Borxx is a L30 Evil Eye-type monster. Bringing back his loot, the evil eye lens, will yield a 2h blunt weapon called the Staff of the Observers.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text:
Brona Frugrin is located in Steamfont mountains at loc 1868, -197.

You say, 'Hail, Brona Frugrin'

Brona Frugrin says, 'Well met, _______! What brings you out this way? Are you interested in becoming an observer? No, you look like the adventuring type. The wilds of the Steamfont Mountains are as far as my body goes. But through my [duties] as an observer, my mind travels the cosmos.'

You say, 'What are your duties?'

Brona Frugrin says, 'Well, I am quite an accomplished enchanter but most of my time now is spent crafting the magical lenses that enable us to see beyond the ceiling of Norrath and into other realms and dimensions. Say, in your travels have you encountered any [evil eyes]?'

You say, 'What are evil eyes?'

Brona Frugrin says, 'Evil eyes are dangerous creatures of great magical power. You will know one if you see one. There is a rumor that somewhere on Antonica there lives a powerful Evil Eye by the name of Borxx. I believe that with the Lens from her eye and some expert tinkering I could create a device that will enable me to observe the gods themselves in their native planes. If you were to bring me this lens the Eldrich Collective will reward you greatly.

Borxx can be found on the fourth floor of Clan Runnyeye. (loc?) She will drop the Evil Eye Lens

Brona Frugrin says, 'This lens is perfect, ________! Please, take this staff in return for your services.'

Cain Darkmoore is at location 662, -675 in East Freeport.

You say, 'Hail, Cain Darkmoore'

Cain Darkmoore says 'Hail, ______! We are the Steel Warriors of Freeport. Our training disciplines have created some of the finest warriors ever to walk upon Norrath. Perhaps the bards shall sing songs of you one day. Let your first mission be the extermination of [Clan Deathfist].'

You say, 'What Clan Deathfist?'

Cain Darkmoore says 'The orcs of the Commonlands call themselves Clan Deathfist. They have committed many vile acts upon the residents of the Commonlands as well as persons traveling to and from Freeport. They must be destroyed. Go forth to slay them. I shall pay a bounty for every two Deathfist belts. If you are a true warrior of the bunker, perhaps you can begin with [the green and blue].'

You say, 'What is the green and blue?'

Cain Darkmoore says 'The green and blue was a test for all skilled warriors. But we have no more bunker battle blades to spare, and I can not offer you the green and the blue. We must prepare for war | '

You say, 'what bunker battle blade?"

Cain Darkmoore says 'The bunker battle blade was crafted and enchanted for use by warriors only. It has the power to strike down those creatures which hide behind their magic. Once bestowed upon a warrior, it cannot leave your side or it shall vanish from this realm forever. One must perform the [green and blue] to earn such a blade.'

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
The tortured librarian can be found in the library in Kaesora. He is on Brood of Kotiz (Iksar Necro) faction.

You say, 'Hail, tortured librarian'

tortured librarian says 'Bring to me that which was taken.'

Go to the Emerald Jungle and clear the northwest area (top side of the cliff) of mobs. You'll eventually find an iksar tomb raider. Spawn point is likely (1914, 2682) without a placeholder. He paths northwest upon spawning. He is approximately 33-35th level and is a rare spawn.

He always drops a book, which can be one of several Iksar history books. The common drops are the same books as sold in Cabilis. His uncommon drop is a TEMPORARY version of Venril the Chief (tradeable). This is similar to the ones sold in stores in that it covers the rise of Venril Sathir and his creation of an Iksar Empire.

Once you have that book, you bring an Emerald to Dom K`Perl in the Dark Elf outpost of The Overthere. Handing it to him will result in a tradeable TEMPORARY book called Before Green. If you are Kill on sight at the outpost and worried about being attacked by guards, you can have someone hand in the Emerald and trade the book back to you.

Take the two TEMPORARY books and head back to Kaesora's library. If the tortured librarian is not there then clear the libary of MOBs until he appears. He will despawn after a while.

Hand him the two books and it will result in:

tortured librarian fades out of existence. The air smells of death. Something has appeared in your hand.

The result is a Large Tassel Bookmark which identifies as a 'Tassel of Flaxen Cord', required for the Necromancer 8th Rank Skullcap Quest in Cabilis West.

sections.heading: Checklist
sections.text:
• Suggested tasks to complete first:
• Obtain a SoulFire via the Zimel's Blades (SoulFire) quest
• Obtain a Dark Reaver from A ghoul cavalier in Lower Guk
• Get Bloodsabers faction Kindly or higher - there are few ways to do this.
• Get Heretics faction Warmly or higher - Kill Kobolds in The Warrens
• Get Dismal Rage faction Kindly or higher - Do Assist the Great Xelha quest in East Freeport (requires about 1000 bone chips to turn-ins)
• Slay Brother Hayle in Splitpaw Lair prison area - cell doors open via switches !
• Loot and right-click on Burning Soul of the Pious
• Find Lord Grimrot in Southern Karana - MUST BE LIVING VERSION!
• Give Lord Grimrot Dark Reaver and right-clicked Burning Soul of the Pious - requires Bloodsabers Kindly faction !
• Right-click the Burning Soul of the Pious he hands you back - make sure it does not have any text in the chat window; if it does, your turn-in did not work (probably due to faction) !
• Kill Lord Grimrot
• Loot Pestilence Scythe - the one with charges; the other one doesn't matter for this quest .
• Find Jotayi Ibupran in Paineel (Necromancer Guild balcony)
• Give Jotayi Ibupran Pestilence Scythe (the one with charges) and Burning Soul of the Pestilent - requires Heretics Warmly Faction !
• Find Dason Goldblade in Plane of Sky Efreeti Chamber (quest room) - MAKE SURE YOU ARE KEYED UP TO ISLAND 4 BEFORE SEEKING HIM OUT !
• Give Dason Goldblade 500pp to spawn Inte Akera inside the Windmill on Island 4 - be quick, he will eventually despawn .
• Kill Inte Akera and loot the Burning Soul of the Virtuous. Note: If you are in a group, the soul is linked to whoever turns in the 500 platinum to spawn Inte.
• Find Luxio Nulsis in East Freeport (Shadowknight spell vendor basement area)
• Give Luxio Nulsis the three Souls and Soulfire - Requires Dismal Rage Kindly faction !

It's rumored to be a 3.2-hour spawn. One of the fastest ways to spawn Lord Grimrot is to make an instance right at 6am. Use /time to see the in-game time.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Upon giving Sir Lucan D`lere the note during the Message Intercept Quest.

Sir Lucan Dlere says, 'So I see you decided to bring me the message. Good. I would hate to have to hunt you down. It could have gotten really messy and I hate reading bloodstained messages. Well it seems Antonius Bayle and the Knights of Truth have begun an alliance. And it sounds as though I may have a traitor among my guards. If you wish to switch your allegiance to Freeport, then find me this traitor. Bring me his militia tunic. Try to keep the blood from staining it.'

The traitor's name is Guard Alayle, and he is in the Freeport Militia House's backyard, underneath the deck. You may have to kill him several times before he will give you a tunic.

Return the Slashed Militia Tunic to D'Lere. Dubious faction was sufficient for this turn-in.

Sir Lucan D`Lere says, 'So, it was Alayle! He was of no importance to us. He knew nothing. I thank you for assisting the Freeport Militia. My men shall keep an eye out for you. Unfortunately, so will the Knights of Truth. Might I suggest you spend less time in North Freeport?'

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
1. Say, "I am a monk of great skill to Puab Closk in West Freeport to receive Puab's Token.

2. Give Puab's Token to a banished kerran in Kerra Isle to receive Box With Pawprints.

3. Kill a goblin alchemist that spawns in Misty Thicket for Ribcage Chest Armor.

4. Kill a goblin alchemist to get the Humerus Handled Mace in the Gorge of King Xorbb.

5. Kill A Pickclaw Mindripper to get the Cat Skull Cap in RunnyEye Citadel.

6. Kill A Pickclaw bonemender to get the Fractured Femur in RunnyEye Citadel.

7. Combine the items in the box to get A Box of Cat Bones.

8. Hand A Box of Cat Bones to a banished kerran to receive Tattered Parchment.

9. Bring Tattered Parchment to Puab Closk for your Treant Fists.

In the guild house of the Ashen Order, Puab Closk has a task for you.

He is located in the top of the guild house.

You say, 'Hail, Puab Closk'

Puab Closk says, 'Greetings, I am Puab Closk, Master of the Ashen Order. Our home is your home, friend. Feel free to stay as long as you like. Learn our ways as many have done in the past. To fight like the tiger and strike like the cobra are your goals. Cough- [treant fist] -Cough!'

You say, 'What treant fist'

Puab Closk says, 'I have these items, and will gift them to any [monk of great skill]'

You say, 'I am monk of great skill'

Puab Closk says, 'Then you shall aid our family. My former pupil [Clawfist] has been banished by his people. You will go to him and hand him this token as proof of your origin. He shall be expecting you.'

Puab Closk hands you Puab's Token.

You say, 'Who is Clawfist'

Puab Closk says, 'Clawfist is a Kerran, a catman. He braved the dangers of Norrath to reach the Ashen Order. He sought knowledge of our disiples [sic]. He learned well.'

Clawfist is actually a Kerran named a banished kerran in Kerra Isle. He is in the basement of the temple, (behind the throne and down a ramp.)

You say, 'Hail, a banished kerran'

a banished kerran says, 'Rrrrrr.. Away frrrom this isle of death and.. prrrr.. punishment.'

You say, 'Puab sent me'

a banished kerran says, 'Prrr.. Master Puab? Show me prrroof.'

Hand him your Puab's Token.

a banished kerran says, 'Ashen Order | Prrr.. My order. I have been expecting one of us. Prrr.. Help me rejoin my native land. Return the [remains of Thipt] to me. This shall aid me in my redemption.'

He hands youa Box With Pawprints (a 4 slot combine box).

a banished kerran says, 'Clawknight Thipt wished to learn the ways of Ashen. Prrr. Together we go into green Goblin's lair to train. Prrr.. We find too many and he is too weak. Seperated and unable to find him, I hear his death cry. Prr.. I cannot make it back, the eyes are upon me. Now I must find one sent by Ashen to aid in the recoverrry of his remains - his Humorous Handled Mace, Ribcage Breastplate, Cat Skullcap and Fractured Femur Bone'

• The Humerus Handled Mace is found on a goblin alchemist in the Gorge of King Xorbb. The spawn point (loc 705, -1794) is at the fork in the gorge directly outside the entrance to Runnyeye. The placeholder is a goblin lookout, a goblin sentry, or a goblin veteran. However, there are two identical spawn cycles at this loc with different timers; 72 minutes and 6 minutes. Both spawns can be up at the same time. The alchemist is a random spawn on the 72 minute respawn timer. -- These are the easy but frustrating two to get. Both goblin alchemists seem to be about 18-19th level, and while they can be hard to find typically once found go down pretty easily.

• The Ribcage Breastplate is Ribcage Chest Armor, which may be found on a goblin alchemist that spawns in Misty Thicket. The spawn rate varies: he has been hunted for 6 hours and never appeared, and then popped up twice in an hour on another day. The camp he spawns at is the southern goblin camp from the entrance to Runnyeye, and the placeholder spawn seems to be Mooto, a goblin shaman and/or a goblin warrior. Seven-minute respawn time on the placeholder at loc -885.42, 1114.96.

• The Cat Skull Cap now drops off A Pickclaw Mindripper in RunnyEye Citadel.

• The Fractured Femur now drops off A Pickclaw bonemender in RunnyEye Citadel.

Once you have all 4 items, place them in the Box With Pawprints and combine. You'll be rewarded with A Box of Cat Bones. Take this back to Kerra and hand it into the banished kerran, Clawfist.

a banished kerran says, 'Prrr.. Thank you brother of Ashen. I can now spend my time upon this island in peace, until my penance is serrrved. He dabs his paw into the mud and places it upon a tattered parchment. Take this message to Puab. Farrrwell.'

You gain experience.

He hands you a Tattered Parchment.

Bring this back to Puab Closk.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, 'Hail, Archivist Tyriele'

Archivist Tyriele says, 'Have you ever found a gift with no name? This one was buried beneath the snow where even time forgets. Still wrapped… still waiting. But the [tag] is nearly gone and is hard to read.'

You say, 'What tag?'

Archivist Tyriele says, 'It reads: ‘To the one who fought with song beneath a frozen moon.’ That is all. How can I [find who this belonged to]?'

You say, 'find who this belonged to'

Archivist Tyriele says, 'Yes. That would be wonderful. The gift is unfinished — a kindness not yet received. The Ledger cannot remember what is left unwritten. He was a bard, I believe. A Coldain. Kind-hearted. The kind who sings warmth into frost. Search the halls of Thurgadin. Speak the gift aloud. If he remembers… so too may the Icestar. Bring back the packaging so that I may know that the gift was properly received. Please note, it can only be opened by those the gift was intended for.'

You receive a Lost Gift Box.

Go to the Thurgadin Bar and Hand Kirvil Snowstring the Lost Gift Box.

Kirvil Snowstring turns the box over in his hands. His expression softens and says, 'This ribbon… Brell’s breath, it’s hers. She said if it ever found me, I’d know she made it out. But now…Now I remember. And so will the stars.'

You receive Discarded Packaging.

Give Discarded Packaging to Archivist Tyriele.

Archivist Tyriele carefully places the frosted page onto a bound stack. The words inscribe themselves in pale blue ink. She says, 'Thank you for delivering the gift! And what is this? The wrapping on that gift seemed to be chapter 2 of the Preamble! That is fantastic news indeed! Its story is no longer lost. The Ledger stirs. Another thread woven into the Whispers. Another light reclaimed.'

You receive Chapter II, Of Bards and Bitter Winters and a Holiday Gift.
